tei:div.tei:p: ༄spro/ kho( / ste sne / sne sne zhe — — sne ste8 khi/ spyone skyi zhetswa ri rdzo tre— ri 9 tsho ci byu cho — dz+war —cho jishāsdi hūṃ —byelngechisdosdu4rdzu —/dzeri rmye/twe—wa— rnane+eṭ+wāṃ k+tone+e chitsho tsho — ji jitrīrī 〉ṭ+wāṃthotshone— dzhalkejiṭ+wāṃ—3dze gerarngudz+wasdo ༵ ciri rdoskre— sna4༈ rmatha mimagyi waṃtsonag khohwanga.oṃ ra 'ad medasga /rgamo bsnyunal / khorkanga.ā+o 4kor 'despo// //——
ngucetra

7/ dpe bskrun gsal bshad//ra༅༅/ /dpal sa skya'i bstan shādzin mkhas grub kyi dbang po mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs blo gsal bzang po mchog ni rab byung 15 sa lug 1919 lo mdo khams sde dge nya shis se tsha zhes par sku 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas mchodi rten dang lha khang lha sku la serdzogs pa dag pa'i gzigs snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga'/ klog yig sogs thugs rtsol chung ngus mkhyen rtogs byung / 'bum bklags dus nas stong nyid la nges shes 'drongs/ sga stoni ngag dbang legs pa/ sga pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros sogs kyis gtsor byas/ grub mtha' ris med kyi yongs 'dzin sum cu rtsa grangs tsam mnyes pa gsum gyi 〉sgo nas bsten/ gsar snying gi gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ dge rgyas dben pa'i sgrub sde gsar du btab ste lhag pa'i lha mchog du ma'i grangs dus mtshan ma'i bsnyen sgrub tshad du phyin pa mdzad/ sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi gdams pa mtha' dag thugs nyams su bzhes/ khyad par gsung ngag lam 'bras la brten te lam rtags kyi yon tan mngon du gyur/ gang shar rdo rje'i rtogs brjod mang du bzhengs pa 'phags yul gyi grub thob rnams kyi do ha dang 2

dbyer med pa bzhugs/ gzhan yang gsung 'angum skosnar pod lnga tsam mchis/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya dang bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang la serdzogs pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang mthon po rnams su zhabs pad bkod de gsung ngag lam 'bras stso1ba bshad kyi nyams khrid gtso bor gyur pa'i gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi zab chos gdul bya gang la gang dgos su bstsal/ khyad par sa skya dang / rnying ma/ shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i chos brgyud la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa che/ sa skya bla brang shar dang rin chen sgang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba sesgogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs la'ang phrin las kyi phyag rjes bla na ma mchis pa mnga'/ dgung grangs bdun cu rtsa lnga rab byung 17 chu bya lo 1993 zla 6 tshes 17 la gdan sa bla brang shar nas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ 'di'i thad lkesngon dus ar byang chub ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'chad pa'i 'phro la gshegs pa dang / kun mkhyen rong stoni che na po zhi bar gshegs pa dang chos 'asgo bcad pa'i bar la nyin zhag gnyis las med pa ltar/ rje 'di nyid kyang byang gter sgrub slor gsum gyi dbang gnang ba dang sku gshegs pa'i bar la nyin zhag gnyis las med pas 'di kho na'ang shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du mngon/ brgyud 'dzin 3

slob tshogs rnams kyang / dben pa'i ri sul rnams su chos dang gdams ngag la rtse gcig tu gzhol/ lto skya gos hrul 'dod chung chog shes kyi ngang / tshe 'di las phyi ma gal che ba gzigs pa sha stag byung / sgrub brtsone bstan pa skrodas grags/ sku dboni 'jam dbyangs seng ge mkhan 'jigs med bstan 'dzin phrin las rnams kyis gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi bstan pa phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs kun tu mi nyams pa spel bzhin pa'o/ /mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs blo gsal bzang po'i gsung mgur gces btus zhes pa'i deb chung 'di ni zhal gsung rnam mgur chen mo las blo sbyong dang rig pa ngo sprod skor gyi mgur tshan phal cher btus te stabs bde'i deb chung 'di bzhin bkod pa yin/ skabs don sbyor mtshams sogs kyi thad rnam thar chen mo'i tshig 'gros ji bzhin las rdo rje'i gsung la so skye'i tshig gis ma bslad pa bya rgyu ni byin rlabs kyi tshan kha mi nyams pa'i ched yin/ rgyu mtshan des na dkar chag sogs kyi spros pa'ang rgyangs ring du dor te rje bla ma'i zhal sleb thang grwa lkebasode nams phrin las dang / bsam 'grub rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bzang po bcas nas gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang posnas kun nas bslangs te par bskrun gnang skabs/ snying nas rjes su yi rangs bcas phran bstan 'dzin smerdzon lam gyis// // lnge/ phyi lo 2009 lor stag tshang mkhan sprul rin po che'i 4

phyag nas gsung mgur deb chung 'di mjal byung bar/ dbul pos gter rnyed lta bu'i yid 'phrog ste bal yul mchod rten gyi dpe deb tshong khang tshang mar nyul ya/nga / da cha rdzogs zin pa dang slad 'gyor min mi shes skad thos skabs yid 'phongs pa'i rnam pas rgyud bskul te/ slar yang rgyal skusnangs sa chen zhes pa nas tshar grwa smu rus/ mgur gsungs pa po sku ngo ma nas chos 'brel ma thob kyang brgyud pa 'dus par dwang 'dod yid ches kyi 〉sgo nas deb grangs 500 tham pa par bskrun zhus par bla ma yi dam mkha' 'grerdzo chos skyodang srung mas gnang ba 〉(la zhing / 'brel tshad sku bzhi'i go 'phangs rin po che thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //5

ra༅༅/ /dpal sa skya'i bstan 'dzin mkhas grub dbang po mkhanari chen rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gsal bzang po mchog gi zhal gsung rnam mgur chen mosna las gsung mgur 〉thor 'ga' zhig khol du phyung ba bzhugs so// myo/ /bla ma rgyang 'apod kyi glu bladzas pa ni/ na mo gu ru bh+ya/ mkhyen no mkhyen no bla ma bka' drin can mkhyen no/ /dran no dran no bla ma bka' drin can dran no/ /spyi gtsug pad+ma rgyas pa'i ge sar gyi dbus na/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo 'o ru bzhugs te/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku nyid du bzhengs pa'i/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i rnam rol sa skya pa yab sras/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag e waṃ pa yab srakha/ /byesab bshad bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tshar pa rje yab sras/ /tshogs bshad shing rta'i srol 'byed dkon mchog gi lhun grub/ /ngo mtshar bka' babs bdun ldan mkhyen brtse yi dbang po/ /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i sdud po blo gter gyi dbang po/ /snyigs dus 'aspo ba'i mgon po ngag dbang gi legs pa/ /'jam dbyangs ngur sprig bzhes pa chos kyi ni rgyal mtshan/ /khyad par ma lus rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi phung po/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang drin chen gyi bla ma/ /'jam dpal dgrangs dngos chos kyi blo gros la sogs pa'i/ rtswa brgyud drin chen bla ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /a ho/ bdag 'dzin rmongs 6

pa'i khrag mtsho srid rtse ru phyur ba/ /—rdzong nyid bde chen zhal du hub gcig gis gsol nas/ /sku dang ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud len du bsgyur ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal drin chen bla ma de mkhyen no/ /gzhi lus dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi'i lhan skyes kyi 'dzin mar/ /smin lam dbang bzhi'i char rgyun bar med du bran pas/ /don gnyis 'bras bu mchog gi dga' stod la sbyodar ba'i/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i deng/ dpon bla ma de mkhyen no/ /dbang bzhi'i ye shes 'dren pa'i rdo rje yi gseng lam/ /rim gnyis rnal 'gror zab mo'i skyo grogs de byin pas/ /bde chen ye rides phyag rgya chen po yi dga' stod/ /snying la sbyin pa'i drin chen bla ma de mkhyen no/ /mkhyen no mkhyen no bla ma bka' drin can mkhyen no/ /dran no dran no bla ma bka' drin can dran no/ /mkhyen no mkhyen no skyabs gsum kun 'dus de mkhyen no/ //mkhyen no mkhyen no sku gsum dbyer med de mkhyen no/ /mkhyen no mkhyen no rtsa gsum mnga' bdag de mkhyen no/ /dkyil 'khor dbus na ba zhugs pa'i drin can bla ma de dran byung / /'di phyi'i lam bzang stoni pa'i drin chen bla ma de dran byung / /bka' drin 'khor mtha' bral ba'i drin chen bla ma de dran byung / /snying nas gdung bas 'bod do thugs rjes 'bral med du gzigs mdzod/ /kye ma las ngan khur khyer snyoms las pa bdag ni/ /bla mas rjespobazung gdams ngag zab rgu zhig thebo 7

cing / /rtag tu snying po'i sgrub la brtseni khul 'dra byas kyang / 81ga dril ngan lam sgordzor ba'i rang sems ni ma thul/ /blo dang bya ba'i thabs la je mkhas dang je mkhas/ /sgyu lus skyid 'dod snang ba je che dang je che/ /rang sems chags sdang sprin nag je long dang je long / /zhe sdang drag po'i me chen je 'bar dang je 'bar/ /'dod chags srid pa'i khrag mtsho je zhabrugs dang je 'khrugs/ /gti mug snosgongs pa'i mun pa je nag dang je nag /phrag dog 'gran sems rlung dmar je 'tshub dang je 'tshub/ /nga rgyal ser sna'i mdud pa je dam dang je dam/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong po'i rgyu 'grul je thu dang je thu/ /snyigs ma lnga yi rang mtshang je rdol dang je rdol/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i bang chen je nye dang je nye/ /lo dang zla ba'i la mo gcig rgyag dang gnyis rgyag /nyes ltung sgrib pa'i ser rberted gcig 'bab dang gnyis 'bab/ /'jig rten 'khrul ba'i rnam g.yeng je mang dang je mang / /tshul 'di gzigs sam 'jam marbeton thugs rje yi bdag nyid/ /gzigs na thugs kyis bzod dam drin chen gyi bla ma/ /sngoni chad khyed kyi bka' 'das 'khor ba yi las bsgrubs/ /kye ma da ni 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la 'jigs nas/ /stobs chen 'jigs sel khyed la skyabs su rang mchi na/ /'jigs pa myur du skusnal mdzod drin chen gyi bla ma/ /bdag blo chos su 'gro zhing dam chos lam du rang longs 8

shing / /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi nas 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar/ /khyab bdag/ dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rang :snabs shig /gang sku gasku1 ba med bzhin sku ba/sum/ gyis 'gro 'dul/ /gang gsung skye 'gag bral bzhin theg gsum gyi sgra sgrogs/ /gang thugs g.yo ba med bzhin snying rje yi gter mnga'/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi bka' drin zhig zhutherdzo/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje bla ma 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs pa'i drung nas gsung ngag rin po che zhu skabs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i yoni tan dran bzhin du bla ma'i gdan sa thar lam rnam rgyal dgon du sbyar ba'o// 7/ /rje bla ma 'jam dgrangs rgyal mtshan mchog dgung grangs bdun cu don gnyis bzhes pa lcags 'brug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu drug la blo1 bur du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te zab dasongs chos dbyengs su thim par gyur to/ /de'i tshe yid skyo ba'i glu blangs pa ni/ kye ma 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /ngan 'aṅge gdug pa'i rba rlabs g.yo ba'i nang / /las kyi rūng dmar drag pos bdas pa la/ /sdug bsngal srin po'i dzasnang gis gtse ba las/ /thar pa chen po'i grong du dbugs 'byin pa'i/ /bshes gnye na cang shes dbang po gang du gshegs/ /kye ma kyi hud kye ma kyi hud ang / /rje btsun bla ma dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /skal ngan bdag ni 'khor ba'i srin gling lus/ / nyam thag byis pas pha ma 'bod pa bzhin/ /ngu ba'i 'o dod bos kyang ma mthong bas/ /skal ngan bdag gi snying 'di gas la thug /dngos dang rmi lam nyams kyi snang cha la/ /pha khyed dgyes pa'i zhal bzang mi stone na/ /kye ma mabode med bdag 9

gis ji ltar bya/ /'di phyi kun tu khyed las skyabs gzhan med/ /mthor gtong dma' gtong ci mdzad khyed rang shes/ /zhes pa'i smre sngags 'di shugs kyis thal lo// 7/ /de rjes khu bo dam pa blo gros mkhyen rab dgung grangs nga lnga bzhes pa'i dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te zhi bar stsegs so/ /de'i tshe/ kye ma/ pha bla ma mi mngon dbyengs su gshegs/ /bu dwa phrug 'khor ba'i thang dkyil 'khyams/ /pha dran pa snying gis ma bzod nas/ /ngu mchi ma'i rgyun dang smre sngags bcas/ /nyam thag pa'i ngu 'bode 'di gsan na/ /pha brtse bas mi dgongs bzode dam ci/ /zhes kyang smras so// 7/ /rang lo nyer gsum lcags khrug lor kye rdor bsten chen lo 'bor ma zhig la ngag ring bcas dang mtshams shin tu dam par byas pas khams 'dus kyi rnam pa cung zad byung bar rdzong gsar du rin po che'i mdun zhu yig phul bas/ gegs sel gyi zhal gdams thun mong ma yin pa mang po dang khyad par/ a ho/ bu chos kun sems kyi snang ba yin/ /na tsha bde sdug rnam rtog yin/ /rnam rtog gi rtsa ba bcad gyur na/ /skye 'gag gnas bral 'gro 'ong med/ /sems nyid gsal rig stong pa gsum/ /zung 'jug de bla ma yi dam yin/ /de rang ngo shes pa'i lta ba la/ /'dzin pa'i sgrog gis ma 'ching zhig /spros bral gyi lta ba de'i ngang nas/ /bskyed rdzogs sogs rtsal mdangs ci shar yang / /'gag med kyi ba〉tshem par nan tan mdzod/ /gegs sel dang bogs 'don rgyal po ni/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'gyor yin/ /mos gus kyi gnad du bsnun pa gces/ /de skad gdams pa nyung ngu 'di/ /rang la nyams myong 6 10

yod min kyang / /bla ma rnams kyis gdams pa bzhin/ /brjod 'dis khyed la phan sdi/ra cingaka /ces sogs kyi zhal gdams gnang bas gegs las grol zhing bsnyen pa sgyin sreg bcas mthar phyin// 7/ /lo 'di'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i nyin dgung grangs bdun cu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa'i rje bla ma legs pa'i zhabs bde ba can du gshegs so/ /de'i tshe/ kye ma 'jigs rung 'a91ra ba'i rgya mtsho'i che/ /sgrol ba'i ded daphro lan gcig rnyed pa de/ /rmi lam nor rnyed bzhin du dbyengs su yal/ /kye ma da ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /nyin dran mtshan dran rje btsun bla ma dran/ /bzod med gdung ba'i snying rlung drag po ldang / /'di la gso ba'i thabs gzhan ma rnyed pas/ /mgoni khyed bzhugs pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ /myur du drongs shig rje btsun bla ma kye/ /zhes dang // 7/ /'jam masmo ngag dbang legs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa snying nas dad pa'i rba rlabs g.yo ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang byas so// 65 ho/ mthong na 'khor ba'i lam las rang shugs kyis ldog la/ /thos pas thar pa'i sa mkhan gcig pu ru gyur cing / /dran pas srid dang zhi ba'i 'jiges pa kun sel ba'i/ /skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid drin chen gyi bla ma/ /'jam mgoni ngag dbang legs pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /lus kyi ba spu'i 'khri shing dbang med du ldang zhing / /ngag gi gdung dbyangs drag po'i 'o dod kyis 'bod na/ /khyed shes dad pas bskul ba'i skal ldan gyi bu la/ /rtag tu 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs 11

rje yis gzigs shig /rang grol bcos bsgyur bral ba chos nyid kyi ngo bo/ /rang bzhin yodi med rtag chad 'pho 'gyur las 'das pa'i/ /rang rig brjod du med pa chosgos sku yi bla ma/ /'jam matreren ngag dbang legs pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi kun rtog rang grol chen po la sbyor thong / /gsal khyab nam mkha' tsholta bu'i rang sems la bltas pas/ /gsal 'dzin stong 'dzin mtshan rtog rang ngo ru dag pa'i/ /gsal stosnang zung du 'jug pa 'ordzongs sku yi bla ma/ /'jam mgon ngag dbang legs pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi rtag chad zung 'jug ye shes la sbyor thong / /ma skyes gdod nas dag pa chos nyid kyi rang mdangs/ /ma 'gag tshogs drug rtog pa rang ngo ru spol ba'i/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi sprul sku yi rnam rol/ /'jam mgoni ngag dbang legs pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi rtog tshogs rang grol chen po la sbyor thong / /chos nyid 'khor 'das ming btags zad pa yi sbug tu/ /chos dang chos can dbyer med bde chen gyi thig le/ /chos dbyings kun khyab ngo bo nyid sku yi bla ma/ /'jam mgoni ngag dbang legs pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi gnyis 'dzin gdod ma'i gzhi dbyengs la sbyor thong / /phyogs med nyer gcig 'du shugs me bzhin du 'bar ba'i/ /zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i gseng lam la brten nas/ /tshe gcig che ba gsum ldan 12

rgyal sa la 'khod pa'i/ /pha rgan sku drin dbang po snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi/ phung khams 'ja' lus 'od cisku la sgyur thong / /zhes pa'i gdung stings kyi 'o dod kyang 'bod par byas so// tsha/ /brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen pa bskyal bas mi lam dang 'od gsal yang yang lan mang du zin pa'i tshe/ a ho khrag gi chu gter/ /rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dbus na/ /rgyal kun ye shes phung po/ /ma rungs gdug pa 'dul phyir/ /srin po'i gzugs su sprul ba'i/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis dpa' zhing / /mthing nag spyan gsum me 'bar/ /bdud dpung 'dul ba'i dpa' bo/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed ma/ /dgra babeg/sa sbyordzol ba'i shan pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma/ /rnal 'byore yongs kyi dgra lha/ /dam tshig can gyi grogs po/ /sngags rig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' nyan/ /bstan srung skurdzongs kyi rgyal po/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba'i sde dponi/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung / /dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ /srid gsum lha 'dre'i dmag dponi/ /rgyud gsum dregs pa'i yang rje/ /khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog bdag /zhi bla'i mdangs kyis mdzes pa/ /rgyas pa'i byin gyis brjid pa/ /dbang sdud rtsal la myur ba/ /drag po'i las la dga' ba/ /sku yis zhing khams khyab pa/ /nga ros stsortong gsum 'dar ba/ /thugs rje nye ring med pa/ /yoni tan cha shas rdzogs pa/ /phrin las thogs 13

pa med pa/ /stobes ldan ma hā kā la/ /rgyud gsum dregs par bcas pa'i /dam can chos srung rgya mtsho/ /sgrub pa po la dgongs dang / /dam tshig can la gzigs dang / /sngoni gyi zhal bzhes sgrubs dang / /dam tshig rjes su skyongs dang / /khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ /snying nas chos la mos shing / /bstan la gakhog tu sems pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs sras nga tsho'i/ /bsam pa'i re ma bskang na/ /zhal bzhes ral ba min nam/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin skyodang na/ /snyan brgyud gsang mdzod 'odzin po/ /nga tsho brgyud 'dzin bcas pas/ /gsang chen slobe bshad zab mo'i/ /nyan bshad 〉thom sgrub snang bas/ /sa gsum gsal bar nus shing / /bar chad sgra 'khon 'jug pa/ /ming gi lhag mar mdzod cig /sprang ban 'khos ka dman yang / /deng sang blatshochen phal ltar/ /bstan 'gro'i don la bsnyad de/ /mnga' thang rgyal khams 'gran pa'i/ /blo ngan gting nas med pas/ /rnam dkar snyan pa'i 'grug sgra/ /sa gsum khyab par mdzad nas/ /bstan dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag /rdo rje srung ba'i rwa bar/ gtan du tshud par mdzod la/ /rab 'byams zhi ba'i las la/ /rang dbang 'gyor bar mdzod dang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la/ /sems pa shin tu dkar yang / /stobs dang 'gror pas dben pas/ /phan pa'i go skabs bral byung / /tshe 'di'i lto gos 14

tsam zhig /ji ltar byas kyang rnyed mode/ /bsam pa bstan la sems pas ye shes spyan dang ldan na/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'gyor/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba'i/ /rab 'byams rgyas pa'i las la/ /rang dbang 'gror bar mdzod dang / /chos brgyad dbang gis pha rol/ /'gugs 'dod sred zhen min pa/ /shin tu bstan la sems pas/ /'khor slobe zang zing 'du ba/ /dbyar sprin bzhin tu gtibs pa'i/ /rab 'byams dbang gi las la/ /rang dbang 'gror bar mdzod dang / /phyogs 'dzin chags sdang drag pos/ /gzhan srog 'phrog pa'i sdig las/ /rmi lam du yang med pas/ /bstan 'gro bla ma'i don du/ /gdug can lta stengs tsam gyis/ /ming gi lhag mar bgyi ba'i/ /rab 'byams drag po'i las la/ /rang dbang 'gror bar mdzod dang / /rgyal bstan rlung gseb mar me/ /yod la med kyi dus 'dir/ /'khos med sprang po nga yang / /ci drag 'di drag bsams pa'i/ /re ba gting nas skyes na/ /bstan pa'i bdag por bskos shing / /mthu rtsal thogs pa med pa'i/ /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho/ /thugs rje mthu stobs bskyed ran/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gis/ /rdo rje spyi 'or bzhag cing / /bdud rtsi lce la blud de/ /bstan pa lag tu gtad tshe'i/ /zhal bzhes dran par gyis la/ /brgyud pa gser gyi nyag ma/ /dam sel g.ya' dang bral ba'i / /15

grub thob rig 'dzin rnams kyis/ /dpyad gsum tshad mas bkral ba'i/ /mdo sngags snyan brgyud man ngag /phyogs kun dar rgyas khyab mchordod/ /nyam chung sprang po bdag kyang / /bsam rgyu chos shig bsams kyang / /snyigs dus bar chad tre(da pas/ /rtag tu ye shes spyan gyis/ /bu la ma bzhin gzigs pa'i/ /srung skyodab mel tshe zhu'o/ /a ho mthu tshen nag po/ /dpal ldan 'dod khams lha mosna/ /zhing spyodang dam tshig mgod po/ /bka' nyan dam can rgya mtshos/ /rtag tu mel tshes skyong ba'i/ /bkra shis rgyas par zhu'o/ /zhes pa'i glu'ang blangs so// lto/ / 'di'i dbyar 'phre chen rdza dmar ma zer ba'i lung stong zhig tu zla ba drug tsam bsngad/ de'i tshe glu blangs pa ni/ nges hrūng gi glu yid skyo 'dren pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba// a ho/ rje 'gran gyi do med rin po che/ /sprang zol med kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /chos skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /yang 'do med chos gzugs kyi dred po zhig /mi med dben pa'i ri sul du/ /bag med du gcer nyal byed pa'i tshe/ /phyi yul rkyen sna tshogs kyis bskul byas nas/ /nang nges 'byung gi bsam pa ci yang skyes/ /de gsal 'debs kyi tshig gi phreng bar star/ /yid nges 'byung skyed cig rnal 'gror pa/ /daphyid zla gsum khu byug gis skyo glu len/ /dus rtag tu snyan snyan 'dra lags kyang / /nam zla dus rdzogs nas rang yul log /khu byug spyodan mo dran tshe yi mug 16

skye/ /gsung snyan yid 'ong dran dus snang ba skyod/ /dbyar zla gsum spang la me tog skyes/ /dus rtag tu bkrag bkrag 'dra lags te/ /stoni ser ṭaṃ'i ngad kyis yud la bcom/ /rtsi skya skam por gyur tshe snang ba skyo/ /me tog gzhon nu dran nas ye mug skye/ /stoni zla gsum zhing la 'bras drug smin/ /dus rtag tu smin smin 'dra lags te/ /sad ser ba'i dgra yis yud la bcom/ /sog skya skam por gyur tshe snang ba skyo/ /lo tog gzhon nu dran nas yi mug skye/ /'od gsal nyi zla'i snang ba gsal gsal po/ /dus rtag tu 'tsher 'tsher 'dra lags te/ /rta bdun shing rta yis yud la drangs/ /grib so thang la babs dus snang ba skyo/ /nyi gzhon gsar pa dran tshe yi mug skye/ /yang sbrang char sngoni mo sim sim po/ /dus rtag tu 'bab 'bab 'dra lags te/ /nam zla dus rdzogs nas bu yug 'tshub/ /ri kluri kha bas bkang tshe snang ba skyo/ /sbrang char sngoni mo dran dus yi mug skye/ /mda' gzhung gsum gyi chu mig sngo ring ma/ /khyod lhung lhung snyan pa'i chab sgra sgrog /dus rtag tu 'bab 'bab 'dra lags te/ /dgun grang ngar :mis 'khyag gi sbugs su bcug /ri klung bzhur gyis gang tshe snang ba skyo/ /gtsang chab sngone mo dran dus yi mug/ skye/ /mtho dgung sngoni gyi klong nas g.yu 'brug ldir/ /dus rtag tu ldir ldir 'dra lags te/ /rgas nor bu shor nas mtsho nang lhung / /chu srin sdig can du 17

gyur tshe snang ba skyo/ /sngar gyi nga ro dran nas yi mug skye/ /bar spang ljongs kyi logs la ri dwags rtsen(3de)/ /dus rtag tu rtsed rtsed 'dra lags kyang / /las ngan khron pa yis dbang med zin/ /dug mdas lus srog phral tshe yi mug skye/ /spang ljongs gzhon nu dran nas mchi ma shor/ /dma' chu bo'i gzhung nas nya mo 'khyug /dus rtag tu myur myur 'dra lags te/ /lcags kyu snani po yis dbang med 'dzin/ /gnad gcod sdug bsngal myong dus snang ba skyo/ /gser mig yid 'ong dran dus yi mug skye/ /mi pho mo sha bkrag dkar dmar rgyas/ /dus rtag tu mdzes mdzes 'dra lags kyang / /'o( dang zla ba yis rim bzhin mnar/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal myong dus yi mug skye/ /mgo skyes dkar por gyur tshe snang ba skyo/ /gzhon lus yid 'ong dran dus mchi ma shor/ /snying du sdug pa'i mdza' grogs pho mo dang / /dus rtag tu 'grogs 'grogs 'dra lags kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rje yis dbang med phral/ /ro bordzog dur khrod du bskyal tshe snang ba skyo/ /gzhon grogs yid 'ong dran dus mchi ma shor/ /gnyen nye 'brel bza' tshang mthong dga' po/ /dus rtag tu gshib gzhib 'dra lags kyang / /gshin rje'i skyes bu yis dbang med phral/ /gcig pu bar dor 'gro tshe snang ba skyo/ /nye 'brel bza' tshang dran dus yi mug skye/ /'jigs skyag sdug bsngal myong dus mchi ma 18

shor/ /mi khas drag rdzos 'gror ldan pa tsho/ /dus rtag tu skyid skyid 'dra lags te/ /waṃn rje'i thag nag gis ske nas khrid/ /bar tso ltong ring gi mtha' la sgyur/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal myong dus yi mug skye/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid dran tshe snang ba skyo/ /ngan song sdug bsngal myong dus mchi ma shor/ /lar yul dang yul can gang gis kyang / /yid skyo ba'i pho nya nyid byas nas/ /nga 'do med kyi sprang po mañju'i ming / /gnas mi med kyi lung stong 'grim snying 'ar+pā/ /grogs 'dzol med kyi ri dwags dang 'grogs snying 'dod/ /zas sdig med kyi chu gtsang btung snying 'dod/ /sems dal med kyis 'chi bdag bsgug snying 'dod/ /lam 'khral med kyi rim gnyis bsgom ming 'ar+pā/ /sag r+pā med du myong ba'i sems ri ri mi (r+sha/// ༷///shā can kun/ /gnas bla med kyi sa la 'god snying 'dod/ /lar dgos med cig rgyud la ma skyes na/ /'di dgos dang 'di byed la 'grub dus med/ /byar med kyi ngang la ma bzhag na/ /'khor ba'i bya byed la thon dus med/ /rang thag cig rang gis ma bcad na/ /ngo srung dang mthun wīg la snyo dus med/ /khong daphro dang grogs mched sbyon bdag dang / /nye 'brel dang pha ma bu brgyud sogs/ /sems gzung bas zin pa nan tan dka'/ /de zin kyang bskyur nas 'gro rgyu yin/ /lar byis pa sus kyang chos gegs byed/ /dbang gzhan la ma bskur rang thag rdzo/ /19’

rang 'dod don mtha' ru ma phyin bar/ /phyi 'jig rten slu khrid ci byung yang / /'gyur med kyi dam bca' bstan par mdzod/ /ci bsam pa'i don de 'grub par nges/ /lus rkus nor bzhin du sbas te nyal/ /ngag lkugs pa bzhin du smra ba gcad/ /sems mi rtag 'chi ba rgyun du dran/ /mtho 'dod dang rang rtsis mi che ba/ /nyam chung byas la rang rgyud 'dul/ /phyi ltar snang gi chos par mi re ba/ /stosnag tu rang sems ci thul bya/ /mkhas 'dod kyi bshad yam mi mang ba /gdams ngag kun rang gi sems la 'chang / /gzhan skyodan la mi brtag rang skyod brtag /gzhan zer la mi nyan rang thag gcod/ /rang don la mi sems gzhan done sems/ /sems can resnas pa sna tshogs phyir/ /kun dang mthun pa dka' na yang / /byams pa'i mig gis blta bya zhing / /snyan pa'i tshig gis smra bar bya/ /chos pa mu ges mi 'chi bas/ /rnyasna 〈snas 'phral gyi 'tsho rkyen yang / /gang byung tsam gyis chog par bya/ /de ring ci byung gang byung byed/ /sang nyin mi 'chi gdeng med bsam/ /sang nyin ci byung gang byung byed/ /gnangs nyin mi 'chi gdeng med bsam/ /mi tshe ci 'khyol gang 'khyodal bya/ /bka' brgyud skusnang ma'i rnam thar dang / /jo bo bka' gdams dge bshes ltar/ /sdug rus zhe bcad chos la bya/ /lar snyigs ma'i skye bo dmu rgod la/ /phan par smras kyang log par 20

blta/ /lhag bsam bskyed kyang g.yo zol mthong / /mthun par 'grogs kyang dgra ru blta/ /kha rog bsdad kyang mi kha ldang / /don de phyir kho sdang skye nye bas/ /bzod pa'i go cha rtag tu bgo /byams snying rje'i sems la nan tan sbyong / /yang bdud rigs kyi pho nya slu 'drid mkhas/ /sngon goms kyi bag chags yun re ring / /'dod chags kyi zhen 'khris ngan shugs che/ /don de phyir 'dod chags skye nye bas/ /dran shes kyi me chen rtag tu spor/ /de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i ngang la gzhag /tshul khrims krishā mig dang bral sdi/ra na/ /sbyin sku1gas pha rol phyin gyur kyang / /mtho ris them skas yid 'ong la/ /'dzeg pa'i sgo skabs med pa'i phyir/ /dpral ba'i mig bzhin tshul khrims bsrung / /yang sesgo sku( skye bo'i 'dun pa ni/ /yud tsam gyis kyang 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /tshe stod 'dul 'dzin gyi mkhan po yang / /tshe smad bza' dgu'i pha ma byed/ /sngar lo chos bshad kyi stoni rtsen yang / /phyi lo ar jag gi 'go pa byed/ /tshe stod ri khrod kyi bya btang ya/nga / /tshe smad grong pa'i gsog 'jog rem/ /khar sang sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes la/ /de ring bdud ltar log lta byed/ /snga dro dad cing bstod pa la/ /phyi dro log lta skur 'debs byed/ /doni de phyir las 'bras khyad gsod dang / /darkani mchog la 'ordzog lta byed pa serdzogs/ /gti mug gi sgrib pa 'byung nye bas/ mosnas 21

gus dang dag snahwa na du bya/ 8sa rab kyi sgro me rtag tu spor/ /mdor na 'chi ba ma dran pa'i/ /dam chos ci dang gang byed kyang / /tshe 'di'i shom rar 'gro ba'i phyir/ /bya byed mang lo spros pa bskyung / /byar med ngang la dran rig bsdu/ /rang sems 'dul zhing rang rgyud chos dang bsre/ /chos kyi snying po kun rdzob smo dam gyi/ /byang chub sems gnyis bsgom la nan tan bya/ /'di brdzo dge bas khes rgyu'i ma rnams kyis/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /che ba gsum ldan go 'phang lo par shog /ces pa 'di'ang nyin mo dgra yi ca co med cing / mtshan mo lha 'dre'i klag sto med la/ mi bsrun skye tsho rgyu 'grul med pas ñju dzoḍū g.yeng ba ngang gis spong zhing chos brgyad shugs kyis 'gog pa'i gnas mtho la yangs pa/ rlung rig dwangs pas rnam rtog shugs kyis nyung ba/ sman ljongs nyams dga'i do rwar gur gum dang ut+pal la sogs pa'i me tog sna tshogs mdangs 'od rab tu bkra ba/ mdun gyi spang ljongs nyams dga' ba na ri dwags rna ba dang dgo ba la sogs pa bag phebs dal gyis rgyu bas snang stohrū ma'i zlos gar ci yang bsgyur ba/ bya gong mo dang 'jol mo la sogs pa spu sdug gi gos sngo pas mgrin pa'i sgra snyan ci yang brdung bas rna ba'i dbang dzo tsham par byed cing / stong pa'i nam mkha' la thabs shes kyi gzhog zung lding zhing mgrin pa'i sgra snyan ci yang bsgyur bas sgra rnams grag stong du lhang lhang 'a4 ba/ g.ya' chu dang gangs chu/ rdza chu sogs 'bab chu sna nga bu rnams rba ḍūr+ya' zhun ma ltar da nga dwangs la/ rtog rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / khrung khrung dang ngang pa la sogs pa chu bya sna tshogs kyis skad snyan sgrogs pa/ rab tu ā+o ba'i me tog gi skyid mos tshal na/ rkang drug ldan pa'i bung ba rnams za zi dar dir gyi glu len pas rna ba'i dbang tsho bdud rtsir gyur te rig pa ye shes kyi ngar 'tho pa/ mi ma yin dang lton gzan gyi rgyu 'grul mang bas 22

dus rtag tu sems tsha hob be/ yid skyo lhang nge bas brtson 'grus dang nges 'byung mos gus sogs dbang med du bskul ba/ lab grogs dang g.yeng rkyen nyung bas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba/ grong khyer gyi skye bo rnams kyis 'khrul snang 'bor ba'i las la dus rtag tu lang long g.yo zhing / ri de'i rtsa bar/ me tog rwa ba zhes bya ba'i skyed tshal nyams dga' ba na/ phyugs rdzi gzhoni nu rnams kyis mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin/ mi gtsang ba la gtsa0ri b.ru 'dzin/ mi bde ba la bde bar 'dzin/ bdag med pa la bdag tu 'dzin te/ dus rtag tu snang ba mtho yere/ glu len pa dang / bro brdung ba/ rtsed mo sna tshogs rtse ba sogs kyis rkyen byas nas snying rje shugs kyis 'byung / dus phal cher smug rlangs 'thibs shing nam mkha'atshodwangs la lho sprin 'gyur ldog mang zhing 'ja' tshoni sna lnga khra bun rner shar yang de ma thag gar song med par yal ba/ dgong mo grib so nag hob be khug pa dang / bya bye'u thams cad kyang gzhog sgra di ri tshang sgor bsnyegs shing / grong pa'i phyugs rdzi sogs kyang rnal 'byor pa dang je 'gyang dang / wa spyang rnams ngu zhing 'jag ma rnams shugs glu kyu re len tsa na/ thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin du go/ snying rje shugs kyis skyes/ brtsoni 'grus kyi lcag tu gyur te skyabs gnas dang bla ma dran/ mos gus kyi rtsal rgyas/ lta ba dang nyams len gyi bskul ma byed/ rig pa ye shes la ngar thon/ drod rtags kyi sa tshang zin/ rtogs pa'i gdeng rig nas gang la'ang zhen pa log ge sems skyo lhang nge / shes pa tsha ho— be/ mos gus kyi yid dung nge ba sogs dang / gzhan yang lho rlung dal gyi rgyu ba bying rmugs kyi gnyen por gyur cing / nyi zla 'char sgo yangs pas 'od gsal gyi ltad mo chi yang 'char te/ yul snang sgyu ma'i snang ba thams cad yul can rig stong rjen pa'i bogs 'don du 'gyur ba sogs dben pa'i yon to ma tshang ba med pas brgyan pa'i ri sul de na bag med du gcer nyal bye da pa'i tshe/ sems ma bcos lhug par bzhag pa'i 'char sgo la ji ltar byung ganges 'byung si gsal 'debs su smras pa/ phyis sprel lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang la zog po rlung khams langs pa'i lag rtsed du bris pa'o// ༈ /yang de skabs snang ba dgrar langs pa lta bu'i nyams shar ba'i tshe skyo glu 'di blangs so// kye ma kye hud las ngan bdag 'dra/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'gror mi lus thob ste/ /drin chen bla ma sangs rgyas mjal 23

zhing / /dben pa'i ri la bsgom khul byas kyang / /tshig ngan mtshone cha byung ma thag la/ /zhe sdang tsher ma zing lugs ltos dang / /gdong pa skya skya mthong ba'i mod la/ /'dode chags tsha bas gdung lugs ltos dang / /sgyu ma'i nor dang 'phrad ma thag la/ /brnab sems sprin nag long lugs ltos dang / /nangs par mi 'chi'i gdeng ni med kyang / /tshe 'di'i shom ra byed lugs ltos dang / /phyi ma mi 'jigs gdeng ni med kyang / /gti mug ro nyal byed lugs ltos dang / /mtho la phrag dog dman la nga rgyal/ /bstodi na dregs pa 'chang lugs ltos dang / /tshag sgra sgob sgra cung zad thos kyang / /sems ni de na rgyugs lugs stos dang / /lus tshugs bsgrims nas ba〉(ma khul byas kyang / /chos brgyad me ltar 'bar lugs ltos dang / /kye ma/ lus bem gog dben pa'i ri sul nyal/ /sems grong gseb khyi rkun bzhin du rgyu/ /kha 〈snang bshad nam mkha'i 'brug ltar ldir/ /nang nyoni resnangs serdzo skye phal las rags/ /mi gzhan la bshad rgyangs gdugs ltar phub/ /rang mi dge bcu la 'jol nyog spyod/ /phyi tshul 'chos lus ngag btson du 'dzin/ /nang ཿsnas brgyad shing skam me bzhin 'bar/ /tshur rang la bltas na yi mug skyes/ /pha bla ma mkhyen no thugs rjes gzigs/ /sprang chos brgyad zad par byin gyis rlor+shas/ /zhes dang // 7/ /bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin dang yon tan dran te bshes gnyen 24

bsten tshul gyi glu drang srong gi bden gtam zhes bya ba 'di'ang blangs so// na resna gu ru bh+yaḥ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bla ma bsten tshul 'di ltar bya/ /ba tshwa can gyi mdo sde las/ /ston pa 'jig rten mig nyid kyang / /dge ba'i bshes kyi tshul snang zhes/ /'dis kyang bla ma bsten par rigs/ tanas rab pha rol phyin las kyang / /rgyal ba'i chos rnams ma lus kun/ /dge ba'i bshes la bsten zhes gsungs/ /'dis kyang bla ma bsten par rigs/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i yoni tan kun/ /bla ma la ni rag las gsungs/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi nang na yang / /bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag zhes/ /yang yang bsngags pa mdzad la ྅(sa/ /'phags sod paṇa grub kyis bkral ba'i/ /snyan brgyud zab lngardzo rnams las kyang / /bla ma'i mos gus kho na yis/ /grol ba dbang po yang rab zhes/ /yang yang bsngags pa mdzad la stosnas/ /mdor na 'jigs rung 'kherdzor ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /ngan 'gro gdug pa'i rba rlabs g.yo ba las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon bshes gnyen gcig gyur pas/ /su zhig bla ma dam pa bsten mi byed/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor gtso bo nyid bzhengs nas/ /bu khyod he ru ka dpal nga yin gyi/ /nga yi bka' las nam yang ma 'da' zhes/ /tha tshig bsgrags shing rdo rje spyi sor bzhag /bdud rtsi lce la blud pa de dran na/ /blo ldan su zhig bla ma'i bka' las sne 25

'da'/ /gang zhig mnyes na sangs rgyas kun mnyes shing / /gal te ma mnyes rgyal kun thugs 'byin pa'i/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mchog /sems yodi su zhig bla ma'i thugs sun 'byin/ /bstode na mchog thun dngos grub kun 'byung zhing / /smad na rdo rje dmyal ba'i mes 'tshig pas/ /bde sdug kun gyi byed po bla ma ste/ /de la smod pa'i blo ldan su zhig yod/ /gang zhig mchod pas rgyal kun mchod 'gyur zhing / /mnyes na sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes 'gyur zhes/ /'khor 'das kun gyi 'byed po gcig gyur pa'i/ /dam pa de la su zhig mchod mi byed/ /dang por ma brtag pa la mos gus skyes/ /bar du dbang lung man ngag thams cad zhus/ /tha mar 'ordzog lta byas nas skur 'debs pa/ /de la bdud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa yin/ /dngos grub rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma las/ /dbang lung man ngag gdams zab kun nos nas/ /jica/tso bos ji bstsal bsgrub par khas blangs te/ /rnam pa du mas thugs sun 'byin byed pa'i/ /skye ngan de la bdud kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ /chos dang bla ma gcig spangs gcig la bsten/ /snga ma snga mar 'ordzog lta skur 'debs pas/ /phyi mar bzhugs kyang de yi byin rlabs dben/ /de dag bla ma 〈snang ba'i bdud las yin/ /rnam pa brgya yi bla ma'i thugs dkrugs shing / /nga rgyal dbang gis bla ma'i bka' bcag ste/ /bla 26

ma sa ci mdzad skyoni du mthong ba yi/ /dam nyams de la bdud kyi tshogs rnams dga'/ /bla mas drag zhan bdams shing a gsar che/ /bla mas nga la sdang zhing gzhan la brtse/ /bla ma mdzad spyodi ngan zhing sdom pa 'chore/ /bla mas nga la bka' brkyani thugs sdang che/ /zhes sogs bla ma'i skyoni la brtag byed pa'i/ /sdig can de la bla ma dgra ru langs/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa yin/ /bla mas mdzad spyodi bka' bskruni byung ba na/ /bla ma spyo 'dug bla ma 'di la ni/ /rgyal 'gong zhugs 'dug zer ba la sogs pa/ /rnam pa brgya yis bla ma smod cing gshe/ /gzhan dag smod la rjes su yi rang ba/ /de dag bla ma spong ba'i bdud tshig yin/ /dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma'i thugs dkrugs nas/ /chos gzhan dka' spyad snying rus che na yang / /chu shing bzhin du snying po med par 'gyel/ /nges par rdo rje dmyal ba'i me yis 'tshig /dang po bla ma brtag la mkhas pa dang / /bar du bla ma bsten la mkhas pa dang / /tha ma mdzad khyodad bslab la mkhas pa yi/ /blosna ldan mchog de bdud kyi dbang mi 'gro/ /dang po dmya pa btsal nas zab chos zhus/ /bar du mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog bsgrubs/ /tha mar ci mdzad legs mthong mdzad spyod slob/ /skyes bu de la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /ci mdzad legs par mthong zhing rnam thar skyong / /ci gsungs tshad mar go nas bka' 27

bzhin sgrub/ /ci dgongs ye shes shes nas thugs yid bsre/ /de la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa yin/ /skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor mthong / /dge sbyor thams cad bla ma'i lam du shes/ /'khor 'das thams cad bla ma'i rnam rol 'char/ /cir snang ci shar bla ma'i gseng lam dang / /bde sdug kun gyi byed po bla mar shes/ /dag pa'i snang bas rtag tu dus 'da' ba/ /e ma gang zag dbang po yang rab mchog /bdud rnams bye bas de la glags mi rnyed/ /bla mar mchod cing bla mar bstod pa dang / /bla mar bkur sti bla mar rim gro byed/ /bla ma'i g.yog dang bla ma'i bya ba sgrub/ /bla ma'i 'bor dang bla ma'i gnyen sogs dang / /bla ma'i grib ma tshun la'ang gus byed cing / /bla mar smod dang bla mar sdang ba yi/ /dam nyams de dang lta spyodad gtam mi bsre/ /bla ma'i bka' las nam yang mi 'da' zhing / /bla mas ci mdzad legs par mthong ba yi/ /skal ldan mchog der bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs/ /bdud dang bdud kyi rigs rnams pham par byed/ /chos gzhan ma ṇi skyo1 gcig ma 'done rung / /rtag par bla ma dran zhing cir snang kun/ /bla ma'i rnam rol shes pa'i dag snang gis/ /snying nas dad pas gsol 'debs 'o dod 'bod/ /bla ma mchod phyir rang gi sha khrag lus/ /dum bur gtubs kyang mi tshim bla ma ni/ /skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus par thag 28

chod nas/ /mig nas mchi ma 'bab cing ba spu ldang / /nyin mtshan mnyam rjes dus rnams thams cad du/ /bla ma ma gtogs bsam rgyu gzhan med pa/ /51sa gus phyag rgya chen pos yid myos pa'i/ /gang zag de ni dbang po yang rab ste/ /nges par bdud kyi sde rnams pham byas nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal sa 'thob par 'gyur/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can kun/ /rgyal bu/ nor bzang rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /yoni tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma mnyes byas te/ /'gro kun bla ma'i lam gyis grol bar 31ga ṣes dang // 7/ /zla ba bcu tsog pa'i tshes bcu nyin nged rang gi khu bo dam pa de'i dus mchod la rje dam pa de dran nas gsol 'debs kyi glu sgrub brtson dam pa blo gros mkhyen rab kyi nang gi rnam thar la bsngags pa dran pas snying gi gdung sel zhesi bya ba 'di blangs so// 65 rder+sha/ dal 'dresar rdo rje'i lus bzang bsil sbyin gyi dbang po/ /sngon smon rnam par dkar ba'i shing rta la chibs te/ /skyo shas nges 'byung drag po'i dri bzhon gyis bskul nas/ /rgyal bstan lha lam ngos su rtsen pa la 'dud do/ /ris med mkhas grub dam pa'i rnam thar la dgongs te/ /bzod med dad pa'i 'od stong lam lam du chas pas/ /don med sgro skur chu 'dzin rang ngo ru grol te/ /phyogs med gdams pa rgya mtsho'i snang ba la spyod pa'i/ /ris med mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i gces phrug la 'dud do/ /'du 'dzi khyim pa'i 'tsho ba zhen log gis ldog cing / /dus min snyan grags bdud kyi pho 29

nya ru mthong nas/ /nyam chung ri sul nyul ba'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i/ /bya dang ri dwags gasmo nu'i skyo grogasatshol 'dud do/ /bcos min snying rje chen i dri bzhes gyis bskul nas/ /lta ba mtha' bzhi ྅rtos bral mkha' dbyings la baspyodad cing / /sgom pa thobs shes zung 'jug gzhog zung gis mdzes te/ /spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gags med spu sdug gis brgyan pa'i/ /'od gsal dbu ma chen po'i rnal 'gror la 'dud do/ /blos byas tshig gi phreng ba rang ngo ru grol zhing / /yid byed spros pa'i drwa ba dbu ma ru zhig ste/ /blo 'das dbyer med gnyug ma'i nam mkha' la rol pa'i/ /zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'gror la 'dud do/ /ka dag stong chen gzhon nu'i bum sku yi rang mdangs/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid/ /chos nyid mngon sum 'ja' tshon thig le yi klong yangs/ /nyams snang gong 'phel lam rtags mngon sum du thon pa'i/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'gror la 'dud do/ /tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yi bdud rtsi la spyad pas/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal rtags lnga khor yug tu 'char zhing / /rim gnyis rnal 'gror zab mo'i brtan pa cher thob ste/ /mkhyen rab 'jam mgoni brgyud pa'i thugs bcud kyi snying po/ /'khor 'das dbyer med chos sku'i rnal 'gror la 'dud do/ /nyin snang chos kun dbyengs kyi ltad mo ru mthong 30 —

zhing / /mtshan dus 'od gsal mdzes mas 'bral med du 'khyud pas/ /kherdzor yug 'od gsal chos sku'i snang ba yis speg pa'i/ /zeb lam ni gu'i chos drug rnal 'gror la 'dud do/ /sku tshe hril por mi med ri sul du bsnyegs pas/ /bdag 'dzin ltar snang shar ba'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre/ /bdag med shes rab yum gyi mkha' dbyings su bcad pas/ /tshar stsortong rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad pha mtha' ru son pa'i/ /re dwogs gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug /zhi byed gcod yul brgyud pa'i rnal 'gyor la 'dud do/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'gror la brtson pas/ /'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma'i stong gzugs su 'char te/ /sor bsam rjes dran lam gyi yod tan dang ldan pa/ /dus 'khor 61 rgyan bsnyen sgrub rnal 'gror la 'dud do/ /'dir snang gzugs sku zhi ba chos dbyings su bsdu tshe/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i ngar sgra chen po rang sgrogs shing / /snying stan+t+ral sba bar 'os pa'i gsang gtam dang bcas te/ /sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i me tog gi char dang / /lnga ldan bkra ba'i 'ja' gur mthun snang du 'char zhing / /sku gdung ring bsrel dad pa'i sa bon du bzhag sogs/ /ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rang bzhin la 'dud do/ /mdo rgyud brgya phrag 'chad pa'i stod chen gyi mkhas pa/ /kun gyis gtsug na bkur ba'i grags ldan gyi bla chen/ /dam pa'i drin gyis 31

ma zin blun 〉snam gyi 〉sgom chen/ /rang sems gnad du bkug nas ma bsgoms pa phal cher/ /'dus byas rang mtshang stoni tshe tha mal pa'i rnam pa/ /de phyir bya byed mang po'i spros pa kun bzhag la/ /rtse gcig brtson pa drag pos rig stong gi ye shes/ /gnyug mar brdar sha chod par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /ces pa'o// 7/ /jo rgan ma karmas bskul ngor glu blangs pa ni/ kye ho 'di na dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes phung po gcig tu 'dus pa'i gzugs/ /bka' drin mnyam med drin chen mkhyen sprul pa/ /chos kyi blo 〈snas zhabs la phyag byas nas/ /phan pa'i gdams pa cung zad khyod la sbyin/ /'di na dal brgyad 'gyor bcu'i lus thob nas/ /yang dag bstan dang mjal zhing dam pas zin/ /gakhrig tu snying po'i sgrub la gzhol khul yang / /tshe la 'ordzong med 'chi ba ma dran na/ /phal cher tshe 'di'i shom rar 'gro ba'i phyir/ /nam 'chi nges med sgoms shig rnal 'gyor ma/ /dal 'gror 'di ni shin tu phan che zhing / /yang yang rnyed dka' u dum wa ra 'dra/ /da lta snying po longs shig rnal 'gror ma/ /'khor ba 'di ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal zhing / /mi rtag g.yo ba glog gi zlos gar dang / /srin mo'i gling dang mi gtsang gzeb 'dra bas/ /skyo shas nges 'byung skyed cig rnal 'gyor ma/ /gnam sa 'gre log mi srid dgu srid kyang / /dge sdig las kyi 'bras bu bslu mi srid/ /blang 32

dor tshul bzhin gyis shig rnal 'gror ma/ /dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa'i snying poni/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis las gzhan med pas/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems gnyis dang / /rgyal sras rnam thar skyongs shig rnal 'gror ma/ /dbang bzhis ma smin lam bzhi bsgom pa ni/ /bye ma btsir yang mar mi 'byung de bzhin/ /sngags kyi dngos grub gang yang mi thobe pas/ /dbang bzhis smin par gyis shig rnal 'gyor ma/ /bla ma ma bsten 'o(nga ba thang 'khyams 'dra/ /lam mkhan bla ma sten cig rnal 'gror ma/ /bsags sbyangs ma byas ting 'dzin mi 'char bas/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong 'bungs shig rnal 'gror ma/ /mos gus med na byin rlabs mi 'jug pas/ /bla mar mos gus rems shigarnal 'byor ma/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mkhas byas kyang / /mthar thug rtogs bya rang sems las gzhan med/ /rang sems rtsa ba chod cig rnal 'gror ma/ /sems ngo sprad tshul mi 'dra mang na yang / /rig pa kher ded zab bo rnal 'gror ma/ /bskyed rim ma bsgoms gzugs sku mi thob pas/ /snang stong lha sku sgoms shig rnal 'gror ma/ /rdzogs rim ma rtogs chos sku mi thob pas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'gror sgoms shig rnal 'gror ma/ /ci ste tshe 'dir brtan pa ma thob na/ /'pho ba bar do'i gdams pa gnad che bas/ /dal dus grabs su tshud cig rnal 'gror ma/ /33

nyin snang sgyu ma rdo rje lta bur brtan/ /rmi lam 'od gsal snying gi grogs dang 'dris/ /'chi ba'i g.yang du lhung yang mi 'grod pa'i/ /rnam gsum dran pa sbyongs shig rnal 'gror ma/ /nyi zla'i 'gros dang sbal ba'i bang bzhin du/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam yang myur bul che/ /myur lam rdo rje theg pa'i zab gnad ni/ /rtsa thig rlung dang sems la bsnun pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i gseng lam sgoms shig rnal 'gror ma/ /dben pa'i ri sul mnyam bzhag bgyid do zhes/ /gzhan gyi mig sngar pho tshugs bzang na yang / /brtags na rang sems chos dang ma 'dres na/ /chos pa gsha' ma'i dri yang mi bro bas/ /chos dang rang rgyud sres shig rnal 'gyor ma/ /bya byed byis pa'i rtsed mor zin dus med/ /byar med gnas lugs skyongs shig rnal 'gror ma/ /'dod yon lan tshwa'i chu yis ngoms dus med/ /'don chung chog shes sten cig rnal 'gyor ma/ /skye shi'i sdug bsngal gzeb las thar dus med/ /skye med pha mkhar zungs shig rnal 'gyor ma/ /gzhan don snying rje'i gnad la rag las pas/ /bdag pas gzhan gces 〉(mas shig rnal 'byor ma/ /'dus byas dge ba rkyen gyis bzhig nges pas/ /bsngo sgror+sha rnam dag mdzod cig rnal 'gror ma/ /gang khyod gcig tu dge ba'i ngang tshul yang / /gangs kyi ri la nyi 'od phog pa bzhin/ /'di brjod pa las slar yang rtogs pa yis/ /yon 34

tan yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni nyams rtogs kyi pad+mo kha bye ba'i rang spol gyi rnal 'gror ma karma mtshos bskul ngor gdams pa'o// 7/ /'di lo gsor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la sbyangs pas/ 'di sgom gyi dmigs gtad med pa/ ma bsgoms kyang basmyur rgyu med pa/ rig pa har song rjen pa/ mnyam rjes thams cad du 'bral mi shes pa 'dra ba byung ba'i tshe/ dran bskul gyi glu blangs pa ni/ 65 ho/ yid dran pa nyag gcig gi bla ma la/ /don dran pa yengs med kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dran pa 'grong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /he he/ da ltos dang ltos dang rnal 'gyor pa/ /bltas pa thams cad mthong bar 'dug /ma bltas bsdad pas cang mi mthong / /dang po rang gi sgo gsum ltos/ /dge sdig gang la gnas 'dug ltos/ /dran rig sna tshogs 'di la ltos/ /kun slong bzang ngan gang 'dug ltos/ /khang zhing nor rdzas sogs la ltos/ /rtag pa snying po e 'dug ltos/ /bde skyid ldan pa'i phyug por ltos/ /rtag tu de 'dra e 'dug ltos/ /mnga' thang ldan pa'i dpon por ltos/ /nyams pa med pa e 'dug ltos/ /mdzes sdug ldan pa'i dga' mar ltos/ /lang tshor rtag pa e 'dug stosnas/ /chu la ri mo bris nas ltos/ /bya byed thams cad de dang 'dra/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi grong khyer ltos/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba de dang 'dra/ /yang de snga shi ba'i mi la ltos/ 8 nas mthob rgyu e 'dug ltos/ /da lta yode pa'i mi la stos/ /mi 'chi gcig kyang e 'dug ltos/ /ma 'ongs 'byung rgyu'i mi la ltos/ /skyes nas snedi dbang e 35

'dug stosnas/ /yang de snga byas pa'i las la stosnas/ /byas pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal ltos/ /da lta byed bzhin las la ltos/ /'bad par snying po ci 'dug ltos/ /ma 'ongs byed rgyu'i las la ltos/ /'grub pa'i nges pa e 'dug ltos/ /lho sprin nam yong cha med stos/ /rkyen ngan bar chad de dang 'dra/ /glog 'gyus skad cig snang bar stosnas/ /sgyu lus mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /rlung gseb gnas pa'i mar mer stos/ /sems ni yode la med de 'dra/ /la kha'i na bun yer la stosnas/ /dbugs kyang yod la med de 'dra/ /chu nang shar ba'i zla gzugs ltos/ /snang ba snang stong de dang 'dra/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltos/ /'dod yoni lnga po de dang 'dra/ /mdang sum nyal ba'i rmi lam ltos/ /dgra gnyen thams cad de dang 'dra/ /rmi lam khang bzang nyams dga' na/ /mosna gsham bu mo mdzes ma zhig /'ja' tshon stone pa'i gos groni zhing / /chu zla'i bzhin ras mdzes pa la/ /nam mkha' me tog rna rgyan btags/ /ri bong rwa yi skas la bgrode/ / rus sbal spu yi snam bu 'thag /smig rgyu'i chu rgyun btung bzhin du/ /dri za'i grong khyer sgo 'khrab ste/ /brag ca'i sgra yi glu len bzhin/ /sgyu ma'i skyes pa bslu la stosnas/ /'dir snang thams cad de dang 'dra/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshoran shar la ltos/ /mdzes dang mi mdzes de dang 'dra/ /brag la bos nas brag car ltos/ /36

snyan dang mi snyan de dang 'dra/ /mkha' la bya lam rjes med stosnas/ /sems kyi 'gyu ba de dang 'dra/ /dri med shel gong dwangs pa dang / /gzugs med dbang po'i gzhu ris dang / /dngos med nam mkha'i dbyengs la stos/ /rnal 'gror rig pa de dang 'dra/ /rkyen dang bral ba'i mar mer ltos/ /gsal la rtog med de dang 'dra/ /gzhon nu ma yi bde bar ltos/ /bde yang stong pa de dang 'dra/ /bu chung lha khang mjal la ltos/ /snang ba ban bun ngos bzung med/ /smyon pas zlos gar rtse la ltos/ /zang thal rig pa gtad serdzo med/ /rba rlabs zhi ba'i rgya mchor stosnas/ /dwangs la g.yo med de dang 'dra/ /mtsho la gza' skar 'char bar ltos/ /rtog med rig pa'i rgya madz+nyo la/ /chogs drug gza' skar de ltar bkra/ /a ho/ yar stos dang nam mkha' la skye 'gag med/ /tshur rnyasnas dang sems nyid la skye 'gag med/ /skye 'gag med pa'i sems nyid las/ /skye dang 'jig pa'i cho 'phrul snang / /snang bzhin med la med bzhin snang / /skusgod kyang yod la med kyang med/ /rten 'brel chos la gad mo 'chor/ /yar ltos dang nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med/ /tshur stosnas dang sems nyid la mtha' dbus med/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i sems nyid la/ /phyogs mtshams mtha' dbus sna tshorags 'char/ /de 'char yang ngo bo la mtha' dngus med/ /'di bden yad bden la rdzun yang 37

rdzun/ /yin yang yin la min yang min/ /bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs 'di rgod re bro/ /yar stos dang nam mkha' la 'gro 'ong med/ /tshur ltos dang sems nyid la 'gro 'ong med/ /'gro 'ong med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /khams gsum rigs drug gi grong du 'khore/ /de 'bor kyang rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /gsor 'das gnyis chos kyi dbyings su 'dres/ /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba yin/ /grol yang grol la 'bor yang 'khor/ /ma grol mi gsor grol re shi/ /ha ha/ spyon pa'i tshig la gtad so med/ /rnal 'gror rig pa la ngos bzung med/ /snang ba ban bun la bzakha gtad med/ /cir snang sgyu ma la ngos bzung med/ /gang shar chos sku la bzang ngan med/ /yar stosnas dang nam mkha' la ngos bzung med/ /tshur ltos dang sems nyid la ngos bzung med/ /ngos bzung med pa'i sems nyid las/ /gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog grangs med 'char/ /de 'char yang ngo bo la 'pho 'gyur med/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i rig pa de/ /gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po yin/ /yar ltos dang nam mkha' ma skye 'chi med/ /tshur ltos dang sems nyid la skye 'chi med/ /skye 'chi med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /skye 'chi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying / /de bying yang ngo bo la bcing grol med/ /bcing grol med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /chos sku gzhir gnas kyi sangs rgyas yin/ /38

yar ltos dang nam mkha' la dngos po med/ /tshur stos dang sems nyid la dngos po med/ /dngos po med pa'i sems nyid la/ /dkar dmar gyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char/ /de 'char yang ngo bo la 'char nub med/ /med bzhin snang ba ngo mtshar che/ /snang bzhin med pa dgod re bro/ /snang stong brjod du med pa 'di/ /gnyis/ su med pa'i lta ba yin/ /yar ltos dang nyi zla la gsal 'grib med/ /tshur stos dang sems nyid la gsal 'grib med/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i sems nyid las/ /bde sdug gi cho 'phrul ci yang snang / /de snang yang ngo bo la bde sdug med/ /bde sdug med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /mnyam nyid lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin/ /phar ltos dang ri bo la g.yo 'gul med/ /tshur ltos dang sems nyid la g.yo 'gul med/ /g.yo 'gul med pa'i sems nyid la/ /rtog tshogs kyi g.yo 'gul bsam mi khyab/ /de g.yos kyang rang shar rang gis grol/ khor ya nga shar la grol yang grol/ khar ma myong la grol ma myong / khor le grol le dus mnyam 'di/ /rnam rtog rang grol gyi lta ba yin/ /mar ltos dang chu bo la rgyun chad med/ /tshur ltos dang rang rig la rgyun chad med/ /rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa 'di/ /'khrul snang 'dzoms pa'i sag rdar yin/ /bsgom ma myong la yengs ma myong / /'khrul ma myong la grol ma myong / /'khrul pa med pa'i sems nyid 39

las/ /'khor 'das kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'gyed/ /de 'gyed kyang don la med pa la/ /gang zhig 'khor te gang du 'khor/ /su zhig grol te ci yis grol/ /gang du 'dug ste gang nas 'ong / /ci zhig bde ste ci yis bde/ /gang zhig skye ste su zhig 'chi/ /brtags na khams gsum 'khor ba 'di/ /nam mkha'i me tog ji bzhin du/ /rtag tu ma bcing ma grerdzol ba'o/ /ha ha snang srid 'khrul pa ru 'ordzog pas/ /malus sems kyi gtad so har ma hor/ /nga ni su yin khyodi cag ci zhig yin/ /a/ mthong med mthong ba chen por ltos/ /dbu ma chen po de la zer/ /bcos med sems la yengs med ltos/ /phyag rgya chen po de la zer/ /nang gsal ka dag 〈snang 'grums nas/ /phyi gsal thode rgas dbyings la stothos/ /rdzogs pa chen po de la zer/ /cir snang thams cad chos sku'i zhing / /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du stos/ /'khor 'das dbyer med de la zer/ /rang gi sems la rang gis ltos/ lta ba bya ba de la zer/ /de la rgyun du ma yengs ltos/ /sgom pa bya ba de la zer/ /de nyid spyod lam kun dang bsre/ /spyod pa bya ba de la zer/ /tha mal shes pa rang ga ma/ /rgyun du dran pas rang so bzung / /sems ngo skyong ba de la zer/ /gang shar bzo bcos med par bltos/ khor grol dus mnyam de la zer/ /snang srid lha dang lha mor stos/ /lha dang rang sems dbyer med stos/ /40

bskyed rim bsgom pa de la zer/ /rlung sems snang ba ngh+ru tir bcings/ /thams cad ye shes chen pone+e stos/ /rdzogs rim bsgom pa de la zer/ /lar dal 'gror rnyed pa dka' bar ltos/ /rnyed bya rnyed byed med par stos/ /nam 'chi nges pa med par stosnas/ /na rgyu 'chi rgyu med par stosnas/ /'khosgor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin ltos/ /'khor bya 'khor byed med par ltos/ /las 'bras bslu ba med par stos/ /dge sdig rgyu 'bras med par ltos/ /'gro kun pha ma drin chen ltos/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su med par stotes/ /re 'ga' nam mkha'i dbyings la ltos/ /rig pa rjen par 'char ba yin/ /re 'ga' nyi zla'i zer la ltos/ /'od gsal 'char sgo yangs pa yin/ /re 'ga' ri bo'i rtse la ltos/ /nyams kyi rtsed mo rtse ba yin/ /re 'ga' chu nang zla bar ltos/ /cir snang sgyu mar 'char ba yin/ /re 'ga' rang gi sgo gsum ltos/ /rang snang rang ngo shes pa yin/ /rang gzhan gnyis su med par stosnas/ /snang ba sems su shes pa yin/ /rtag tu rang gi sems la stosnas/ /'khrul snang myur du 'jigs pa yin/ /re 'ga' bka' dang bstan bcos ltos/ /the tshom gol sa sel ba yin/ /gcig pur sdode tshe sems la ltos/ /mang po'i nang nas ngag la ltos/ /gang snang sgyu ma rmi lam ltos/ /cir snang chos sku'i yo lang ltos/ /de ltar sems la bltas bltas pas/ /nam 41

mkhar bltas shing bltas pa na/ /mthong ba'i dngos po mi dmigs ltar/ /lta ngan kun las rang grol nas/ /gsal stong zung 'jug sems kyi gsang / /chos nyid gnad kyis 'char ba yin/ /blos btags bsgoms pas 'di mi mthong / /byin rlabs lam la 'char ba yin/ /mosnas gus can gyi rtogs bya yin/ /kha 'byams rtog ges phyogs mi shes/ /ha ha/ ltos zhes bya ba ci la blta/ /bltas pas mtherdzong na ci 'dra mthong / /blta rgyu byung na lta ba min/ /dngos yo mthong ngam dngos med mthong / /gsal ba mthong ngam stong pa mthong / /snang ba mthong ngam mun pa mthong / /brtags na nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /blta bya lta byed gnyis med pas/ /ci la lta ste su yis blta/ /ci zhig mthong ste su yis mthong / /gsal ba ci gsal stong pa ci/ /ci zhig bsgom ste su yis bsgom/ /spyod pa ci spyod 'bras bu ci/ /sems ni gang yin snang ba gang / /'das pa'i snang ba gang du song / /ma 'ongs snang ba gang nas 'ong / /da lta'i snang ba ngos bzung ci/ /mdang sum rmi lam snang ba de/ /da lta med pa gang du song / /da lta'i snang ba sna mogs 'di/ /rmi lam dus med ci zhig yin/ /rnal 'gyor nyams kyi snang ba la/ /lha dang ye shes 'char ba'i tshe da lta'i snang ba gang du serdzong / /brtags na khams gsum 'khor ba 'di/ /lngardzo gsham 41rwape

bu mo'i rjes su 'gro/ /ha ha/ nam mkha' spar mos btab pas ci zhig zin/ /mkha' la mdud pa bor bas su zhig 'ching / /rmi lam nyo tshong 'grim pa'i da〈snas pa ci/ /sgyu ma'i bud med bsten pa'i 'dod pa gang / /nam mkhas nam mkha' glags skabs rnyed dam ci/ /sgyu mas sgyu ma bslu bar nus sam ci/ /lar 'dod skutshen sgyu ma'i ltad resna 'dra/ /grub mtha' nam mkha'i bya rjes 'dra/ /bde sdug mtshan mo'i rmi lam 'dra/ /lta ba ci lta sgom pa ci/ /spyod pa dam tshig 'bras bu ci/ /kun btags snang ba 'ud po che/ /smig rgyu'i chu yis ri dwags bzhin/ / med bzhin mgo bo skor skor nas/ /'khrul snang gsor ba'i grong 'dir 'khor/ / da bla ma'i drin gyis bya btang bas/ /blo'i rdzun phug chos kyi dbyings su rdib/ /lar dngos po bsgoms na rtag pa'i mtha'/ /dngos med bsgoms na chad pa'i blo/ /gnyis dang gnyis min spros pa'i mtha'/ /da ni bsgoms kyang ma shes so/ /yod par 'dzin na thar pa med/ /med par 'dzin na mtho ris med/ /gnyis dang gnyis min log pa'i blo/ /da ni lta yang ma shes so/ /log par spyad na ngan 'gror ltung / /dge ba spyad kyang mtshan ma'i chos/ /mo gzham bu mo'i 'ching bag bzhin/ /spyod pa spyad rgyu ma rnyed do/ /ji ltar bsams kyang mtshan ma'i chos/ /ma ba〉(mas bsdad na tha mal ba/ /da ni sems kyang ma shes serdzo/ /43 rī

tshig tu brjod na spros pa 'phel/ /ma brjod bsdad na don mi go /blo 'das smra bsam brjod med dang / /gsal stong bde stong rig stong sogs/ /ji ltar brjod kyang thog mi khel/ /su yis brjod de ci zhig brjod/ /su la brjod de su yis go /da ni brjod kyang ma shes so/ /snang srid 'grul pa ru 'ordzog pas/ /kha rog rgya yan gtad so med/ /brjod ma shes la bsam ma shes/ /snga phyi 'gro 'ong yode med rtag chad sogs/ /thams cad gtad so med pa har ma hor/ /la las phyag chen la las rdzogs chen zer/ /la las dbu ma la las gzhan stong 'dod/ /ngas ni grub mtha' gang yang ma dmigs sku(/ /la las gsal stso(nga la las rig stong zer/ /la las spros bral la las ka dag zer/ /ngas ni gang yang 'dzin pa ma rnyed do/ /la las bskyed rim la las rdzogs rim zer/ /la las sems kyi ngo bo skyong zhes zer/ /ngas ni bsgoms rung ci yang ma rnyed do/ /la las tshong byed la las sem nam byed/ /la las gnas bske(ra la las dka' ba spyad/ /ngas ni spyad rgyu ci yang ma rnyed do/ /la las lha mchod la las 'dre bskrad de/ /ngas ni lha 'dre gang yang ma dmigs so/ /la las gnyen spyodang la las dgra 'dul zer/ /ngas ni dgra gnyen gang yang ma dmigs serdzo/ /la las chos byed la las sdig pa byed/ /ngas ni dge sdig gang yang ma dmigs so/ /la las nga zer la las khyodi 44

ces zer/ /ngas ni nga khyod gang yang ma dmigs so/ /'di ni khyab par brdal ba'i thang tshen du/ /rig pa dus gsum 'gyur med ri bo'i spor/ /snang srid sgyu mar rol pa'i sgrub khang du/ /rang byung spros pa bral ba'i rnal 'gror zhes/ /sna tshogs gnyis su med pa'i mtshams bsdams tshe/ /sems nyid dbyings kyi ma las rang shar ba'i/ /sems byung rig pa'i khye'us nga la gdams/ /'di ni rang gi rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag ste/ /sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i drin chen bla ma la/ /byin rlabs rtogs pa zhu ba'i maṇ+ḍal yin/ /rig pa gnyer mthong stoni pa'i bla ma la/ /gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrod pa'i rtogs 'bul yin/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i dpal ldan bla ma la/ /nyams smyu1nga brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i dpa' skad yin/ /mchogo thun dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam la/ /bskyed rdzogs srog rtsa zin pa'i nyams dgrangs yin/ /phrin las sgrub pa'i gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'du zhing rtse dga' byed pa'i dga' stoni yin/ /bar chad sel ba'i chos srung dam can rnams/ /labul med rgyun du 'aspogs pa'i blo rdo yin/ /nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas pa'i sgom chen la/ /rang nyams gsal 'debs byed pa'i me long yin/ /nyams rtogs nyag nyug byed pa'i sgom phrug (5/ /rtogs pa'i dpa' tshan bskyed pa'i ngar chu yin/ /thos chung snying rus can gyi gang zag la/ /the tshom drwa ba gcod pa'i 45

ral gri yin/ /stong lta 'ud snyobo mkhan gyi sgom chen la/ /nga rgyal brag ri bsnyil ba'i tho ba yin/ /blun sgom mun pa spel ba'i sgom chen la/ /nyams rtogs snang ba gsal ba'i sgroni me yin/ /mi tshe bshad pas g.yeng ba'i stoni chen la/ /nyams len sgom la skul ba'i lcag tshan yin/ /'di ni :ni pas mu cor smras pa ste/ /sur yang bzod pa mi gsol lo/ /bzod gsol phul ba'i yon ma rnyed/ /dge bas nang gi de bzhin nyid/ khes rab mig gis mthong bar shog /ces kyang sems kyi rtsal las byung pa'o// lco/ /yang 'di skabs shig chos la bskul ba'i glu nges 'byung gi pho nya zhes bya ba 'di blangs so// a ho/ rang snang rnam par dag pa 'og min gyi zhing khams/ /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dga' tshal gyi dbus na/ /nga yi skyabs gcig drin chen bla ma de bzhugs yod/ /byin rlabs char chen phob dang 'khor lo yi maspon po/ /na mnyam sems mthun sdeb pa'i gzhon nu tsho/ /glu dgrangs rtsed 'jo byed‘pas snang ba bde/ /rgyan gos gzab 'chor mig sngar mdzes lags kyang / /'u cag 'kherdzor bar yerdzod pa ma shes sam/ /'kherdzor ba sdug bsngal yin pa ma shes sam/ /dal 'gror stong log byas na mi 'grod dam/ /gzhon tshe lha chos byas na mi drag gam/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang a ma'i gces phrug tsho/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang na mnyam sems mthun tsho/ kho bkrag dkar 46

dmar rgyas pa'i gzhon nu tsho/ /sgyu lus stoni ka'i me tog rgyas lags te/ /me tog sad kyis khyer ba ma mthong ngam/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mi shes sam/ /pha ma rgas 'a〈snags gnas tshul ma mthong ngam/ /'chi bdag gshin rje byung na mi skrag gam/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang gzhon nu snying med po/ /bsam blo legs po 'i/ga thong dang skye bo ngang ring po/ /mi tshe g.yeng bas bslus pa'i rgan 'khogs mo/ /tshe gang don med 'da' ba ma shes sam/ /'khor bar snying po ci 'dug ma go 'am/ /mgo skyes dkar por song ba ma tshor ram/ /dal 'gyor stong log byas na mi 'grod dam/ /gcig pu bar dor 'gro dus mi skrag gam/ /dam chos rgyags phye bsgrub na mi dga' 'am/ /dben pa'i ri sul bsnyeg pa mi drag gam/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang pha ma rgan 'khogs tsho/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang a ma snying med ma/ /bde skyid longs spyod ldan pa'i phyug po tsho/ /kun gyis gtsug na bkur bas snang ba mtho/ /longs spyod stobs 'byor ldan pas spro lags te/ /longs spyod sgyu ma yin pa ma shes sam/ /gcer bu lag stong 'gro tshe mi 'gyod dam/ /sbyon pa'i rgyags phye bsgrub na mi drag gam/ /bya byed 'phro la bzhag na mi dga' 'am/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang 'khrul pa'i khol po tsho/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang phyug po ser sna 47

can/ /btsan drag mnga' thang ldan pa'i dpon po tshe/ /kun gyis gtsug na bkur bas snang ba 'ur/ /sdig gos lu gu'i tshar slog lus la 'jam/ /sdig zas sha chang spyod pa spro lags kyang / /gshin rje'i pho nya byung na mi skrag gam/ /gcer bu dur khrod bor tshe mi 'gyod dam/ /gzhan nor hab kyis za ba phod lags sam/ /lcags bsregs tho lum za ba phod lags sam/ /gzhan nor lcags bsregs yin pa ma shes sam/ /phyi ma rang lus 'tshig par mi skrag gam/ /nyam chung rang mgo 'done na mi dga' 'am/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang dpon dga' tshar slog can/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang dmya/la ba'i bud shing dag /nyes med ri dwags gsode pa'i rjon pa tsho/ /tshe 'di yud tsam yin pa ma shes sam/ /pha ma gsesgon bsad byed pa phod lags sam/ /'grerdzo kun pha ma yin pa ma shes sam/ /bsdus 'joms ri bos btsir na mi skyag gam/ /byang sems rgyud la bsten na mi legs sam/ /bdag 'dzin ri dwags gsad na mi dga' 'am/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang las ngan rjon pa tsho/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang col chung snying med po/ /ngur sgrig rgyal gyis mdzes pa'i btsun pa tsho/ /sku tshe tshong la dril bas snang ba mtho/ /dad zas bag med zos pas lang tsho rgyas/ /chang dang bud med bsten tshe snang ba 'ur/ /'chi bdag drung na slebs pa 48

ma shes sam/ /rang mgo mos kyis 'don na mi legs sam/ /tshong gis sdom kun zhig pa ma shes sam/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang stoni pa'i rjes 'jugatshe/ /blo skyed gzha' ma zhig thong dang dad pa'i zhing sa tsho/ /gser zhwa rta lham ldan pa'i bla chen tsho/ /kun gyis bkur zhing mchod pas snang ba mtho/ /dkor zas dug chus sku lus rgyas lags te/ /phyi mar rang lus tshab ((6)tshe mi 'grod dam/ /dug chu khol ma 'thung ba phode lags sam/ /daskasnar zas dug chu yin pa ma shes sam/ /lkog tu rang sems 'dul na mi dga' 'am/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang kun gyi bla ma tsho/ /blo skyed gzha' ma zhig thong dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sbo/ /ri khrod dben par sgom pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /bgamed gcer nyal byed pas snang ba bde/ /'chi bdag bdud po 'ong ba ma shes sam/ khye gcig bsam gtan bsgom pa mi drag gam/ /bsam blo legs po zhig thong dang rnal 'gyor bya bral ba/ /blo skyed gzha' ma zhig thong dang drin chen bla ma'i sras/ /kye ma/ rang nyid 'du shes gsum gyi khol po ru gyur pas/ /gzhan la gdams mi 'os kyang nges 'byung gis bskul nas/ /gang shar rtog pa yi ge'i gzugs brnyan du bgyis pa'i/ /dge bas 'aspo kun sangs rgyas go 'phang la sbyor shog /slar smras pa/ dgong mo'i grib so 'di dang / /'chi bdag gshin rje 'di gnyis/ /skad cig 49

yud tsam song yang / /tshur tshur sleb pa yin 'dug /da ni 'chi ba'i mun pa/ /myur du rub ran 'dra na/ /mun nag 'di la phan pa'i/ /sgroni me grabs gshom ran byung / /la kha'i nyi ma 'di dang / /skyes bu'i tshe lo 'di gnyis/ /skad cig yud tsam song yang / /phar phar 'gro ba yin 'dug /da ni skye ba'i la mo/ /myur du brgal ran 'dra na/ /da lta rang dbang yerdzod tshe/ /dam ཿsnas rgyags phye sgrub ran/ /zhes kyang bskul lo// 7/ /rdzong gsar nas rang yul du log khar rje bla ma chos kyi blo gros kyi gzim khang la mgo gtugs nas mchi ma 'bab bzhin 'di skad kyang smras so// zhi/ hosto/ rje bla ma'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ /lus lha skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ /ngag sngags su 'char bar byin gyis rlebes/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs snang bar zhugs/ /snang ba ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis :snabs/ /'di na bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /sar gnas ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /smre tu rab 'byams la serdzogs pa/ /dam pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis ni/ /mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog bsgrubs/ /brgya 'bul 〈snang 'bul gyis mnyes par byas/ /sprang po nga la ni 'bul rgyu med/ /bsam bzhin skyo ba 'phel ba zhig byung / /'khrul zhig rnal 'gyor dbang phyug che/ /rje bla ma chos 'phel rab 50

rgyas sogs/ /nyams rtogs ldan pa'i sgom chen tshos/ /nyams rtogs pa'i brgya 'bul stong 'bul byas/ /snying med nga la t+t+waṃ nyams rtogs med/ /des kyang skyo ba 'phel ba zhig byung / /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mkhan chen thub bstan rgyal ma/tshon soges/ /chos spyan yangs pa'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /'chad rtsodi rtsomo pas mnyes par byed/ /thos chung nga la ni yon tan med/ /des kyang skyo ba 'phel ba zhig byung / /mos gus nyag gcig lam byed pa'i/ /nang chen mchog ldan la sogs ni/ /lus srog ltos med kyis zhabs tog bsgrubs/ /las ngan ngas zhabs tog kyang ma 'grub/ /des kyang skyo ba 'phel ba zhig byung / /nga bla ma dran pas bzod glags med/ /lus ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'khrug /ngag ca co'i gdung dbyangs dbang med shor/ /sems za zi rgyun chad med par 'ur/ /lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs kun/ /rje bla ma mnyes pa'i 'khor du 'angul/ /dus rtag tu zhabs drung skye bar 〈snag /ces so// 7/ /de nas yul du log skabs rje bla ma nyid sku mnyes pa'i brtse skyong / gsung mnyes pa'i dbugs dbyung / thugs mnyes pa'i rig rgatad bcas zhal gdams dbugs dbyung rgyas par thob/ rtag mda' zer ba'i bla ma'i gzim spyil mthong sa de nas 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i gdung shugs drag pos mchi ma 'bab bzhin gsol ba btab pa ni/ lto/ rje ma rig mun sel ni 'di na bzhugs/ /sprang snying mun 'thib bzhin rang yul 'ordzog /'dun ma ni bla ma'i phyogs la 3(ra/ /ye shes snang ba ma 'dres bar/ /dngos 51

nyams rmi lam snang cha la/ /chos kyi sgroni me spar du gsol/ /snying gi mun pa bsal du gsol/ /rje dbyar gyi dpal mo ni shul du lus/ /sprang moni bya khu byug ni rang yul ldog /'dun ma ni dgrar gyi rgyal mo la shor/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas ni 'di na bzhugs/ /nga lus ni rang yul ldog lags kyang / /sems ni rje yi drung du 'khor/ /gom pa ni pha yul phyogs la sor/ /'dun ma ni bla ma'i phyogs su shor/ /rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku drin can/ /thugs yid gcig tu ma 'dres bar/ /thugs rje nus pa'i dbang bskur zhu/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i byin rlabs zhu/ /'bral mi phode pa'i brtse gdung zhu/ /dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /rje bla ma dang 'bral ba med par shog /ces kyang smras so// tsa/ /rang yul du slebs nas rje bla ma'i bka' bzhin khri tsho dgoni pa'i dgrar gnas mkhan po byas/ dgrar chos la snang gsum zhig 'chad/ de mtshams sgrub khang gsar bzhengs sogs bya byed mang po'i zing long ba'i tshe rang gi spyod tshul la yid ltung ba'i skyo glu 'di blangs so// a ho/ rang snang rnam dag gi 'og min na/ /mgon rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pha drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /blo cwa tshom med par gsol ba 'debs/ /dus rgyun chad med par thugs rjes gzigs/ /sprang chos brgyad bral bar byin gyis rlobes/ /nga de snga'i bsam blo 'khrul nas 'dug /dal 'byor rdo rje'i lus bzang 'di/ /don gal chung gi las la yengs yengs nas/ /dgra 'chi bdag gis spar zin byed la khad/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 52

'di/ /'jig rten gyi las la bkol bkol nas/ /yi dam gyi gsal snang brjed la khad/ /grag stong sngags kyi bzlas brjod 'di/ /gre mo'i gtam la yengs yengs nas/ /dam bcas pa'i bzlas brjod chag la khad/ /sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /chos brgyad kyi rlung la bskur bskur nas/ /gzhi chos sku'i rgyal srid gtor la khad/ /gsor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba 'di/ /phyogs 'dzin gyi sgrog gis bcings bcings nas/ /mnyam nyid kyi don dang bral la khad/ /sgom pa nyin mtshan kha sbyor 'di/ /don med kyi bsam blos gtor gtor nas/ /'jig rten tha mal du 'ordzog la khad/ khri/gas 'byung 'gag med kyi spyodi pa 'di/ /blang dor dang 'dor len byas byas nas/ /tshul 'chos dang tho cor sho ra la khad/ /zas ci za bdud rtsi'i 'tsho ba la/ /zhim bcog gi gdam ka byas byas nas/ /dkor ldom bu ba zhig 'gyur la khad/ /'do med col chung gi rang sems 'di/ / mi gtsang ba'i gzeb la zhen zhen nas/ /tshe gcig bsrungs pa'i 〈snam pa 'di/ /yud tsam 'khrig bde dang brje la khad/ /tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs mang po la/ /thob thob dang shes shes byas byas nas/ /snyan brgyud yi ge med pa 'di/ /yig nag gi dpe char re la khad/ /grub mtha' mang po'i bzhed srol la/ /lta rtog dang dgag sgrub byas byas nas/ /dmar khrid lag len mngoni sum 'di/ /rtog ge'i 53

bshad par re la khad/ /rnyed pa dang bkur sti grags pa la/ /yid dung dung gi re stsod byas byas nas/ /gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud 'di/ /sgyu ma'i nor dang brje la khad/ /nyoni mongs dug lnga'i mal sa ru/ /gti mug ro nyal byas byas nas/ /'ode gsal gyi rjod me yal la khad/ /dar gos dang tshar phrug bol gdan sogs/ /bde 'jam gyi reg bya la spyad spyad nas/ /g.yis mo'i bde drod yal la khad/ /snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la/ /bden 'dzin zhags pas bcings bcings nas/ /khams gsum gyi batshoni rwar tshud la khad/ /'khosgor dang mnga' thang sgrub slad du/ /mi dge la tsham tshomom zhugs zhugs nas/ /ngan serdzong gi g.yang sar lhung la khad/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya gzhag la/ /zin med kyi so nam byas byas nas/ /mgo skyes dkar so 'gyur la khad/ /mi gtsang rnag gi rkyal pa la/ /gces 'dzin dang byi dor byas byas nas/ /ro snyoms kyi spyod pa brjed la khad/ /khong dpone dang grogs mched sbyon bdag sogs/ /mi chen gyi ngo srung byas byas nas/ /dag snang dang mos gus brjed la khad/ /bya byed mang po'i zing long la/ /dus rtag tu bag med yengs yengs nas/ /byar med kyi gnas lugs brjed la khad/ /grong pa'i za lugs spyodi lugs dang / /gnyen tshan gyi kha 'dzin byas byas nas/ /dben pa'i ri sul brjed la khad/ /tshur rang la bltas na yi 54

mug skye/ /khong gzhan la bltas kyang de ka'i ngang / /da ji ltar byas kyang skyo ba 'phel/ /nga dal 'gror rdo rje'i lus bzang rnyed/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rab tu byung / /gzhung lugs mang por thos bsam byas/ /pha bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /gdams ngag mkha' 'dre'i snyan brgyud rnams/ /sba gsang meng par lhug par bstsal/ /mi med dben pa'i ri sul la/ /g.yeng ba med pa'i nyams len byas/ /nyams rtogs kyi parmyo ci yang bzhed/ /dus deng sang snang ba 'khrul pa'i rgyus/ /bsam med col chung gi rang sems 'dis/ /gnyug ma'i rgyal sa ma zin nas/ /rgyal bstan la bya ba dbeshas 'dug snyam/ /sems can :rto 'gro ldan bya'o snyam/ /'khor dang bu slob bskyang ngo snyam/ /snyan grags gzi byin bsgrub bo snyam/ /phyi ltar snang gi chos spyod mang po la/ /'grub med kyi bsam blo btang btang nas/ /sems bde ba'i go skabs gtan ma byung / /da byar med blo 'das skyong ba las/ /bsam blo mang po gtong re shi/ /sgyu lus mi byed dgu byed 'dis/ /bsam gtan gyi mal sa ma nyone nas/ /re 'ga' dpe cha dang lha khang bzhengs/ /re 'ga' sa rko rdo slog byas/ /re 'ga' dbang zhu chos zhur song / /re 'as/'a gnas bskor jo mjal byas/ /re 'ga' zas nor gyi khol po byas/ /re 'ga' ltar snang gi chos spyod bsgrubs/ /re 'ga' 'jig rten gyi las snye5 55

yengs/ /re 'ga' rang gi bya bas brel/ /re 'ga' gzhan gyi ngo srung byas / /lar zin med kyi serdzo nam mang po la/ /dus rtag tu zing long bcags bcags nas/ /lus dal bar sdod pa'i 'ordzong ma byung / /da byar med lhug par sdod pa las/ /'khrul snang gi khol po byed re shi/ /ngag bre mo mi zer dgu zer 'dis/ /bajodi med kyi smra bcas ma nus nas/ /re 'ga' sngags dang bsnyen pa bgrangs/ /re 'ga' bka' dang bsta na bcos bklags/ /re 'ga' bre mo'i gtam la yengs/ /re 'ga' chos bshad 〉(ma bshad byas/ /re 'ga' dga' 'dus kyi gtam yid 'byams/ /lar dgordzos med kyi 'ordzong gtam mang po la /dus rtag tu bshad rgyangs 'then 'then nas/ /brjod med du gnas pa'i long ma byung / /da lkugs pa'i rnam thar skyong ba las/ /don med kyi long gtam byed re shi/ /yul gang la bltas kyang spyod ba 'phel/ /gnas gang du bsdad kyang yi mug skyes/ /grogs su dang 'grogs kyang blo sun langs/ /zas ci la spyad kyang skyo ba 'phel/ /las ji ltar byas kyang ma bde byung / /'di gzhan gyi len pa ma yin te/ /rang bsam blo 'khrul pas len pa yin/ /da bsam blo gting nas btang tsa na/ /mi med kyi ri sul yang yang dran/ /rje grub thob gong ma'i gdan sa la/ /nga sprang po shi ru mi 'gro re/ /rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /sprang ri 56

khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya ba thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos brgyad zad par byin gyis rlobes/ /zhes pa'ang yid skyo ba 'phel ba'i gtakhu mo// tsa/ /rje btsun ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'jigs brgyad tsha gdung sel ba'i gdugs dkar zhes bya ba/ zhig ༷do/ ma 'u/sa rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las kyi rang gzugs/ /bya grub ye shes gzugs sku'i snang brnyan du shar ba/ /ma lus rgyal ba skyed dang rol pa yi yum gcig /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrerdzol ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi blo sna dam pa'i chos spyodi la sgyur thong / /ngo bo spros dang bral ba chos sku yi rang bzhin/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sprul sku yi mtshan nyid/ /zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan 'ordzongs sku yi ngo bo// /sku gsum dbyer med 'phags ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /nga yi snang rig sku gsum rol gar la sgyur thong / /'phags bode paṇa grub kun gyi skyabs gnas kyi mthar thug /'gro kun bu ltar skyong ba'i drin chen gyi pha ma/ /nyon mongs rims nad gso ba'i ye shes kyi sman pa/ /rje btsun myur ma dpa' mo snying dbus nas dran byung / /snyigs ma'i duḥ khas mnar ba'i sems can la gzigs mdzod/ /brgyad gnyis tsha gdung sel ba'i phan bde yi gdugs dkar/ /ngan song ga/yang las skyedab pa'i mtho ris kyi mig bu/ /myang 'das skam sar 'jog pa'i mthu chen gyi skyel ma/ /bde chen zhing du khrid pa'i chos mdzad kyi lam 57

mkhan/ /bar do'i 'phrang las sgrol ba'i mthu chen gyi bsu ma/ /'jig rten gsum mgoni ma khyed snying dbus nas dran byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'byung bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /mdor na byin rlabs rtsa ba rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ /marog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ /rtag tu thugs rjes skyong ba'i mchog gsum gyi ngo 'o/ /las bzhi myur du sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi mkha' 'gro/ /bdud bzhi'i bar chad sel ba'i rdo rje yi chos skyong / /dgos 'ar+pā char ltar 'bebs pa'i nor lha dang gter bdag /gcig bsdus 'phags ma sbyordzol ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las thogs med du stsol cig /snying dbus mi shigs dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi dbus na/ /'od gsal rdo rje rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo/ /sems nyid chos sku'i gnas lugs don dam gyi 'phags ma/ /rtag tu 'bral med bzhugs pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /gnas lugs rang ngo shes par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten pa chos spyod kyi 'drug sgo/ /dalaji'agyor rnyed dka' dran pa dge sbyor gyi thog ma/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa dam chos kyi skul ma/ /'kherdzor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa thar lam gyi 'jug ngogs/ /las 'bras blang dor byed pa dam chos kyi rtsa ba/ /thun mong lam rim 'grong bar byin gyis rang rlobes shig /byang chub sems 58

gnyis bsgom pa theg chen gyi rtsa ba/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i spyode pa rgyal sras kyi spyi no ra/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa dam pa yi mdzad spyodi/ /rgyal sras rnam thar 'grong bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /dbang bzhis rang rgyud smin pa gsang sngags kyi 'jug go /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba rig 'dzin gyi srog rtsa/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong brtson pa nyams rtogs kyi zhing sa/ /mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'gror nyams len gyi snying po/ /thun min sngon 'gro 'grong bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba chos sku yi dgongs pa/ /rang gzhan 'phags mar gsal ba bskyed rim gyi dngos gzhi/ /sgra grag sngags su shes pa bzlas brjod kyi mdo chings/ /rtog tshogs chos skur lta ba ye shes kyi lam khyer/ /rlung sems dbyer med shes pa rdzogs rim gyi snying po/ /rang lus gzhan lus thabs ldan gsang chen gyi myur lam/ /nying 'khrul 'od gsal rgyudang ba sngags 'chang gi khyad chos/ /rnam shes tshangs bug 'pho ba rig 'dzin gyi gseng lam/ /rig stong rjen pa'i ngang du bsal bzhag dang bral ba/ khes rig rang so bzung ba nyams len gyi mthar thug /gsang chen myur lam 'gyong bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba deng sang gi dus 'dir/ /grim grim ji ltar 'bad kyang las rlung gi kun rtog /bar med 'khor lo 'khor nas zhi lhag gi 59

yoni tan/ /cung zad ma thobi dug lnga sngar bas kyang rags pa'i/ /skyabs med bdag la da tsam thugs rje yis gzigs ran/ /choso brgyad me ltar 'bar ba'i dug lnga yi gzeb hrul/ /bzang bzang gos kyis dkris nas legs legs kyi snyan ming / /snyan snyan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mchod sdong du btags kyang / /dug lnga phal las rags pa'i snyigs ma yi dge bshes/ /nga dang nga 'dra yod na thugs rje yis gzigs shig /thog med dus nas da bar rigs drug du 'khyams kyang / /sun pa med pa phag la mi gtsang bzhin mdza' zhing / /gzheni nu nyid nas rgas rgas shi shi yi bar la/ /zin med chu ris lta bu'i las ka la brtson kyang / /mi 'grub 'phro la bzhag nas pha rol du 'gro zhing / /dngos po longs ma spyad pa gcig tsam yang med kyang / /tshim sems med pa lan tshwa'i chu 'thung gi ngang tshul/ /chung chung rta kha thub nas deng sang gi bar la/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong dang so nam la rems kyang / /'di byas 'di thon bya ba smegazhig kyang med steng / /ma byas ma thon mi kha gtam ngan ni je mang / /'khor ba'i 'gro la bsam na snying rje yi 'os kyang / /long bas long ba bzhin du skyob pa ni ma nus/ /ma khyed mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yoni tan kun mnga' bas/ /nyam thag byis pas pha ma 'bode pa yi tshul du/ /mchi ma'i rgyun dang ngu ba'i smre sngags dang bcas te/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 60

bskul lo 'grotre kun gyi skyabs mdzod/ /skyabs gsum dpang bzhag khas blangs dam tshig dang sdom pa/ /phor gang chang dang yud tsam 'khrig pa yi bde bar/ / brje la khad pa'i col chung khrel med kyi blun po/ /gzhan gyis dam par brtsis kyang rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs/ tsheng la me bzhin 'bar ba dug lnga yi gong bu/ /rgyu 'bras tshul bzhin mi sems las ngan gyi btsun gzugs/ /nga dang nga 'dra yode na thugs rje yis gzigs shig /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan shar phyogs kyi thig le/ /rlung gseb mar me bzhin du yod la med dus 'dir/ /bstan 'gro'i khur chen khyer ba'i dam pa yi skyes bu/ /'ga' zhig yode na thugs stobos bskyed pa yi 'os kyang / /snyigs ma'i ban hor skra yag gos mdzes kyi dmu rgod/ /tshong dang so nam chang dang bud med la spyod cing / /da rung yin mdog pho tshod gzhan las kyang mtho ba'i/ /ma rungs bstan bzhig chogs kyis sa gzhi 'di gang ba'i/ /rang chos rang gis brlag 'di skyo ba yi pha phog /ma khyed glog dang 'dra ba'i phrin las la myur bas/ /rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rang rlebes shig /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so rgyal kun gyi skyed yum/ /mngon sum byin gyis rlobs shig ye shes kyi sku can/ /re sa khyed las med do gangs can gyi skyabs gcig /gdung ba'i dgrangs kyis bskul lo snran chen gyi ma ma/ /khyodi zhal yid 61

kyi dbang pos dran pa yi mode la/ /brgyad gnyis 'jigs dang bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /'kherdzor 'das bde dge tha/ dum wa ra yi dga' tshal/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad par byin gyis rang rlobes shig /bkra shis sa gsum pad+ma dkar yo yi khyon yongs/ /bkra shis bde skyid bung bas dar dir du sgrogs shing / /bkra shis dam chos sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston la spyod pa/ /bkra shis sku bzhi'i dbyar gyi rgyal mo la sbyor thong / /zhes pa'o// 7/ /rang gzhan gyi snang tshul 'ga' res sems cung zad sun par yang gyur ba'i tshe glu 'di blangs so// a ho/ byin rlabs mchog stsole rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /phrin las mchog stsol mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste/ /kun 'dus rang sems yid bzhin nor bu rgyal/ /a ho/ rtsa rdo rje lus kyi sgrub khang du/ /gdan gsum yongs grub kyi rnal 'gror pa/ /snang stong bskyed rim gyi mtshams bsdams pas/ /tha mal snode bcud kyi rgyu ba kun/ /lha dang gzhal yas kyi ngang du smin/ /kun btags kyi rbeskyed rim ma dgos pa/ /yongs grub kyi rdo rje'i phung khams kun/ /snang stong gi zlos gar shigs se shig /ngag sngags su smin pa'i sgrub khang du/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag gi rnal 'gyor pa/ /grag stong bzlas brjod kyi mtshams bsdams pas/ /'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi sgra skad kun/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kyi rol mo 62

'khrol/ /lce mchu yi bzlas brjod mi dgos pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i stong grogs a la la/ /a wa dhā ti yi sgrub khang du/ /bde stong dga' bzhi yi rnal 'gyor pa/ /dbab bzung sngerdzog 'grems kyi mtshams bsdams pas/ /'pho bcas srid pa yi rgyu ba kun/ /'pho med dwangs ma yi 'od skur smin/ /sdug btsir gyi sems 'odzin mi dgos pa/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga/ /bde chen gyi ngang du lhangs se lhang / /〉tho gsum cha mnyam kyi sgrub khang du/ /ngang bzhag lhun 'byams kyi rnal 'gror pa/ /rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtshams bsdams pas/ /gzung 'dzin sna tshogs kyi rtog pa kun/ /khor yug 'od gsal gyi ngang du smin/ /mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob ma mchis shing / /thun mtshams dang thun tshad ma dmigs te/ /snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams kun/ /bde chen de rnam kun mchog ldan pa'i/ /ye shes kyi ngang du sa la la/ /khyod snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mnyes pa'i sras/ /sku mtshams bzhugs na de 'dra bzhugs/ /sgrub pa mardzod na de 'dra mdzod/ /'phyi ba khung du nyal ba bzhin/ /lus ni dben pa'i sgrub khang nyal/ /sems ni ci dran 'di dran med/ /bying rmugs gnyid kyis dus 'da' ba/ /de 'dra'i mtshams la yid ma ches/ /a bu ne tso'i ma k+ṇi bzhin/ /kha stong pas gsang sngags rig sngags bzlasda/ /sems rgya bod lho 63
