khri 'dan gsum bskosnar/ /bklag thabs tsam legs par ma shes pa'i/ /bsnyen tshad mang po bskyal lo skad/ /'gru 'bum mang po song ngo skad/ /bden tshig ling thog tsam ma sel/ /de 'dra'i mtshams la yid ma ches/ /mtshams khang la batshoni khang gi 'du shes can/ /mtshams stodi pa la btsos gyi 'du shes can/ /mtshams tho la lcags sgrog gi 'du shes can/ /gzhan dbang kho nas 'jug pa'am/ lto gos tsam gyi ched dmigs nas/ /mi tshugs bzhin du ri la bsgur/ /de 'dra'i mtshams la yid ma ches/ /dben pa'i ri la mtshams bsdams kyang / khoskog dril ngan lebes rang mal bzhin/ /grong pa'i za lugs spyode gnas dang / /tshong dang so nam bun skyed dang / /dgra 'dul lugs dang gnyen skyong lugs/ /don med rgya nag rgyal po yi/ /mchod gnas bya lugs tshun chad kyi/ /rnam rtog spos rgya'i ri mo mthud/ /bsam bsam chu yi gnyer ma bgrang / /de 'dra'i mtshams la yid ma ches/ /lar mtshams la bzhugs pa mang lags kri/ /la la rnyed 'dode bkur snyi 'dode/ /la la grags 'dod snyan pa 'dod/ /mi dang mi 'phrad mtshams po che/ /lkog tu tshem drub mkhar las byed/ /de 'dra'i mtshams la yid ma ches/ /ri khrode 'grim pa mang lags kyi/ /snying nas nges 'byung gis ma bskul na/ /a gsar yal nas rmus thag chod/ /grong pa'i srang mdor khyi bzhin 64

nyul/ /spyodad pas su thu dgu bas thu/ /bya byed su mang dgu bas mang / /nyone mongs su che dgu bas che/ /de bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren ma lags sam/ /rnal 'gyor gyi chom rkun ma lags sam/ /chos byed kyi rkang 'dren ma lags sam/ /dang po dad cing ba spu ldang / /mjal ma thag tu mchi ma 3snar/ /ci gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrub bo skad/ /ci bkyag khur po 'khur ro skad/ /'dris shing 'dris la dred cing dred/ /tha mar log lta byed pa'am/ /min kyang gzhis kyis brnyas thabs shor/ /phar la bshad na tshur la lab/ /go ba bkon na bka' bskyon go /yon tan mi rtogs skyon la rtog /ru nga phrag dog ko long can/ /slob ma rnams la yid ma ches/ /chang dang bud med 'jol nyog spyod/ /sdom pa dam tshig chu la 'pho/ /dngos nus spu tsam ma thon bzhin/ /grub brdzu gter brdzus phu sa steng khengs/ /bla ma 'ga' la yid ma ches/ /thobe na khyim mtshes nang nor rku/ /ma thub dgra yang gtsug tu bkur/ /sum ldan rnams la skur pa 'debs/ /'jol nyog mkhan la lhag par dad/ /rtsod dang phra ma kha mchu 'gyid/ /ji ltar byas kyang mgu dus med/ //yul mi rnams la yid ma ches/ /re 'ga' mkha' ltar rnyo gas med dwangs/ /re 'ga' spros pa'i drwa bas 'thums/ /re 'ga' mtho ste re 'ga' dma'/ /lta ba 'di la yid ma ches/ /re 'ga' khor yug 'od gsal 'char/ /65

re 'ga' ba〉snams kyang tha mal pa/ /re 'ga' gsal te re 'ga' 'grib/ /sgom pa 'di la yid ma ches/ /re 'ga' gsor 'das ro snyoms 'dra/ /re 'ga' bag med 'chol ba spyod/ /re 'ga' legs te re 'ga' nyes/ /spyod pa 'di la yid ma ches/ /khyad gzhi 'khore 'das ma grub na/ /khyad chosgos bcing 〈snal ga la grub/ /re dwogs thob shor 'du shes can/ /'bras bu 'di la yid ma ches/ /zas dang gos kyis legs bskyangs shing / /bzang 'dod byi dor gces spras sogs/ /ngal ba du mas skyong ba khyod/ /dur khrod 'jigs rung glo bur du/ /gcer nyal byed pa nam 'ong zhes/ /sgyu lus 'di la yid ma ches/ /grag stong brag ca 'dra ba la/ /brtags na phan gnod med pa'i chos/ /ma brtags tsa na stong 'ur che/ /bstod smad dga' sdug cho rol slong / /tshig dngos med khyod la yid ma ches/ /ma brtags rig rig tur tur po/ /brtags na 'di yin 'di min med/ /g.yo dkrug bde sdug kun gyi gzhi/ /sems dngos med khyodi la yid ma ches/ /yod ni rdul tsam med pa la/ /snang ni dpag tu med pa snang / /snang rnyasnang 'gal 'du bkra bkra bo/ /snang ba sgyu ma khyod la yid ma ches/ /lar thams cad thams cad rdzun du gda'/ /snang srid rdzun gyi cho rol la/ /nga de snga yid ches blo gtad phung / /rdzun gyi rgya mchor dbang med 'khor/ /rdzun gyi rlabs des srid gsum 66

dkrugs/ /rdzun 'ur ded na zad mtha' med/ /rdzun phug sdib na thams cad bde/ /thams cad rdzun du shes pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /rdzun gyi snang bas bslu ba ga la nus/ /steng nas gnas sdib 'og nas sa 'gul yang / /snang srid rdzun par shes pa'i rnal 'gror la/ /re dwogs spang blang dgag sgrub ga la yod/ /gdod ma'i rang tshugs zin pa'i dus shig mchis/ /bag chags rdzun gyi rgan pos sprul pa yi/ /snang srid rdzun gyi ltad mo sna tshogs kyis/ /col chung sems kyi byis pa bslus pa las/ /bde sdug rdzun gyi cho rol long long g.yos/ /e ma sems nyid dngos med 'khrul po ches/ /sprul pa srid pa'i grong khyer chen po 'dir/ /la la lcags bsregs sa gzhir gcer nyal byed/ /la la rin chen me tog bde bar rol/ /la la lcags bsregs tho lum 'bar ba za/ /la la bdud rtsi gsar pa'i btung bas myedas/ /la la mi sdug srin mosnas sha khrag za/ /la la lha resna mdzes mas dga' bas 'khyud/ /thams cad sems kyis sprul zhing sems kyis byas/ /'di na snang srid 'khore 'das dgrar langs kyang / /sems rtogs pa la phan gnod re dwogs med/ /snang srid thams cad sems kyi rang rtsal yin/ /bde sdug thams cad sems kyis bzos pa yin/ /'khor 'das thams cad sems ngo shes ma shes/ /de phyir sems ni 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ /dper na rmi lam chu bos 67

khyer ba na/ /de las thar 'don ngal ba rang sdug yin/ /rmi lam shes na rang snang rang sar grol/ /de bzhin snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang snang nang du rang mgo mi 'khor ba/ /rang snang rang ngo shes na rang sar grol/ /de skad rang la nyams myong yodi min yang / /dam pa gong ma'i rjes zlos byas pa 'di/ /sngags btsun mañju ma tis sbyar ba ste/ /dge bas snang srid 'khrul ba ru 'ordzog ste/ /bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' mthong bar shog /ces dang // 7/ /yang rmi lam 'od gsal gyi skabs shig a ho/ 'od gsal rdo rje lus kyi grong khyer gyi dbus na/ /'od gsal rang byung a wa dhu ti yi khang mdzes/ /'od gsal snying dbus dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi thig le/ /'od gsal rdo rje rig stong dbyer med kyi bla ma/ /'od gsal rig rtsal dag pa'i 'khore tshogs kyi tshom bu/ /'od gsal 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa de mkhyen no/ /'od gsal gzhi yi gnas lugs ji bzhin du rtogs shing / /'od gsal lam gyi bgrod pa nyi zla ltar myur te/ /'od gsal 'bras bu ye shes mngon sum du 'gyur ba/ /'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /'od gsal nyin mo'i snang ba ye shes su 'char zhing / /'od gsal mtshan mo'i gnyid kun 'ode gsal la 'byams pas/ /'ode gsal rmi lam sprul bsgyur spel ba la dbang thob/ /'od gsal khor yug ye shes chen po yis 68

myos pa/ /'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /'od gsal skye ba sprul sku'i rol gar du 'char zhing / /'od gsal 'chi ba mos sku'i a ma dang mjal te/ /'od gsal bar do longs sku'i zhing khams su mthong ba/ /'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /ha ha/ gti mug gnyid kyi mun khang du/ /'od gsal chos sku'i zla ba shar/ /snang mun bar lag dbyings su yal/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thobe sa mtshams zhig /skye shi'i mtshan ma rang sar grerdzol/ /zhes pa'ang 'od gsal rdo rjes so// 7/ /rang lo sum cu so gsum lcags yos lor nga rang gi slob ma chos dbang gzhan rkyen gyis 'jo phu dgon gyi sgrub bla la 'gro dgos byung ba'i tshe skyo glu blangs pa ni// tshu/ hesna/ brag dkar dkyil la thang dkar rbesnad tshang bcas/ /dkar rdzong brag ngas rgyun du 'grogs snyam kyang / /thang dkar rgod khyod nam 'phang gcod do skad/ /tshang rten gog po nged gnyis mal du lus/ /thang dkar rgod khyod dran nas yi mug skye/ /tshang rten gog po mthong nas mchi ma shor/ /thang dkar rgod khyod rnyi yis ma zin zhing / /dkar rdzong brag nga thog gis ma gtor tshe/ /phyis nas yang yang 'dzoms pa'i smoni 'dun zhu/ /khyod dang nga gnyis dam tshig srad bus sbrel/ /blo gtad snying nas bcol ba'i grogs po byas/ /blo chung ngas ni rgyun du 'grogs snyam kyang / /snying gi bu khyodi gzhan du bzhud do skad/ /khang pa gog po nged gnyis mal 69

du lus/ /snying gi bu khyod dran nas skyo ba 'phel/ /khang pa gog po mthong nas mchi ma shor/ /rnal 'gror nga yang 'chi bas ma non zhing / khes ldan bu khyod gzhan gyis ma bslus tshe/ /phyis nas yang yang 'dzoms pa'i stsod 'dun zhu/ /a cang rtse mo yin mod/ /skyes pa thams cad 'chi zhing / /bsags pa thams cad 'dzad la/ /'dus pa thams cad 'bral ba/ /'kherdzor ba'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /de la skyod bas ci phan/ /dgra dang grerdzogs kyi snang ba/ /rmi lam snang ba bzhin du/ /rang gi sems kyis bzos pa'i/ /'khrul snang kho na yin pas/ /dga' sdug rtog pa'i cho ngol/ /skye med da)ngas su stim shog /ces blangs so// lto/ /rdzong gsar du gsung ngag rin po che zhu skabs rang gis gsor 'das dbyer med la go ba lon tshul glu ru phul ba ni/ a ho/ dus gsum gri ༄7la ba thams cad kyi/ /ye shes kyi phung po gcig bsdus nas/ /bdag dmu tre(da sems can 'dul ba'i phyir/ mi phal ba'i gzugs su snang ba yi/ /pha dran pas gdung sel rin po che/ /thugs brtse bas yud tsam gsan par zhu/ /sprang bdag la nyams smyu1nga ma mchis kyang / /pha bla ma sangs rgyas bka' drin las/ /chos lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la/ /rang go yul ji ltar byung bzhin zhu/ /chos khungs la btsun rung mi btsun rung / /nga'i lung khungs gnyis med kye rdo rje/ /chu mgo gangs dkar la thug pa bzhin/ /rje 70

rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /bka' yang dag lung gi tshad ma zhes/ /'phags bod kyi paṇa grub kun la grags/ /rgyud yin min gyi ye tshome rtsode pa med/ /bka' spyi dang zhu dag 'pher ba yin/ /brgyud pa la bzang rung mi bzang rung / /nga'i brgyud pa 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa/ /khong zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang nas/ /pha drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi phreng ba la/ /so skye'i bla mas bar ma chodi/ /brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba la/ /dam sel ngan pa'i g.ya'atshom gos/ /de rnam thar dang zhu dag 'pher ba yin/ /byin rlabs la che rung mi che rung / /nga'i bla ma chos kyi blo gros yin/ /ya ki 'og min gyi pho brang na/ /longs sku la rdo rje 'chang chen zhes/ /kha sbyor la yan lag bdun ldan sku/ /mthing ga la 'od zer lam me la/ /khong sa bcu'i byang sems 'khor tshogs la/ /theg chen yi chos 'khor bskor ro skad/ /'di na zhig mos gus dag pa'i rtsal/ /mchog sprul la chos kyi blo gros zhes/ /mi gzugs la sangs rgyas dgongs pa can/ /skal ldan ni 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs la/ /gsang chen gyi chos gsor bskor ro skad/ /khong gdod ma'i gzhi la dbyer med cing / /spangs rtogs dang yoni tan la khyad par med/ /thugs rje dang byin rlabs mnyam mo zhes/ /mi nga la the tshom spu tsam med/ /de bstod 'dod dang mos gus kyis bzhag pa min/ /pho rus dang 71

'dod chags kyi dad pa min/ /blun dad dang grags pa'i rjes 'brang min/ /de rang sems dang zhu dag 'pher ba yin/ /nyams len la zab rung mi zab rung / /nga'i nyams len gsung ngag lam 'bras yin/ /ma rgyal kun skyed yum bdag med mas/ /khong paṇa grub dbang po bi rū par/ /gdams pa nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi'i/ /rten 'brel byin rlabs mthu ma nyams/ /bdag med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i drod ldan la/ /mi tshig bcos ma'i lhad ma zhugs/ /sku gsum gyi zhing khams btsal na yang / /chos 'di las zab pa med do zhes/ /lha brgya byin yin yang 'gog dka' ba'i/ /'phrog med kyi yid ches rdo ba la/ /ri mo ru bris pa bzhin du gyur/ /de phyogs ris dang grub mtha' bzos pa min/ /grwa sa dang chags sdang gi skad cha min/ /de tshad ma bzhi yis grub pa yin/ /lta ba la mtho rung mi mtho rung / /nga'i lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med yin/ /ya ki sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs dang / /ma ki rigs drug gi zhabrul rtog gnyis/ /chos nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa/ /'kherdzor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba yin/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du 'tshol ba 'khrul/ /'phro rgod du ga lnga rang mtshan dang / /mi rtog chos sku'i ye shes gnyis/ /rang grol shes na gcig pa ste/ /gnas dga' 'gyu sdug byed pa 72

sha re tsha/ /gnas kyang chos sku 'gyu yang sprul pa'i sku/ /rig pa longs sku'i dbyengs las ma g.yos so/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi grong khyer dang / /myang 'das bde chen gyi zhing khams gnyis/ /gdod nas dbyer med du bzhugs pa la/ /'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa shin tu 'khrul/ /re dwogs spang blang gdone chen snying la zhugs/ /gang zhig legs par rtogs na sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dang mtshungs 'gyur zhing / /ma rtogs srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gsal stong zung 'jug sems/ /sku gsum rang ngo 'phrod pa bla ma'i drin/ /ro mnyam lta ba'i gdeng dang mi ldan pa'i/ /mchog dman re dwogs 'odzin pa sna tshogs kyis/ /kun gzhi chos sku 'byed pa theg pa dman/ /mthoni por 'don pas dma' ba'i gral mthar lhung / /rnam shes ma spangs ye shes chen po ru/ /bzo med lhug par skyong ba nyams len gnad/ /rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tur tur pos/ /gnyug ma lhan skyes don gyi grogs bzang stor/ /bcas bcos bsgyur bkod bzo lhad la sogs pa/ /da lta'i rang rig ye shes skad cig mar/ /ma yengs rang mdangs skyodang ba bzhag thabs gnad/ /zab zab mthon pa'i chos skad rjes 'brang nas/ /gsal stosnang phra rags dwangs snyigs 'byed pa nor/ /dwangs ma 'dod pas rnyog ma mi zad slong / /phra ba grim pas 73

rags pa'i ngar 'dzin ldang / /ma bcos bzhag pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas yin/ /ma btsal ye nas gnas pa skyong ba yin/ /'di yin 'di min rtog dgrod rnon po yis/ /sems rig shan 'byed byed pa a thang chad/ /bgrung bgrung rtsol pas rnyog ma mi zad slong / /spyang spyang bya ras bos pas ye shes gos/ /mkhas mkhas spyad pas doni gyi gnad 'gag 〈snar/ /'khor ba ma spangs myang 'das chen po ru/ /ma bsgrub ye nas gnas pa chos nyid gshis/ /gsor 'das dbyer med rtogs pa bla ma'i drin/ /'khor 'das spang blang byed pa shin tu blun/ /mnyam nyid lta ba'i rgyal po sprang la 'khyams/ /re dwogs spang blang bdag 'dzin gzeb la chud/ /nyon mongs ma spangs ye shes chen po ru/ /rang gsal lhug par skyong ba man ngag gnad/ /skyoni rnams yoni tan len pa ma shes par/ /nyon mongs ye shes 'byed pa shin tu blun/ /byung rgyal man ngag rgyal po 'bangs kyis bslus/ /rnam rtog ma spangs rang byung ye shes su/ /rang grol rjen par skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad/ /rtog pa kha tshom gcod pa'i zhi gnas la/ /sdug btsir sems 'dzin byed pa nyon re mongs/ /gnas 'dod rtsol bas 'gyu ba nan gyis sgrub/ /sgom 'dod zhen blos sgom gyi rtsa ba rul/ /chos can ma spangs chos nyid gnyug ma ru/ /rang bzhin ye nas gnas pa gshis kyi bab/ /chos can chos nyid 'byed pa'i zing zing — 7 74

pos/ /skyone med gnyug ma'i grogs bzang mal nas stor/ /lta ngan mi gtsang mdze mosnas dam du 'khyud/ /gzung ba'i yul snang chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /gang snang phan gnod med par rang sar dag /'dzin pa'i sems rtog nam mkha'i blosnag 'gyu 'dra/ /gang shar dgag sgrub med par rang sar grerdzol/ /snang sems dbyer med du ma ro gcig pas/ /dus gsum rtog pa lam khyer spyodad pa'i gnad/ /gzung 'dzin rgyang chad 'dzin pa theg pa dman/ /ro snyoms spyod pa'i seṅge khyis bdas shor/ /kun rdzob ma spangs don dam bden pa ru/ /gdod nas rnam par dag pa shes bya'i gzhis/ /phyir ltas rtog ge'i dpyad pa snani pa yis/ /gcig dang tha dad 'dzin pa grub mtha'i skyon/ /mdor na 'khor 'das dbyer med ma rtogs par/ khan 'byed dwangs snyigs phra rags 'byed pa kun/ /re dwogs spang blang gnyis 'odzin gdon gyis zin/ /grub mtha'i skyon nam rang gi blo skyon gyis/ /nan gyis dman pa'i lam la sbyar ba ste/ /lta ngan mi zad spyo1sa pa'i drwa bas 'thums/ /mthon po'i rir 'dzegs dma' ba'i g.yang sar lhung / /de ltar lta ba'i mnyam bzhag rig ngo la/ /gzhan stong rang stong 'dzin pa'i dmigs gtad bral/ /spros bral med dgag grub mtha'i tha snyad med/ /gsal stong rig stong 'odzin pa'i khas len med/ /sems dang snang ba gcig dang tha dad med/ /rnam shes ye shes 75

sangs rgyas sems can med/ /sems dang rig pa nyon mongs ye shes stong / /kun gzhi chos sku kun rdzob don dam bral/ /'khor 'das dbyer med thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /du ma ro gcig snang srid chos sku'i zhing / /snang sems zung 'jug 'khor 'das 'od gsal klong / /'di la yin min yod med stong mi stong / /gsal dang mi gsal bde dang mi bde dang / /rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang ma grags dang / /bstosnad dang smad pa skye shi bar do sesgogs/ /thams cad nam mkha'i me tog bzhin du rdzun/ /rme gsham bu mo'i bgying bag brdzod dang mtshungs/ /de ltar lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la/ /rang gi go yul ji ltar byung ba rnams/ /drin chen bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las/ /gsung ngag lta khrid zab mo༄ 1ba pa'i tshe/ 8nga rta'i sa ga'i nya ba'i tshes bcu la/ /bla ma mchog la rtogs 'bul zhus pa ste/ /'khor 'das kun gyi gnad gsang 'di yin zhes/ /rang gi lam la the tshom ma mchis shing / /mi 'phrog yid ches rdo la ri mo bzhin/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang ma gyur 'grerdzo/ /kun kyang 'kherdzor 'das dbyer med don rtogs te/ /lta ba ngan pa'i 'phrang dog las thar nas/ /rnam mkhyen sku bzhi'i grong du slebs par 3snag /ces pa 'di'ang rjes bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros las gsor 'das dbyer med kyi khrid zhu skabs rang la go yul ji ltar byung ba rnams rje bla mar zhus shing yi ger bkodi pa'o// 7/ /dgung grangs serdzo bdun bzhes pa'i skabs kyi dam bca' yi ge 76

las/ da tshe mjug gi nyi ma nub rir phyogs kyang / de snga phan chad la 'di thon snyam pa'i blo bder sdod chog pa'i chos ni ci'ang ma grub/ thos bsam dang rten bzhengs phran bu byas kyang / phal cher chos brgyad dang tshe 'di'i che thabs kho nar song ba las/ 'chi ba gros phugs su bcugs pa'i chos ni gcig kyang ma thoni/ mtshams bsnyen sgrub daja / rlung 'khrul gsor/ sems ngo lta ba sogs nyams len la cung zad brtsoni khul byas kyang 'chi dus mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng ni ci'ang ma thob/ ri khrod dang dben gnas cung zad 'grim khul byas kyang / lam rtags kyi yon tan ni sne gcig kyang ma leni/ gzhan la chos bshad dang stong skad cung zad bsgrags kyang / chos brgyad dang nyon mongs pa ni kha cung zad kyang ma bri ba'i khar me 'bar ba la shing skam bsnan pa bzhin je cher song / ting nge 'dzin dang sgom pa la cung zad brtson khul byas kyang / dgra gnyen chags sdang tshong so nam sogs 'jig rten gyi bya ba sgrub lugs kyi bas/ma blo rnam g.yeng gi khur po ni je rags la gyur/ thabs lam zab mos nyams len la cung zad bcun kyang / ci phal cher chagasta sdang dang tha mal snang zhen gyi dbang du song nas yang dag pa'i lam du ma chud/ dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyi gnad 'gag cung zad shes kyang / blang dor ni gang yang ma nus/ sems can thams cad pha ma drin chen yin pa'i rgyu mtshan shes kyang / gzhan phan gyi sems ni brgya la re re tsam dang / gzha na la nga rgyal phrag dog khong khro bsam ngan sbyor rtsub g.yo sgyu 'gran sems sogs ni grangs med par skyes/ snang ba lha yin/ sgra grag sngags yin/ dran rtog ye shes yin zer ba'i stong skad mthon po bsgrags kyang / dus phal cher snang sems tha mdze+ergya 'byams su lus nas/ 'jig rten tha mal pa rnams kyi lad mo la lang sgosnar du song ste seng ges khyi yi rjes su stegs pa lta bu'i 'brul snang gi las la yengs pas mi tshe zad la thug da 'chib nam 'ong ni mi shes/ 'chi dus mi 'jigs pa'i blo bde zhig ni ma thon/ phyi mar gsor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong dgos byung na bizod thabs ni mi 'dug mi myong ba'i gdeng ni ci'ang ma thob/ phar rang gis dngos brgyud gnyis nas sgo gsum gyis phan ci thog byas pa'i slob 'khor grwa pa jo mo 'dras kyang cung zad re la yus chen yo byed/ gcig la cung zad bag phab na a gsar che/ rang 'dod che/ drag zhan bdams so zer ba sogs phrag dog dang 'gran sems kho nas ma byas pa la byas serdzo dang / ma bzlas pa la bzlas so zhes sgro 'dogs dang 'khang ra kho na byed/ blo gtad snying nas bcol ba'i grogs po tsho'ang ri mgo gang mthor lha bsang gtong ba'i dpe ltar 77

byed pas/ rgud dus thamaso cad thabs kyis byol/ stotho dang grags phyir 'brangs nas rang mgo gang thon gyis lam re len 'grerdzo ba las lugs gnyis kyi gzhung dang phyi thag la bsam mkhan ni mi 'dug mthun 'jug dang ngo srung ci drag byas kyang lo dus dang mgu dus med par/ ma byas ma thon gyi mi kha dang gtam ngan ni je cher song / las gang du gnas kyang su dang 'grogs kyang / ci la spyad kyang ma lo ma mnyes pa kho na las med pa 'di/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la bden 'dzin zhags pas bcings nas na dwogs/ shi dwogs/ sdug dwogs/ dbul dwogs/ ltogs dwogs/ 'khyags dwogs/ gzhan gyis skur pa 'debs dwogs/ mi kha ngan pa 'ong dwogs/ dgra 'dre byur gsum gyi 'tshe ba 'ong dwogs/ nor longs spyod snyan grags 'bor slob gnyen nye 'brel sogs nyams kyis dwogs/ ma mgu yi dwogs/ e skyid/ e rnyed/ e rag e bstod/ e grags snyam pa'i 'dod phyogs la re ba chen po byed pa sogs rmi lam lta bu'i 'grul snang kho na la mgo gsor ba 'dis lan par snang bas/ da phan chad 'di 'dra'i spyod pa las ldog ste dam bca'i ri mo snying la 'bri ba yin pas/ mthun 'gyur bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'grerdzo chos srung nor lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas gnang bar zhu/ da dgong nyi tsam gyi tshe mjug 'di la dgra gnyen chags sdang / bstod slad/ dga' sdug ngo srung / mthun 'jug sogs 'jig rten tha mal ba'i khyu nas bud/ dgras log sgrub dang gnod pa srog gcod pa'i bar byung yang lan mi byed/ bstan 'gro'i ched ma gtogs drag las dang mngone spyode mi byed la/ bsam ngan dang bdag bstode gzhan jodi sogs midage ba'i las thams cad mi byed cing de dag byung yang de ma thag bshags pa dang gnyen poso zin par byed/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin zhing rgyang dang bub ka rang gis len/ lar su la'ang phrag dog dang 'gran sems/ nga rgyal/ khyad gsode/ grub mtha'i phyogs zhen/ don med kyi sgro skur sogs spangs nas thams cad la dag snang sbyangs te kun gyi slobo mar 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad/ dgra dang dgra phyogs la legs po byung na mi dga' ba dang / mi 'dod pa byung na dga' ba'i blo spangs te byams snying rje la blo sbyong / pha ma gnyen bshes grogs slob sogs nye phyogs gang la'ang chags zhen mngon 'gyur bas 'ching ba'i bsam sbyor spong ci thub dang de dag gis kyang chos lam las bzlog mi thub par byed/ ngo srung dang 'gras 'dris spangs te mchog dman su la'ang re dwogs mi byed/ su ma mgu na'ang ma mgu/ rang dbang mi la mi sprod par sna thag mgo 78

la dkri/ zas bzang po rnyed na bza' ba'i rnal 'gror gyis zin pas bza'/ ngan ngon las ma rnyed kyang chog shes pas spyod/ gos legs po rnyed na zhen chags med par rgyani/ ngan hrul las ma rnyed kyang gtum mo dang chog shes kyi gos la brten/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti byung na chags zhen med pa chos phyogs la ci 'gro byed/ ma byung na'ang dkor grong chog tshong so nam/ bun skyed/ brgya bzhig stong 'gugs kyi las thabs sogs log 'tsho sgrub pa'i thabs rnams sperdzong / snyan pa dang grags pa setregs byung na chags zhen med pa lam du len/ ma byung yang e 〈snang gi re ba/ ma byung gis dwogs pa med par ro snyoms kyi spyod pa lam du khyer/ chos ci sgrub gzhan gyi mig sngar mdzes su re ba sogs su ma yin par byang chub kyi lam du ci 'gro byed/ bde ba dang skyid pa byung na dkone mchog gi bka' drin du shes pas lam du khyer/ sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa/ na tsha mi kha gtam ngan mnga' thang nyams pa sogs ci byung yang re dwogs dang mya ngan mi byed par sgyu ma rmi lam du shes par byed/ 'khor slob 'du mi byung na chos dang zang zing gi phan pa ci thogs byed/ 'khor mi gcig kyang ma byung yang e 'ong gi re ba/ mi 'byung gi dwogs pa dang mi mgu yi dwogs pas ngo dga' g.yo sgyu sogs gzhan mgo sprid pa'i las thabs thams cad spangs te/ re dwogs zil gnon gyi bsam pas seng ge'i gzugs kyis rgyu/ mdor na rnyed ma rnyed/ bde ma bde/ grags ma grags/ bstod smad dga' sdug re dwogs kyis/ gtam dang lto gos 'ba' zhig don du gnyer nas ci byed tshe 'di'i lag char song ba'i bsam pa dang bya ba thams cad ring du dor te/ gang byung des chog 'tsho ba bya 'tshol/ re dwogs zil gnon/ snang ba gdong 'ded/ 'chi nus thog 'gel/ gang 'ong na'ang shog ci red na'ang red snyam pa'i ro snyoms kyi spyodi pa lam du len/ chags sdang rmongs gsum phrag dog sogs ngan rtog dang lus bde sems skyid nyams dga' ba sethogs bzang rtog dus phal cher ci dran med pa 'khrul snang rgya 'byams su cham gyis 'gro ba gtang snyoms kyi rtog pa sogs thams cad re dwogs spang blang dga' sdug med par lam du khyer/ gnas mi med kyi lung stong 'grims/ grogs bya dang ri dwogs 'grogs/ zas sngo dang chu gtsang bsten/ ri yi bu bya/ na bun gyi gos groni/ gyong sto gos gtam gsum la bskur te bskakha brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar ci gsal dang / blosna phug chos la gtad/ chos phug sprang la gtad/ sprang phug brag la gtad/ brag phug 'chi la gtad zer ba'i bka' gdams gong ma'i gtad so bzhi mtha' 'khyol ba bya/ yang so thar gyi pham pa 79

bzhi/ byang sems kyi rtsa ltang bcu bzhi dang pham 'dra bzhi/ sngags kyi rtsa ltang bcu bzhi/ yanalag gi 〈snam po brgyad bcas mi nyams par bsrung / ci ste nyams na so so'i gzhung bzhin phyir bcos sogs byed/ gzhan yang dbang bzhi'i mnyam rjes bza' srung mi bral ba'i dam tshig sogs ci nus bsrung / nyi ma re re bzhin bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs pa ma chag pa dang rlung sbyor brgya re/ chag med rnam bzhi ma chag pa/ bza' ba'i rnal 'gror rgyas pa re/ bar bar du sems ngo skyong zhing 'khrul 'khor ci rigs dang kye rdor/ mkha' spyod/ sgrol dkar/ mgon po rnams kyi bsnyen pa brgya re/ de bzhin gtor bsngo dang bla ma gsum gyi gsol 'debs brgya re ma chagapa/ nyin re bzhin bla ma yi dam/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong / byams snying rje/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje/ sems ngo skyong rgyu/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ sbyimyo/ pa rnam bzhi sogs ma brjed pa byed/ mtshan mo'ing bag med du mi nyal bar/ rmi lam 'edi gsal gyi nyams len brtson 'grus drag pos byed/ dkar po dge ba'i las ci la'ang khyad gsod mi byed par ci 'grub dang / byang chub kyi lam du tsi 'gro/ rang 'khri med pa'i bsngo smon sems bskyed kyis zin pa byed la/ nag po sdig pa'i phyogs thams cad spong ci nus dang bshags sdom sogs kyis zin par byed/ de ltar byas kyang gzhan gyis bdag 'edzin che/ sdom pa sgosnar/ dam tshig nyams/ 'dzin chags che/ a gsar che/ ngan sems che/ gti thug can sogs smad ra gtong yang dga' sdug med pa gang yong yong byed/ don sgo chos su ma song na mi kha la nges pa med pas sangs rgyas yin/ grub thob yin/ btsun pa yin/ mkhas pa yin/ sgom chen yin/ bdag 'dzin med/ zhen chags med/ chos brgyad med/ snyan grags mnga' thang dang 'gre 33 gdul bya che ba/ bla ma de red/ chos pa de red zer ba sogs mi kha bzang yang phan med pas rapa ñcad chos dang bsre zhing / rang sems chos kyis btul/ spyode lam rnam bzhi thams cad du'ang rang lus yi dam dang mi 'bral/ spyi gtsug bla ma dang mi 'bral/ snang ba sgyu ma rmi lam dang mi 'bral ba ste mdor na snang grag rig gsum tha mal du ma lus pa khyer so gsum dang mi 'bral bar byed/ gzhan yang dang po sdig pa'i bya ba thongs/ bar du 'jig rten bya ba thongs/ tha mar chos kyi bya ba thongs zhes pa ltar chos 'gal gyi bya ba phar 'ol chos su ming btags pa'i yi ge 'bri klog dang rten bzhengs sogs bya byed mang po'i zing long thams cad cham gyis bzhag ste/ 'grul pa'i rtog pa zad 80

pa/ chos nyid 'gyur med kyi btsan sa zin pa/ gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba nub pa/ snang srid 'khrul pa'i rdzun phug ne+eb pa/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa bral ba/ bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod pa/ lta ngan gyi 'phrang las thar ba/ mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams gtore ba/ snang mun gyi bar lag 'gyelob/ dam chig dang 〈snam pa las grethol ba/ skye rga na 'chi'i 'ching ba las grol ba'i mthong lam chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du chos brgyad dang tshe 'di'i che thabs su ma song ba/ snang ba gdong 'ded/ 'chi nus thog khel/ re dwogs zil gnon gyi spyod pas 'chi ba snying khung du bcug pa'i chos shig mi byed re/ de ltar bdag gi dam bca' mthar phyin par phabla ma bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ khyed mkhyen/ khyed la re/ khyed la stos/ pha bla ma/ pha blam/ pha bla ma/ khyed rang mkhyen/ zhes pa'ang khas len dang dam bca' rta ri ba la/ nyams len lag thog yodi pa la khyi mi ri ba zhig 'ong gis dwogs nas/ yang yang zhu dag bya phyir yi ge 'di bris pa yin pas dkoni mchog lgesum gyi bden pas de de bzhin du gyur cig ces dang // tsha/ /yang de'i tshe dam bca' la gdeng rnyed pa'i glu 'di'ang blangs so// e ma/ dran pas snying gi gdung sel bka' drin 'khor mtha' dang bral ba'i/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam mgone ngag dbang gi legs pa/ /'jam dpal mi yi tshul bzung 'jam dbyangs ཿsnas kyi ni rgyal mtshan/ /kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs chos kyi ni blo gros/ /'jam dgrangs rnam gsum zhabs la 'dud do thugs rje yis spyodangs shig /grub brnyes bye ba'i gshegs shul gsung ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /bla ma sangs rgyas drin gyis smin grol pha phog tu thob pas/ /mngon sum nyams myong rtogs pa'i drod rtags sa zin gyis dben yang / /yid gnyis the tshom med pa'i yid ches tshad ma 81

yi nges shes/ /ming la ri mo bris bzhin 'phrog med gdeng khel du snang bas/ /nyazab zab mtho mtho'i chos kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes rang mdzod cig /stong 'ur grags skam rjes su mi 'brang dam bca' rang yin no/ /'khrul snang dbyings su dag pa'i rnal 'byor chen po rang min te/ /sgyu ma'i snang ba 'di yi rdzun phug cung zad tsam rig pas/ /'dir snang chos brgyad gnyer kha sngar dang mi 'dra tsam chung 'dug /da ni skyed sdug bzang ngan ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i che thabs mi bsgrub dam bca' rang yin no/ /sems nyid chos sku'i rang zhal mngone sum mtherdzong ba zhig min yang / /yin min the snuram med pa nyams len skyong bde tsam 'dug pas/ /spros med chig dril ngang nas bag yangs bde mo ru nyal chog /spros bcas za zi'i chos kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes rang mdzod cig /da ni byar med cog ger 'dug pa dam bca' rang yin no/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje 'byongs pa'i byang sems rnal ma zhig min yang / /'grerdzo kun pha ma yin pa'i go ba snying dkyil nas rnyed cing / /dgra gnyen las kyi 'khrul par nges shes cha tsam zhig yode pas/ /dgra 'dre byur gsum phan gnod ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzodangacig /srog 'di bcad kyang gnod lan mi byed dam bca' rang yin no/ /gnyen bshes brgya rnyasnang ldan dang phyogs mtha' dgra bo yis ba〉snar la/ /ltar snang 82 —

phan gnod che ste don la nam mkha' yi me tog /phan gnod gang yang med pa rdzun snang bslu khrid kyi mkhan po/ /gnyen nye mgu dang mi mgu ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni gnyen la chags sems mi byed dam bca' rang yin no/ /tshe ring lo brgya thub dang tshe thung da lta rang 'chi bar/ /rnam pa khyad par che ste done la rmi lam gyi snang ba/ /tshe ring tshe thung khyodi rang ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni shi yang 'grod pa mi byed dam bca' rang yin no/ /phyug po nor brgya ldan dang dbul po sprang zas kyis 'tsho bar/ /tshur mthong so skye'i snang ngor phan gnod bzang ngan ltar snang yang / /don la yodi med phan gnod med pa sgyu ma yi nor rdzas/ /da ni phyug dbul gang 'ong ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas bsag bsrung mi byed dam byāca' rang yin no/ /'khor slobe brgya stong ldan dang sprang ban gcig pu ru 'khyams la/ /'jig rten ltar snang bzang ngan dga' sdug chen po ltar snang yang / /done la rmi lam bzhin du gnyis ka 'khrul pa las ma 'das/ /'khor slob 'du dang mi 'du ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni ngo srung mthun 'jug mi byed dam bca' rang yin no/ /mthoni po'i khri gdugs bar na kun gyis spyi gtsug tu bkur dang / /khas zhan mdze sprang gseb na kun gyis tho 'tsham dang brnyas la/ /'khrul ngor mtho dman che ste don la sgyu ma dang rmi lam/ /mtho 83

dman 'gror rgud khyod rang ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni tshe 'di'i che thabs mi bsgrub dam bca' rang yin no/ /sangs rgya sa grub thob yin zhes snyan grags 'jig rten du khyab dang / /sdom sgo(ra dam nyams red ces gtam ngan sa steng kun gang la/ /'dir snang chos brgyad can la khyad par chen po rang snang ste/ /doni la brag ca'i sgra bzhin phan garnadi spu tsam yang mi 'dug /mi kha bstode smad khyod rang ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni gtam snyan phye gtor mi bsgrub dam bca' rang yin no/ /bde bde skyid skyid ngang la zhim 'jam gsol ba yi mi dang / /sdug bsngal yus yus ngang nas zas gos ngan ngon tsam chol bar/ /sgyu ma'i nyams ma skyes la khyad par chen po rang snang ste/ /'khrul snang rang sar grerdzol la bzang ngan spu tsam yang mi 'dug /nam mkha' 'di la bde sdug phan gnod e 'dug he he ang / /skyid sdug gang 'ong khyod rang ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni gang byung lam du khyer ba dam bca' rang yin no/ /gzugs mdzes lha 'dra dang ni gzugs ngan yi dwags dang 'dra bar/ /'dod ldan skye bo'i snang ngor drag zhan chen po rang 'dug ste/ /chags bral rnal 'gror snang ngor legs nyes spu tsam yang mi 'dug /mdzes ma 'khor dang ma 'kherdzor ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /da ni bzang 'dod byi dor mi byed dam bca' rang yin 84

no/ /brgya stong mang po'i dad 'bul char ltar 'bab pa yi mi dang / /'tsho ba bya tshol sprang zan nangs tshol nub tshol gyi skye bor/ /tha mal byis pa'i snang ngor khyad par chen po rang 'dug ste/ /done la phyug dbul bden med sgyu ma rmi lam gyi rang bzhin/ /sbyin bdag mgu dang mi mgu ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /dkor dang grong chog log 'tsho mi bsgrub dam bca' rang yin no/ /mdor na rnyed dang ma rnyed bde sdug grags pa dang mi grags/ /bstod dang smad pa zhes bya'i 'jig rten 'khor ba yi chos brgyad/ /thams cad smyu ma rmi lam dri za'i grong khyer dang mtshungs pas/ /spang blang re dwogs med pa gang byung lam du rang len no/ /'jig rten chos brgyad thams cad ci dga' gang dga' rang mdzod cig /tshul 'chos tho co jo rdzu mi byed dam bca' rang yin no/ /lus kyis byas byas bsgrubs bsgrubs 'khor ba ngan song gi so nam/ /ngag gis smras smras brjod brjod nyes spyod mi zad pa'i 'byung khungs/ bsams bsams dran dran dug lnga chos brgyad kyiyo lang / /da ni ci dang ci la'ang snying po rdul tsam yang mi 'dug /lus kyis bya spyod kun dor dur khrod mi ro ltar gnas shing / /ngag gis smra brjod kun spangs lkugs pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes bsnyeg /sems kyis dran bsam kun dor :snas bral nam mkha' yi ngang tshul/ /byar med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag pa dam bca' rang yin 85

no/ /de ltar dam bca' 'grub par bla ma yi dam dang mkha' 'gro/ /chos srung bden pa'i mthu yis gegs med mthar phyin du mdzod cig /dge bas 'gro kun 'jig rten chos brgyad 'khor ba yi 'khrul snang / /'khor 'das rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes su smin te/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal sa myur du zin pa'i smone 'dun zhig zhu'o / /byin rlabs 'od phung 'asgo 'asgo gsung ngag rtsa brgyud bla ma yi chogs dang / /dngos grub char rgyun 'beb 'beb yi dam dges bde gsang gsum gyi lha tshogs/ /phrin las blosnag ltar myur myur mkha' 'dza1 chos spyodang gur zhal dang lcam dral/ /mthun 'gyur shis pa'i me tog char bzhin deng 'dir chil chil du phob cig /de skad chos dang 98jig rten gang yang ma nus snyoms las kyi mkhan po/ /sprang rgan 'jam dgrangs blo gsal ming can 'do med dred po des smras so/ /zhes pa 'di'ang rang lo so bdun shing lug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga rje bla ma 'jam dgrangs rgyal mtshan gyi dus dran nyin bris pa'o// 7/ /lo 'di'i stoni rin po che pad+ma bkod nas dgras su phebs pa'i rjes su phyin pas spo 'or slebs dus rin po che mjal 'dod chen po byung ba'i rkyen byas te glu 'di blangs so// a ho/ mgoni dran pas gdung sel rdo rje 'chang / /pha 'dren mchog rgyal po sprul pa'i sku/ /dus snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /mtshan chos kyi blo gros dpal bzang por/ yid re(sa gus gdung bas gsesgol ba 'debs/ /dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /blo the tshom med pa hril ler gtod/ /las skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung 86

yang / /skyabs re sa gzhan du ma mchis pas/ /phas mngoni sum byin rlabs deng stsol cig /rdo rje'i ye shes de snying la 'phos/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam du byin gyis rlobs/ /ya ki zhig dgung sngon gyi klong yangs na/ /khyung chen de rtsanu/ gsum rdzogs pa tsho/ /mtho dgung sngon gyi klong na ye re re/ /nam 'phang de dbyengs su gcod do skad/ /'dab chags kun zil gyis gnon no skad/ /mchu sder de dgra la ngom mo skad/ /dug can de zas su za'o skad/ /khyung phrug nga rtsa'asmi gsum ma rdzogs kyang / /pha khyung chen khyed la lta zhing 'phur/ /sku gsum gyi nalomakha'i klong yangs su/ /lhan cig tu bgrode pa'i rten 'brel zhig /pha khyung chen khyed kyi drin la re/ /ya ki zhig gangs dkar gyi zur phud na/ /seng dkar mo de rtsal gsum rdzogs pa tsho/ /mtho gangs dkar gyi stod la ye re re/ gangs bu yug de rtsal gyis gcod do skad/ /sder chags kun zil gyis garnani no skad/ /g.yu ral de dgra la ngom mo skad/ /gtum po kun gsoni zas byed do skad/ /seng phrug nga rtsal gsum ma rdzogs kyang / /pha seng chen khyed la lta zhing rgyug /bde chen gyi gangs ri'i ngos yangs su/ /lhan cig tu rtsen pa'i rten 'brel zhig /pha seng chen khyed kyi drin la re/ /pha ki zhig tsan+dan gyi nags khrode na/ /rgya stag de rtsal gsum rdzogs pa tsho/ /nags tsan+dan gyi khrod na ye re re/ /nags khrod de rtsal 87

gyis gcod do skad/ /gcan gzan kun zil gyis gnon no skad/ /'dzum drug de dgra la ngom mo skad/ /mi sha de rlon zas byed do skad/ /stag phrug nga rtsal gsum ma rdzogs kyang / /pha rgya stag khyed la lta zhing rgyug /stobes bcu yi tsan+dan nags khrod du/ /lhan cig tu spyod pa'i rten 'brel zhig /pha rgya stag khyed kyi drin la re/ /ma ki zhig gtsang chen gyi chu gzhung na/ /nya chen de rtsal gsum rdzogs pa cho/ /dma' gtsang chen gyi gzhung na ye re re/ /rba klong de rtsal gyis gcod do skad/ /chu gnas kun zil gyis gnyoni no skad/ gser mig de dgra la ngom mo skad/ /dzam+bu yi 'bras bu za'o skad/ /nya phrug nga rtsal gsum ma rdzogs kyang / /pha nya chen khyed la lta zhing rgyug /chos sku yi rgya mtsho'i klong yangs su/ /lhan cig tu rol ba'i rten 'brel zhig /pha nya chen khyed kyi drin la re/ /'di na zhig mdo khams shar phyogs kyi/ /rje bla ma spangs rtogs rdzogs pa tsho/ /kong dbus kyi phyogs su ye re re/ /yang gsang gi gnas sgo 'byed do skad/ /kla klo kun zil gyis gnon no skad/ /mthu stobs de bdud la ngom mo skad/ /bde chen de zas su za'o skad/ /skal ldan kun lam sna 'dren no skad/ /slob bu nga nyams rtsal ma rdzogs kyang / /pha rje btsun khyed la lta zhing rgyug /yang gsang gi 'chi med gnas phyogs su/ /lhan cig tu spyod pa'i rten 'brel zhig /pha rje btsun khyed kyi drin la 88

re/ /ces so// lto/ /lo de'i dgun lha ldan du rin po che mjal zhing gser zho gnyis sogs phul te 'di phyi'i slob ston spyi dang khyad par du gnas skabs bya spyod kyi lung bstan dang / mthar thug chos kyi gnad 'gag ston par zhu ba'i glu 'di phul lo// a ho/ gnas lha ldan sprul pa'i zhing khams su/ /mgon dran pas gdung sel rdo rje 'chang / /pha 'dren mchog rgyal po sprul pa'i sku/ /mtshan chos kyi blo gros dpal bzang po/ /sku zhu bde'i lang tsho gzi 'od 'bar/ /gsung stong nyid rdo rje'i chos sgra sgrogs/ /thugs ting 'dzin 'jug ldang bsam mi khyab/ /'khor mi dang mi min sprin ltar 'du/ /nga'i bla ma byas na rin po che/ /yi dam byas na rin po che/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rin po che/ /chos srung gtso bo rin po che/ /da gong daphro po rin po che/ /phyi ma'i bla ma rin po che/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /las skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /blo tshom med pa hril ler gtod/ /dus rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje'i sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ /lus sprul skur 'char bar byin gyis :snabs/ /rje'i gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ /ngag 'o(ngas skur 'char bar byin gyis rlebes/ /rje'i thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /sems chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rje yid bzhin nor bu'i sku drin gyis/ /gnas skabs kyi bya ba'i blang dor la/ /slobe stod dang lung bstan bstsal du gsol/ /mthar thug 89

gi chos kyi gnad 'gag gi /the tshom dang dwogs pa bsal du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'jam dbyangs bla mar mos ldan pa/ /blo gros rab tu gsal ba nas/ /dris pa'i dri lan 'di lta ste/ /'chi med pad+ma bkod pa yi/ /phyi yi sbas lung 'ga' zhig las/ /yang gsang gnas 〉( re zhig la/ /mi 'byed snyam yang nges pa ci/ /khyed cag da skabs spo kong sogs/ /gang bde gang skyid dag tu sdod/ /spyodi 'jug la sogs dam pa'i chos/ /'chad 'os rnams la 'chad pa sogs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub la brtson/ /zhes sogs rdo rje'i gsung gi dbugs dbyung rgyas par bstsal// 7/ /de skabs pha yul nas mar 'ong dgos tshul gyi yi ge rim par 'gror ba'i lan du/ a ho/ sngoni chad don med 'khor ba'i las la yengs/ /da ni mi tshe lhag ma ci yod kun/ /gnas mchog pad+ma bkod dang tsa ri tra/ /sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs dang mkhan pa ljongs/ /nges med grong dang bas mtha' nags khrod du/ /bza' gtad med par phyur+sha pa bzhin du rgyu/ /rtse gcig snying po'i sgrub la mi brtson re/ /zhes sogs kyi yig lan kho na bskur nas 'gro ba'i grabs tsam yang ma byas so// lto/ /jo bo'i mdun maṇ+ḍal phyag mchod sogs ci nus byas te/ smon lam gyi gtso bor gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa 'dzin nus pa dang / rin po che'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par byed nus par shog ces pa kho na btab cing / gdung ba'i dgrangs kyis gsol 'debs 'di'ang byas so// a ho/ chos sku skye med nam mkha'i bu mo yi lto bar/ /'ordzongs sku 'gag med chu 'dzin dkar dmar gyi sbyodar bas/ /sprul sku 90

'gag med sbrang char gzhon nu yi rol gar/ /lha gcig jo bo yid bzhin nor bu khyed mkhyen no/ /sku gsum dbyer med ston mchog shākya yi seng ge'i/ /rnam mkhyen ye shes mchog gi sgyu 'phrul gyi rang gzugs/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i dpal mgon mngon sum du shar ba/ /mnyam med jo bo yid bzhin nor bu yi mtshan dpe/ /mngon sum mig gi dbang po'i bdud rtsi ru gyur te/ /bsags sbyangs maṇ+ḍal mchode pa'i bya ba la rems pas/ /dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa doni ldan du gyur song / /gang zhabs dma' ba'i zhabs sen nor bu yi nye drung / /dad gsum bser bus bskul ba'i ljoni bzang gi phung po/ /phyag 'tshal yal 'dab gsar pa lang long du g.yo zhing / /ser sna'i 'dam gyis ma gosari ting 'dzin gyi yid mkhar/ /bkod legs mchod sprin me tog 'dzum rlabs de bzhad par/ sdig ltung dri ma'i 'bags btsog rtsa ba nas sbyong ba'i/ /stobes bzhi bdud rtsi'i gru char sim sim du 'bebs shing / /bsam nag phrag dog gdug pa'i tsha gdung las skyobo pa'i/ /yi rangs sprin dkar phung po lang long du g.yo bar/ /rab gus ba spu'i gzhog yangs ling ling du bskyodi de/ /skul tshig khu byug mgrin rol lhang lhang du bsgrags pas/ /lhag bsam sbrang rtsi gsar pa'i btung ba yis myos pa'i/ /bzhugs gsol bung ba'i glu dbyangs dar dir du sgyur bzhin/ /'khor gsum rnam 91

par dkar ba'i nor 'dzin gyi zhing sar/ /bsngo smon dgrar gyi dpal mo'i dga' stod la spyod do/ /a ho/ 'gog bden rtogs pa chos sku'i dwangs ma yi mkha' las/ /lam bden lung gi 'od zer bye ba yi rang bzhin/ /dpyad gsum shing rtas gdul bya'i pad tshal la 'dren pa'i/ /bstan pa nyin mo'i snang ba yun ring du gnas pa'i/ /jo —1 yid bzhin nore bus byin gyis rang rlobes shig /tshul khrims mdzes ma'i mtshar sdug sman ljongs kyi do rwar/ /ting 'dzin bzhin ras nam mkha'i me tog gis gsos te/ ṣes rab rtse dga'i sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar de skyong ba'i/ /bstan rtsa dge 'dun bung ba gzhon nu'i sde rgyas par/ /jo bo yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang :snabs shig /rnam dag tshul khrims gser gyi sa gzhi yi dbus su/ /rnam mang thos pa'i chu gter bsrubs pa las thon pa'i/ /rnam grol ting 'dzin rin chen bye ba yi rang bzhin/ /bstan 'dzin ri rgyal zhabs pad yun ring du brtan par/ /jo bo yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang rlobs shig /dad pa rgya mtsho'i 'jings la gnas mal rang bcas nas/ /gtong ba chu klung bye ba bsam yas su spros te/ /bstan pa 'dzin ma'i skyed tshal gong 'phel du gtong ba'i/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag klu dbang dpal 'gror dang ldan par/ /jo sto yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang rlobs shig /mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshon snan 'bar ba yi dpung 92

gis/ /nag phyogs kla klo lha min phye ma ru bcom ste/ /dkar phyogs rgyal bstan lha gnas srog bzhin du skyong ba'i/ /bstan srung lha dbang dbu 'phang dgung sngone dang mnyam par/ /jo 'o yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang rlobes shig /bsam nag dug gi kha rlangs phyogs bcu ru 'thul zhing / /sbyodar nag lha min gdug pa'i mche sder kun bgrad de/ /bstan pa nyin mo'i snang ba glo bur du bcom pa'i/ /bstan dgra sgra gcan gdug pa'i 'tshe ba dang bral bar/ /jo 11 yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang rlobs shig /skyabs gsum gser gyi sa gzhi brtan po yi dbus su/ /nges 'byung thar pa'i sa bon grung po ru btab par/ /byang sems ljang bu phyin drug drod gsher gyis bskyed de/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor 'bras bu yis sgeg par/ /jo 'o yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang rlobs shig /smin byed dbang gi rgyal rigs mthon po ru skyes te/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i rdzong chen dpa' ba yi dbus su/ /mthar lta'i bdud tshogs gzhom pa'i lta ba yi dmag dpon/ /rim gnyis rnal 'gror zab mo'i mdzes ma yi skyo grogs/ /tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi ldan ying bzhin gyi nor bu/ /rten 'brel gnad la mkhas pa'i shes gsal gyi blon po/ /snye7dus gsum 'phrang las sgrol ba'i spyod pa yi glang po/ /grub mtha'i gling bzhi bskor ba'i sa lam gyi rta mchog /bde stong rgyun chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 93

'khor lo/ /rang byung ye shes chen po'i bu stong dang bcas te/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mchog gi rgyal sa la 'dzeg nas/ /ma rgan 'grerdzo ba 'dren pa'i snying stobes la 'khyol bar/ /jo bo yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rang rlobs shig /slo pa'ang sa khyi zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la lha ldan jo bo yid bzhin nor bu'i mdun gsol ba btab pa'o// lto/ /rgya gar du rin po che'ang sku gshegs zer ba'i gtam ngan thos pa sogs gang sa ci thad nas zhe skyo ba kho na byung ba'i tshe skyo glu 'di blangs so// kye ma kye hud khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'aspo/ /bzod med duḥ kha drag pos mnar pa 'di/ /sngon chad mthong thos nges shes gtan nas med/ /da lan rang thog mngon sum myong ba 'dis/ /bzod glags med pa'i mchi ma gting nas 31ra/ /rgyal rnams thugs rjes bdag la gzigs su gserdzol/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che/ /rlung gseb gnas pa'i mar me ji bzhin du/ /yun ring mi gnas rtags ngan 'di mthong tshe/ /skyo ba'i snying rlung gting nas ldangs par gyur/ /thog med brtse bas bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /gsor ba'i gcong nad drag pos gzir ba'i thog /snyigs ma'i duḥ khas mnar ba 'di mthong tshe/ /bzod med snying rje'i mchi ma lhung bar 'gyur/ /khyad par snying ltar gces pa'i gcung nge de/ /dbang med gzhan ji) yul du sprugs pa la/ /bsams bzhin mig nas mchi ma yang yang babs/ /'di la cadags bcu'i sangs rgyas ma ga༈rdzogs pa/ skyabs gnas re sa gzhan du ma mchis pas/ /de bzhin gnyegs 94

rnams de yi gnyen matsodi la/ /myur du ngos 'phrad 'byung ba mdzad du gsol/ khye hud 'di phyi tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs/ /drin chen bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /mi mngon dbyings su gshegs zhes 'di bden na/ /kye ma da ni skyabs gnas su la re/ /kye ma kyi hud kye ma kyi hud ang / /dpal mgoni bla ma rnams ni zhi bar gshegs/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma ring du mi gnas mthong / /'gro ba'i bde skyid zad nas sdug la thug /'di la drin chen bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag po/ /khyed las skyabs gnas re sa gzhan med pas/ /khyed kyang zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /bstan dang 'grerdzo 'di yal bar dor gyur na/ /kye ma da ni su zhig skyabs gnas 'gyur/ /kyi hud 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /ngan 'gro gdug pa'i rba rlabs g.yo ba can/ /las kyi rlung dmar drag pos bdas pa la/ /nyon mongs smin po'i tshogs kyis btses gyur pa'i/ /mi bzod sdug bsngal gyis mnar 'gro ba 'di/ /yal bar dor nas mgon khyod zhir gzims na/ /sngoni gyi thugs bskyed yal bar mi 'gyur ram/ /kyi hud snyigs ma'i 'gyur ba 'di 'dra la/ /'jigs nas mgoni khyed zhi bar gzims gyur na/ /grangs med bskal par 'gro 33 go bgos te/ / stobs bcu mnga' ba don med ma lags sam/ /kye ma kyi shud kye ma kyi ṅgād 95

ang / /rje btsun bla ma dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /skal ldan bdag ni 'kherdzor ba'i gnas 'dir lus/ /nyam thag byis pas pha ma 'bod pa bzhin/ /mchi ma'i rgyun dang ngu ba'i smre sngags bcas/ /gdung ba'i nga ros 'o dod bos gyur kyang / /mgoni khyed dgyes pa 'i zhal bzang mi ston na/ /blun rmongs bdag gi snying 'di gas la thug /nyin dran mtshan dran rje btsun bla ma dran/ /bde dang skyid na rje btsun bla ma dran/ /sdug dang dbul na rje btsun bla ma dran/ /mtho dang 'gror na rje btsun bla ma dran/ /dma' dang rgud na rje btsun bla ma dran/ /na tsha 'jigs skag 'khrul snang sdug bsngal dang / /tha na rmi lam yul du'ang 'jigs skrag tshe/ /ma〈snan skyabs dpung gnyen rje btsun bla ma dran/ /'dod yoni dga' bde zhim dgu mdzes bcu dang / /tha na rmi lam yul du yid 'ong dngos/ /bsnyen bkur mchod yul dpal mgoni bla ma dran/ /bla ma dran pas snying gis ma bzod nas/ /gdung ba'i nga ros 'o dod sos pa 'di/ /mgon khyed zhing khams gang du bzhugs gyur kyang / /mi las 'das pa'i snyan gyis gsan lags pas/ /dngos nyams rmi lam nyams kyi snang cha la/ /zhal bstan gsung gis dbugs dbyung stsal du gsol/ /kye ma kyi hud kye ma kyi hud ang / /bde tshen zhu bde'i gzi byin cher 'bar zhing / /mthong bas tha mal snang ba gtan 'gag pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sku yi 96

bkod pa dran nas byung / /grag stong skye med chos kyi rang sgra can/ /thos pas ngan 'gro'i sgo 'phar gcod byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi gdangs de yang dran byung / /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes can/ /dran pas tha mal snang ba 'gog byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i thugs kyi ye shes snying nas dran/ /ji ltar brtags kyang skyon zad yon tan can/ /dran pas dad pa'i mchi ma g.yo byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i yoni tan snying nas dran par gyur/ /ji ltar spyad pa rnam dkar spyod pa can/ /rjes su slob tshad gtan bde la sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje'i phrin las can de dran nas byung / /gdod nas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi/ /ye shes sku bzhi'i ngo bor byin brlabs shing / /cir snang thams cad chos sku'i zhing khams su/ /rang ngo sprad pa'i bka' drin 'di bsams tshe/ /bzod glags med pa'i mosnas gus me ltar 'bar/ ri/lus kyi ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma g.yerdzo/ /ngag gi ca co'i gdung dbyangs dbang med shor/ /mos gus shes pa gtad‘med za zi 'ur/ /'di 'dra mgon khyed zhing khams gar bzhugs kru/nga / /sgrib med ye shes spyan :mis gzigs lags pas/ /lngardzos ldan bu la byin gyis brlab tu gasku(la/ /'khesar ba'i mun khang chags sdang tshang tshing can/ /ngan 'grerdzo gdug pa'i g.yang gis khengs pa 'di/ /ye shes 'od rdul lhung bas de ma thag /gtan bde'i snang ba'i dpal la sbyor byed pa'i/ /97

rje btsun nyin byed dbang po gang du gshegs/ /thugs rje'i tsha zer can de gang du gshegs/ /thar pa'i dmig bu rje btsun gang du gshegs/ /spangs rtogs dkyil 'khor can de gang du gshegs/ /byin rlabs 'od phung can de gang du gshegs/ /smin byed dbang bskur bum bzang gang du gshegs/ /grol byed gdams ngag ded dponi gang du gshegs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo gang du gshegs/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgoni dam pa gang du gshegs/ /kyi hud mgod khyed zhi bar gzims bden na/ /'aspo ba'i mig rnams dus gcig ldongs gyur cing / /mi re'i khog nas snying re bton pa dang / /bstan pa'i nyi ma cig car sgrib par gyur/ /khyad par bdag gi snying 'di thon nam snyam/ /gdung ba'i ngu 'bod bu chung pha ma bzhin/ /yid skyo'i rig pa snres pa'i shes pa bzhin/ /gtad med sgyu lus bal 'dab bzhin du 'dar/ /'gro na 'dug snyam 'dug na 'gro snying 'dod/ /nyal na ldang 'dod ldangs na nyal snying 'dod/ /'di 'dra'i snying rlung las kyis bskyed pa la/ /gso ba'i thabs gzhan srid 'dir ma rnyed pas/ /mgoni khyed bzhugs pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ /myur du drongs shig rje btsun bla ma kye/ /sngon gyi rgyal dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams skyob par zhal bzhes bzhin/ /maphro khyed 'gro don snying rje'i go bgos te/ /snyigs ma'i dus 98

'dir rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bskyangs/ /'di 'dra ngo mtshar bas kyang ngo mtshar na/ /da dus 'gro 'di yal bar dor nas khyed/ /zhi bar gzims pa'i tshul 'di ci'i tha tshig /gang sku mthong dang gang gsung thos pa dang / /gang thugs ngang du mnyam bzhag smos ci 'tshal/ /gang zhig 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo grerdzos zhes/ /gang rgi mtshan tsam thos pa'ang doni ldan pa'i/ /rje btsun bla ma dran nas bzod glags med/ /kyi hud 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i chu geter che/ /ngan 'gro gdug pa'i rba rlabs g.yo ba las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon lan gcig rnyed pa de/ /rmi lam nor rnyed bzhin du dbyings su yal/ /kye ma da ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /thar pa'i dmig bu sa lam ded dponi che/ /'di phyi'i skyabs gnas mabod khyed zhir gzims na/ /skal dman bdag cag gsoni pas ci zhig bya/ /lus 'di gtub nas mchodi dam ci byed ang / /'on te rje btsun gang gi zhal snga nas/ /'khor 'das chos kun rang sems cho 'phrul dang / /sems nyid gsal rnyesnang bla ma sku gsum du/ /rang ngo sprod pa'i tshul la bsgoms pa yi/ /nyams su myong ba'i rtogs tshad ma mchis kyang / /mos pa'i go yul rdo la ri mo bzhin/ /mi ldog yid ches snying nas rnyed 'di tsam/ /da lta'i dus na skyo grogs gcig pur gyur/ /cir snang bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor shar/ /sgra rnams grag stong rdo rje'i sngags su shes/ /99

dran rtog rig stong thugs kyi dkrol 'khor rtogs/ /snang grag rtog tshogs lha sngags chos kyi sku/ /ye nas rang gsal bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gshegs bzhugs 'du 'bral med par rgyun du mjal/ /bdag mdun dam ye mchog dman ma dmigs pa'i/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs pa'i phyag gis bsnyen/ /gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin rtog pas ma bslad pa'i/ /snang srid ma bcos lhug pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /dug lnga ye shes lnga ru ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /spang blang bsal bzhag bral ba'i ngang du bshags/ /chos kun dbyings su rol pa'i bla ma la/ /mdzad pa bzang ngan med par rjes yi rangs/ /sgra rnams grag stong rdo rje'i chos sgra ste/ /snyan dang mi snyan med pa'i chos 'khor bskul/ /snang srid ye nas bla ma'i dkyil 'kherdzor la/ /gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral bas bzhugs su gserdzol/ /chos can kun btags glo bur dge ba'i tshogs/ /chos nyid yongs grub gnyug ma'i dbyengs su bsngo/ /bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs thugs yid dbyer med bsre/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur sgrub pa'i mchodi pa 'bul/ /bla ma'i sku drin mos gus dad pas gzhal/ /bla ma'i mdzad phrin bdag gzhan dbyer med skyong / /rang sems bla ma'i rang zhal rgyun du mjal/ /rang rig chos sku'i ngang du 'du 'bral med/ /rang gzhan snang ba'i bla ma phyi nas shar/ /rang grerdzol rig pa'i bla ma nang nas shar/ /100

rang stong chos sku'i bla ma dbyings nas shar/ /rang gsal gzugs sku'i bla ma cir yang shar/ /rang snang phyi nang med pa bla mar shar/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma'i bla ma 'du ma hote/ /zhes sogs gdung dgrangs kyi smre 'a'od kyang byas so// ༈ /gtsang phyogs la thon khar 'brang stod lcam me tog sgol dkar nas zhal gdams dgos zhes nan tan chen yos bskul ngor 'di smras so// kye ho dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes phung po gcig tu 'dus pa'i gzugs/ /drin chen bla ma 'jam dgrangs rnam gsum rdzi /rdo rje'i ye shes khyod la byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi mtha' ma 'dir/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i sgoni me nub rir brgal/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad khri mun chud/ /bstan rtsa dge 'dun tshochogs rnams khrims kyis mnar/ /rten gsum ma chod yul phyag dar khrod du bor/ /rang gzhan dbang med bdud kyi bran du bskosnal/ /'di 'dra'i dbang med sdug gis mnar ba la/ /lus ngag dal bar sdod pa'i dbang med kyang / /'gro 'dug za nyal spyodi lam thams cad du/ /chos sku'i dran pa nam yang ma brjed na/ /gar serdzong gar bsdad chos sku'i zhing khams yin/ /ci bya ci byas chos sku'i rol pa yin/ /gang za gang 'thung chos sku'i 'tsho ba yin/ /bde sdug cir snang chos sku'i yo lang yin/ /gang shar gang rtog chos sku'i rig pa yin/ /chos sku'i rnal 'gror ji ltar byas kyang skyed/ /mtho dman 101

'gror rgud rmi lam snang ba 'dra/ /bde sdug snang ba sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'dra/ /'dod yon dngos med chu yi zla ba 'dra/ /don la thob shor med par blo thag chod/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'gror bde sdug rdzun du zad/ /skye rgu rgyu 'bras log pa'i lam du zhugs/ /dbang med bdud kyi bran du bskardzol dus 'dir/ /gcig tu sgrub la gzhol skal med na yang / /srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi spong / /rgyal srid ched du'ang dkoni mchog blos mi gtong / /ci la thug kyang rgyu 'bras khyad mi gsode/ /mgo bo bregs kyang phan sems blos mi gtong / /gshed mas brab kyang dran pa gsum mi brjed/ /de ltar byas na 'di skyid phyi mar skyid/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan/ /phyi ma bde chen zhing du 'phrad par snror+sha/ /zhes gdams te gtsang phyogs su thon// 7/ /de mtshams kha'u brag rdzong du phyin pa na brag phug gcig nas dpe 'di 'dra zhig rnyed byung ba/ nga rang la'ang rje bla mas 'da' kha'i zhal chems su gnang ba yin nam snyam tshags byas pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ zhal gdams rin chen mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgos bka' drin can gyi byin gyis rlobs/ /grogs khyed kyis mgur ma dgos zhes zer/ /mi nga la mgur ma snyan po med/ /mgur rdo rje'i thol glu zhes pa de/ /rje grub thob rnams kyi do ha yin/ /lar sprang po nga yis blun gtam gyis/ /bu khyed la gdams ngag gsal 'debs zhu/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgoni/ /pha drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /khyed shes kyi dad mos drag 102

po yis/ /kha tsam min snying nas gsol ba thob/ /gsol ba de ji ltar 'debs zer na/ /mos gus kyi gzer chen snying la thob/ /dam tshig gi sa gzhi gtsang gyur na/ /nyams rtogs kyi dpag bsam sdong po 'khrungs/ /mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par nges/ /sngon bsags kyi dge ba'i 'bras bu las/ /dus da res dal wang mi lus 'di/ /nor bu rnyed pa'i do zla min/ /tshe 'di phyi'i wo chen bsgrub 'dod na/ /dus da res snyoms las ma gtong zhig /de snga phan dgos med bya bas 'das/ /mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mang sbyangs kyang / /kha 3(ga lce rlung gis bskyod pa las/ /don nyams len rgyud la sbyor ba dka'/ /de bsam grin bsam grin snying rlung ldang / /mi tshe nyi ma stosnang zad thal/ /dgra 'chi bdag gzhin rjes mdun na sgug /khosgos zhags pa nam 'debs mi shes shing / /dus n+da/ra ba nyid du shi ran gda'/ /lo zla ba zhag dang nyin mtshan zad/ /tshe srog 'di mar me rlung 'ded mtshungs/ /rkyen ci 'ong nges pa med pas na/ /sbos sang byed gnangs byed dbang ma gtong / /'phral 'phral du lag len thebs par mdzod/ /'chi ba de nam 'ong cha med cing / /'chi rkyen la nges pa med pa'i phyir/ /dus da res thob pa'i lus rten 'di/ /yag nyes gnyis kyi sa mtshams yin/ /rtsu1nga bltab na de las phangs pa med/ /khe thob na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub/ /tshe 'di phyi'i 103

legs tshogs ji snyed pa/ /lus 'di yi steng nas bsgrub dgos pas/ /de thugs la yang yang bsam pa dang / /las 'bras la yid ches bskyed nas ni/ /dge sdig gi spang blang nan tan gyis/ /las mi dges ngan song gsum du 'phen/ /zag bcas kyi dge bas mtho ris skye/ /de gtan du thar ba ma yin zhing / /dman nyan rang gtan du thar gyur kyang / /lam gyi sgrub thabs dman pa dang / /rang zhi bde'i mtha' la lhung bas na/ /gzhan phan gyi bsam pa rgya chen pos/ /chos theg pa chen po'i nyams len bya/ /dus deng sang rang gi don du ni/ /mtshams bsnyen sgrub thos bsam byed pa serdzogs/ /ming theg pa chen por khas 'che yang / /doni dman lam tsam las yar ma phyin/ /bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dis phung bas/ /bdag med kyi don la bsam par gyis/ /de rig pas dpyad nas klu sgrub kyi/ /dbu ma'i gzhung ltar gtan la phebe/ /des bdag 'dzin mgo bo sto par 'gyur/ /ros zab mo gsang sngags rdo rje theg /de'i yang rtse dges pa rdo rje yin/ /dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma la/ /bka' babs pa'i gsung ngag rin po cher/ /nyams len gyi phugs thag chod par mdzod/ /chos yang zab rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /gnad zab mo bla ma'i drin nyid dang / /dpal birla pa yi snyan brgyud lgi /gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu gnyis/ /khrid tshul de rim 104

dang cig car gyi/ /khyad tsam las doni gnad gcig tu 'bab/ /lar grub mtha' kun la phyogs ris spongs/ /nges don gyi gnas lugs zab mo la/ /yid ches dang dad mos brtan po gyis/ /bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu ma mang bar/ /'dod chung dang chog shes rgyun du bsten/ /lus po de ci mi snyam ma skyur/ /zas gos de gang 'dzoms legs par bsten/ /dus da lta lus la dka' spyad na/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum myur du rgud/ /de rgud na nyams len byed mi nus/ /don de phyir lus la gces spras mdzod/ /dpal kye yi rdo rje'i lam dbang de/ /ma chag pa rgyun du len par mdzod/ /mos bshad sgrub gnyis las sgrub pa gtso/ /bsgrub ma nus ye shes rtogs pa ci/ /nus phra mo tsam yang thob par dka'/ /bu de phyir gsang sngags sgrub la brtsone/ /a ho ye/ chos thams cad gdod nas ka dag la/ /sems glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas bsgribs/ /dri ma de gshis la zhugs pa med/ /de chos kyi dbyings su rang ngo mthong / /'od gsal ba'i ye shes snang ba yis /khams gsum gyi 'khrul pa zad de thal/ /'khrul ma smyu1nga sku gsum rang bzhin la/ /da bla ma'i drin gyis gshis der 'byams/ /gzugs snang ba thams cad 'al ma 'ol/ /sgra grag kun brag ca lta bur zad/ /sems 'gyu ba wal wol rjes med song / /nga rnal 'gror rtogs pa'i khyad chos yin/ /lus na bar snang yang na 105

ba med/ /cir snang kun de la der 'dzin med/ /spyodad pa la rtsis gdab dang bral ba/ /nga rnal 'gror :ni pa'i spyodi tshul yin/ /yar sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra chen dang / /mar 'khor ba zhes pa'i sdug skad gnyis/ /nga gnyis med rtogs pa'i rtogs ldan la/ /re ba dang 〈snags pa bcang ma mchis/ /'bras sku gsum gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ /bu a pho rang la tshang nas gda'/ tshig de skad kha pho ches song yang / /nga grub thob brgyud pa'i bu yin pas/ /gshis bcos med ngang nas therdzol 3)sa 31ra/ /zhes pa'ang rang slob rin chen 'bras ljongs nas bod la bzhud pa'i tshe mgur dgos so zhes bskul ba'i ngor choso 2 31 gros pas bris pa'o// 7/ /dpal sa skya'i zhabs bstan lha khang du bsnyen sgrub skabs rje btsun gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas khyad par can du nges shes rnyed de gdung dgrangs kyi gsol 'debs 'di'ang byas so// a ho/ gnas mchog sa la 'og min dpal ldan gyi sa skya/ /ston pa rdo rje 'chang dbang 'khon gdung gi skyes bu/ /'khor chogs sa bcu'i byang sems phyogs 'dus kyi mkhas grub/ /dam chos theg pa chen po mdo sngags kyi 'khor lo/ /rtag pa rgyun du bskor ba'i dga' ston 'di a ho/ /byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs bod yul gyi gnas su/ /'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo mngon sum du byon nas/ /rab 'byams mdo sngags shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhugs pa/ /brtse chen kun dga' snying po snying dbus nas dran byung / /mkha' spyodad mkha' 'dzasna 'du ba'i dga' tshal gyi dbus su/ /mkha' la bya rgyal bzhin du 106

mngon sum du 'phyasdo nas/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dpon du bzhugs pa'i/ /mkha' spyod 'ja' lus bsod nams rtse mo de dran byung / /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs rje'i ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bye ba'i gtsug rgyan du bzhengs pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gsang mdzod ma lus kyi bdag po/ /jo rje'i bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan de dran byung / /'jam dpal gdode nas rnyasnas bral chos sku yi dbyings nas/ /'jam dbyangs ye shes phung po longs sku yi rang mdangs/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsang gsum sprul sku yi snang brnyan/ /'jam mgoni sa skya paṇa chen snying dbus nas dran byung / /sa bcu'i byang sems 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs kyi dbus su/ /sa gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi bla ma ru bzhengs te/ /sa steng dkar 'byams gtong ba'i phrin las kyi byed po/ /sa chen chos rgyal 'phags pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /'jam dbyangs dī paṃ kā ra'i lung bstan dang mthun pa/ /'jam dgrangs rigs kyi phreng ba mu tig ltar byon te/ /'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mdzad pa ltar mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud khyod rnams snying dbus nas dran byung / /rigs gsum rigs kyi phreng ba bar med du byon nas/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po ru bzhengs te/ /rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya smin grol la bkodi pa'i/ /rigs ldan 'khon gyi brgyud pa snying 107

dbus nas dran byung / /rgyal bas rgyal ba lung bstan rgyal kun gyi spyi gzugs/ /rgyal sras sa bcu'i dbus na rgyal ba ltar zhabs bskasnad/ /rgyal bas rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ji bzhin du mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun dga' bzang po snying dbus nas dran byung / /sa steng 'di na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug tshar chen chos rje la sogs pa/ /sa gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon du bzhugs pa'i/ /sa skya'i mkhas grub rim byoni snying dbus nas dran byung / /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes kyi spyi gzugs/ /rtsa gsum rab 'byams 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/ /mchog gsum ma lus 'dus pa'i skyabs gnas kyi mthar thug /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /cir snang bla ma sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor du shes shing / /sgra rnams grag stong bla ma longs sku yi grong khyer/ /dran rtog bla ma chos sku'i dkyil gsor gyi dbyengs las/ /nam yang 'da' ba med par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'khor ba gdod nas rnam dag chos sku yi bla ma/ /myang 'das glo bur dri bral gzugs sku yi bla ma/ /'khor 'das dbyer med bla ma sku gsum gyi zhing khams/ /dag pa gnyis ldan mjal bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /snang grag rig gsum rgyal ba sku gsum gyi zhing khams/ /cir snang snedi bcud mos gus phyag chen gyi yo lang / /lus ngag yid 108

gsum bla ma'i gsang gsum gyi dkyil gsor/ /gsor 'das lam gsum rdo rje'i ye shes kyi rang gzugs/ /thams cad bla mar 'char bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /dbang gi ye shes mos gus phyag chen gyi dbyengs su/ /'khor 'das rtog pa'i rdzun ris btsan thabs su dgag pa'i/ /dbang po yang rab cig car rigs can gyi nyams len/ /lam zab bla ma 'char bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /dbang thob dam tshig 〈snam pa mig bzhin du bsrung bas/ /phyi nang rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur te/ /sa lam yoni tan thams cad rang shugs kyis bgrode pu 'i/ /dbang 'bring nyams len 'grong bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /dbang dang dam tshig rim gnyis las byung gi ye shes/ /lus la so sor rtog pa'i rten phrel gyi 'gog pas/ /sa lam yon tan rim pa ji bzhin du bgrod pa'i/ /dbang tha'i nyams len rdzogs par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /thun mong chos bdun 'khor 'das dbyer med du shes shing / /'khor ba'i nyams bdun 'dus gsum spyod gsum du bsres te/ /'das pa'i chos bzhi ma 'dres star chags su 'char ba'i/ /rgyas chos bco brgyad 'gyong bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /thos bsam phyi yi mtha' rgya bskyed pa zhig med kyang / /nyams len nang gi sgro 'dogs ma lus kun chod de/ /rgyu dang ngo bo phan yon gegs sel dang sa mtshams/ /'bring po'i 109

chos lngar dril bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'khor 'das chos kun ngo bo rang bzhin dang mtshan nyid/ /ting 'dzin nyams kyi snang ba rnam gsum du bsres te/ /spros med bhu su ku yi nyams len la gzhol ba'i/ /lam bsdus chos gsum 'grong bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /bye mdo rnal 'gyor spyod pa dbu ma dang gsang sngags/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len ma lus kun tshang ba'i/ /skal dman rim 'jug gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i/ /grub chen nag po pa bzhin byin gyis rang rlobs shig /thog ma nyid nas dngos gzhi'i sngags lam la zhugs te/ /rgyu gnas dbang lam lta sgrub 'bras bu yis bsdus pa'i/ /gnad drug bkri ba'i gzhung shing tshul bzhin du 'grongs te/ /dbang rnon rigs can grol bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /sbyang ba lus kyi rba rlabs ngag 'dren zhi drag dang phyag rgya/ /bogs 'byen spyode pa che chung sems gyi lo rlabs dang sa mtshams/ /'gros thim bcu gcig gnad kyi bkri ba yi gzhung shing / /bde chen rdo rje'i rba rlabs bzhi pa yi lam nas/ /skal ldan cig car tshe gcig mchog dngos la sbyor ba'i/ /ḍom+bi he ru ka bzhin byin gyis rang rlobs shig /thun mong theg pa che chung 'khor 'das dbyer med la bslab cing / /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug phyogs gnas kyi rnal 'gyor/ /re re la'ang dbang po rab 'bring tha ma yi bkri tshul/ /chos dang 110

gang zag 'dzol ba med par byin gyis rang :snabs shig /lam dang phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pa phan 'dogs rnam bdun gyi man ngag /lam du bsre ba 'grerdzos bzhi phyi nang mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang bcas pa'i/ /gzhung shing bzhi yis bskyed pa'i nyams myong sogs 'byin rtogs bskyed kyi chos lngas/ /ting 'dzin nyams kyi snang ba gong nas gong 'phel byin gyis rang rlobs shig /bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun byung rgyal mi gtasnang ba'i gnad bzhi/ /'byung ba 'u/sa 'khrug bsal byed phrin las serdzo gnyis dang bcas pa'i/ /gegs sel yi ge rnam bzhi'i nyams len gnad thog tu khel te/ /bgrod dka' 'khor ba'i 'phrang las grol bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /bdag med rdo rje btsun mo mngon sum du byon nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rnal 'gyor dbang phyug la gdams te/ /bdag cag 'dren pa mchog bar ring brgyud du byon pas/ /bdag gi sgo gsum smin grol byin gyis rang rlobs shig /grub pa'i gnas mcho go dpal ldan sa skya yi gnas su/ /grub chen rnal 'gror dbang phyug mngon su ma du byon nas/ /grub pa'i nye brgyud sbas don gsal ba ru gdams bzhin/ /grub mtha'i nye lam ba〉thog par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla chen snying po yi zhabs kyis/ /rdo rje'i sras po rje btsun grags pa yi mtshan la/ /rdo rje'i brda doni shin tu nye brgyud kyis gdams 111

bzhin/ /rdo rje'i gsang lam rnyed par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /de ltar ring brgyud nye brgyud shin tu nye brgyud kyi gdams pa/ /gnad du che ba drug dang lam 〉sgor rnam dgu yi man ngag /gser ros bcu gsum lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i sbos bzhi/ /dgyes bde gsang gsulodus 'khor gshed dmar dang 'jigs byed/ /dmar po dmar mo dmar chung skor gsum dang chos skyong / /gur zhal snyan brgyud thun mong thun min gi gdams pa/ /tshogs bshad kun dang mi 'gal thun mong gi lam bzang / /:rtob bshad na/na las khyad 'phags thun min 2) gdams pa/ /snyan brgyud chig brgyud zhal ngo nang brgyud kyi gdams ngag /theg gsum spyo1ma pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i lam rim ma tshang ba med pa'i/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rang rlobes shig /gangs can bod kyi ljongs 'dir bka' gter gsar rnying dang mdo sngags/ /dam chos gdams ngag rin chen kun gyis thang ma ru brdal yang / /dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i rgyud tshod 'tshams pa yi bkri tshul/ /rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len phyogs gcig tu dril ba/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu las lhag bordzo /'dzam gling tha gru kun tu khyab par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /ces dang // 7/ /a ho/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi blo 112

gros/ /yi dam lhag pa'i lha mchog dges pa rdo rje/ /grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bdag med ma dpal/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i sde dpon gur zhal lcam dral/ /snying gi pad+mor bzhugs gsol rtse gcig 'debs so/ /nyin snang chos kun dbyings kyi ltad mor mthong cing / /mtshan dus 'od gsal mdzes mas 'bral med 'khyud pas/ /snang mun bar lag 'gyel bar byin gyis rlobes shig /mnyam bzhag srid zhi'i rtog tshogs dbyengs su 'gag cing / /rjes thob yul snang ye shes rol par shar bas/ /mnyam rjes ye shes 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs shig /'dir snang khye'u chung rim gnyis dpal la spyod cing / /'chi tshe 'od gsal chos sku'i a ma mjal bas/ /'od gsal ma bu 'phrad par byin gyis rlobs shig /'khor ba gdod ma'i 'edi gsal sku gsum lhun grub shes shing / /myang 'das gnas 'gyur sku gsum 'bras bu'i 'od gsal mngoni gyur te/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu sku gsum 'od gsal dbyer med du shes pa'i/ /'od gsal 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobes shig /a ho/ gti mug gnyis kyi mun khang du/ /'od gsal chos sku'i zla ba shar/ /snang mun bar lag dbyings su 'gyel/ /rjes thob gzung 'dzin nags tshal du/ /mnyam bzhag ye shes me chen 'bar/ /mnyam sdos sa mtshams dbyer med 'dres/ /'chi ba mya ngan thang chen 113

nas/ /'chi med chos sku'i a ma mjal/ /skye shi'i bar lag dbyings su 'gyel/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal grong khyer 'di/ /myang 'das bde chen zhing du shar/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rang ngo 'phrod/ /a ho/ 'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma ste/ /yid kyi dpal gyur lhag pa'i lha maskro ga khyed/ /mi shigs snying gi thig ler gar mdzad bzhin/ /gnyis snang mun pa sel ba'i gnyen mdzad de/ /'od gsal ye shes snang bas khyab par mdzod/ /a ho/ 'od gsal ye shes sku can rje bla ma/ /'od gsal bde chen ye shes dges mdzad mgoni/ /'od gsal dbyengs kyi btsun mo bdag med ma/ /'od gsal ye shes sbyin mdzad tā re yum/ /'od gsal lam gyi grogs mchog nag yo che/ /'od gsal dbyengs kyi grogs mo 'dod khams ma/ /'od gsal lam gyi gegs sel gdong bzhi pas/ /'od gsal ye shes 'char ba'i gnyen mdzod cig /nyin mo'i 'od gsal chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /mtshan mo'i 'od gsal mar me gtams pa bzhin/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal ye shes 'khor lo 'khor/ /snang mun bar lag 'gyel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir 'od gsal rig pa'i brtan pa thob/ /'chi ba 'od gsal ma bu rang ngo 'phrod/ /bar dor 'od gsal lha sngags ye shes shar/ /skye shi'i 'khrul snang 114

yal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi yi 'od gsal sems nyid rang ngo 'phrod/ /lam gyi 'od gsal rig pa'i brtan pa thob/ /'bras bu'i 'od gsal chos sku mngon du gyur/ /rgyud gsum 'od gsal 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs/ /a ho/ 'od gsal rdo rje lus kyi grong khyer gyi dbus su/ /'od gsal a wa ngh+ru ti'i khang mdzes kyi nang na/ /'edi gsal snying dbus dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi thig le/ /'od gsal rdo rje rig stong dbyer med kyi bla ma/ /'od gsal rig rtsal dag pa'i 'khor tshogs kyi tshom bu/ /'ode gsal 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa de mkhyen no/ /'od gsal gzhi yi gnas lugs ji bzhin du rtogs shing / /'od gsal lam gyi badzadi pa nyi zla ltar myur la/ /'od gsal 'bras bu'i ye shes mngon sum du gyur pa/ /'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i bla ma de ma/khyen no/ /'od gsal skye ba sprul sku'i rol rtsed du mngon zhing / /'od gsal 'chi ba chos sku'i a ma dang mjal te/ /'edi gsal bar do longs sku'i zhing khams su shar ba/ /'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /'od gsal nyin mo'i snang ba ye shes su shar zhing / /'od gsal gnyid kyi snang ba mar me ltar 'bar te/ /'od gsal rmi lam sprul bsgyur sbyong spel gyi rol gar/ /'od gsal sad rmi gnyid kun ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ /'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /zhes pa'ang wo gsal 115

ba'i klong nas r+sā pa'i gsang tshig go/ 7/ /a ho/ 'khor 'das bde stong khyab gdal gyi zhing na/ /lhan cig skyes pa chos sku yi bla ma/ /khor yug bde chen mos gus kyis bskul na/ /ma lus phyam me dbang bskur dang byin rlobs/ /rdo rje'i ye shes snying dbus su phob cig /a ho/ bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dga' ma/ /cir snang bde chen 'dren pa'i skyo grogs la 'os pas/ /gnyis snang nyi ma nub pa'i mtshan resna yi dus su/ /'ode gsal zla ba'i bzhin ras lhag lhag tu ngom bzhin/ /gnyid mthug 'od gsal chos sku'i mal sa ru zhugs nas/ /bde stosnang lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'jo sgeg dang sprags te/ /cir snang sku dang ye shes rtsed 'dzo la rol zhing / /khor yug bde stong kha sbyor snyoms 'jug gi bde bas/ /rtag par rgyun du skyong ba'i rnal 'gyor 'di a ho/ /zhes pa'ang 'od gsal gyi dbyings las so// 7/ /skabs der 'khor 'das thams cad bla ma'i ye shes su shar ba'i mos gus phyag rgya chen po'i mgur glu 'di blangs so// a ho/ mtshan nyid gsal ba bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /rang bzhin stong pa bla ma chos kyi sku/ /ngo bo zung 'jug bla ma longs spyod rdzogs/ /rang sems bla ma // ga3/ma zhabs la 'dud/ /ma dag 'kherdzor ba'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'di/ /re sa gus bla ma'i lam du shar ba'i tshe/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /lam zab bla ma'i 51sa gus gnad smin na/ /snang ba 116

phyi yi bla ma phyi nas shar/ /rig pa nang gi bla ma nang nas shar/ /dbyings rig dbyer med bla ma dbyings nas shar/ /rang bzhin chos sku'i bla ma stong par shar/ /bde chen 'ordzongs sku'i bla ma bde bar shar/ /sna tshogs sprul sku'i bla ma cir yang shar/ /rang snang phyi nang med pa bla mar shar/ /'khor 'das bla ma'i ye shes shar tsa na/ /gnyis snang gzung 'dzin spros pa rang sar zhi/ /'khor 'das gnyis su snang ba nub pa'i phyir/ /lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med de las med/ /khor yug 'od gsal chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /bla ma'i ye shes gcig gis dus 'da' bar/ /mtshan 'dzin rtog pa 'jug pa'i skabs med pas/ /sgom pa'i man ngag de las zab pa med/ /dug lnga chos brgyad 'khrul pa'i bud shing dang / /rkyen snang rlung dmar drag tu 'tshub pa 'di/ /bla ma'i ye shes gcig gis lam khyer ba/ /cir snang bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs/ /gang shar bla ma sku gsum zhing du shar/ /spyod pa'i spyad thabs de las zab pa med/ /mchog dman re dwogs rtog pas ma bslad pa/ /sku dang ye shes gdodi nas lhun grub pa'i/ /rang sems bla ma'i ye shes mthong tsa na/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas logs nas btsal du med/ /'khor ba bla ma'i ye shes shar tsa na/ /mya ngan 'das pa gzhan nas btsal du med/ /myang 'das srid pa'i ngo bor shes tsa na/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 117

logs su dor bya med/ /'khrul rtog bla ma'i ye shes shar tsa na/ /rtog med ye shes gzhan nas btsal du med/ /ye shes rtog pa'i ngo bor shes tsa na/ /kun rtog 'khrul pa logs su dor bya med/ /phung khams bla ma rigs lngar shar tsa na/ /kun btags bskyed rim gzhan nas btsal du med/ /lha nyid phung khams ngo bor shes tsa na/ /gdos bcas phung po logs su dor bya med/ /rten bzhi bla ma sku bzhir shes tsa na/ /yongs grub rdzogs rim gzhan nas btsal du med/ /sku bzhi rtsa yig thig rlung shes tsa na/ /snyigs ma'i rtsa khams logs su dor bya med/ /dug lnga bla ma'i ye shes shar tsa na/ /ye shes rnam lnga gzhan nas btsal du med/ /ye shes du ga lnga'i ngo bor shes tsa na/ /nyon mongs chos brgyad logs su dor bya med/ /cir snang sku dang ye shes shar tsa na/ /dag pa'i snang ba gzhan nas btsal du med/ /sku dang ye shes rang snang shes tsa na/ /ma dag snang ba logs su dor bya med/ /las dang nyone mosnangs sdig sgrib sdug bsngal dang / /skye shi bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs pa'i/ /kun rtog rlung dmar drag tu 'tshub pa 'di/ /bla ma'i ye shes gnyig gis lam khyer ba/ /nad brgya sman gajig dkar po chig thub yin/ /thos bsam sgomo pa'i gnad don ji snyed dang / /lta sgom spyode pa'i man ngag thams cad dang / /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i snang ba sna tshogs dang / /sde sdod rgyud sde'i 118

nyams len ji snyed la/ /bla ma'i ye shes gcig tu ngo 'phrod pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi mdo 'gag yin/ /tshig brgya gnad 'gag gcig tu stoni pa yin/ /doni brgya nyams tshu1nga gakhrig tu 'char ba yin/ /thabs brgya man ngag gakhrig tu dril ba yin/ /chu brgya zam 'og gcig tu 'dus pa yin/ /des na skal ldan tshe 'dir grol 'dod rnams/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'gyor snying la shar/ /cir snang bla ma'i ye shes rang ngo 'phrod/ /mos gus phyag rgya chen po'i mkha' dbyengs su/ /'khor 'das rtogs pa'i rdzun ris rang sar grol/ /bla ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang // 7/ /yang snang srid gsor 'das khur med du shar ba'i rdo rje'i thol glu 'de blangs so// a ho/ sna tshogs snang ba ma 'gag sprul sku yi bla ma/ /tshogs drug 'dzin rtog bral ba'i zhing khams su mjal bas/ /bum dbang bskyed rim ma bsgom lhun grub tu gyur te/ /ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba shugs 'byung gis rdzogs pa'i/ /grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med gseng lam la brten nas/ /'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i rten 'brel zhig 'grig byung / /sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug longs sku yi bla ma/ /ma bcos rang byung rig pa'i zhing khams su mjal bas/ /gsang dbang gtum resna ma ba〉(ma lhun grub tu gyur nas/ /rang byung bzhi yi lta ba shugs 'byung gis rdzogs te/ /grub mtha' ma 'dres yongs rdzogs 119

gseng lam la brten nas/ /'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i rten 'brel la yag byung / /bde stong lhan cig skyes pa chos sku yi bla ma/ /thig le bde stong dga' bzhi'i zhing khams su mjal bas/ tanar dbang pho nya ma ba〉(ma lhun grub tu gyur nas/ /yas bab dga' bzhi'i lta ba shugs 'byung gis rdzogs te/ /grub mtha' bde stong chung ba'i gseng lam la brten nas/ /'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel la yag byung / /bde stong rnam kun mchog ldan nyid sku yi bla ma/ /skyon med gnyug ma ye shes zhing khams su mjal bas/ /bzhi pa rba rlabs ma ba〉rtom lhun grub tu gyur te/ /mas brtan dga' bzhi'i lta ba shugs 'byung gis rdzogs pa'i/ /grub mtha' bde stong chen po'i gseng lam la brten nas/ /'bras bu nyid sku thob pa'i rten 'brel la yag byung / /a ho/ chos can 'khor ba zhes bya btsal bas ni ma rnyed/ /chos nyid mya ngan 'das pa logs su rang ma grub/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mosna rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〈snam chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /rigs drug sems can las nyon ma dag pa'i snang ba/ /bde gshegs gsang gsum dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba/ /rnal 'gyor ting 'dzin nyams kyis dbyer med du bsres nas/ /snang gsum rang snang shes pa'i ting 'dzin gyi 'khor lo/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang 'dug 120

mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'grerdzo/ /rgyu rgyud dkyil 'kherdzor rnam bzhi lhun grub kyi sku bzhi/ /thabs rgyud sku bzhi lam khyer ting 'dzin gyis sbyangs pas/ /'bras rgyud gnas 'gyur sku bzhi'i ngo 'o ru shar ba/ /rgyud gsum dbyer med rtogs pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde 51 rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉(ma chen ma ga༈rdzogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /kun gyis mosnas pa chos dbyings rgya mtsho ru zhugs kyang / /rang byung rig pa'i nor bu rnyed pa rang dka' 'dug /snyan brgyud tshad ma'i gdams ngag gnad thog tu khel na/ /'khor 'das dbyer med mtshon bya 'phags lam gyi ye shes/ /mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes da lta nas 'char bas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras sgom che na ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /rgyud sde kun gyi zab don rten 'brel gyi gnad 'gag /gsung ngag lam 'bras ma gtogs gzhan gyis ni mi rtogs/ skal ldan tshe gcig grerdzol ba rnyed 'dod gcig yin na/ /lam 'bras sgom chen mdzod dang gsang chen gyi zab gnad/ /'khor 'das lam gsum rten 'brel rnam gsum du bsres pas/ /gegs dang gol sa lam gyi rten 'brel du shes te/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog rang byung ye shes su shar zhing / /skyon dang bar chad yoni tan dngos grub tu blangs te/ /121

snang ba thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char nas/ /sa lam yoni tan thams cad shugs 'byung gis bgrode de/ /re dwogs rtsol sgrub bral ba'i gnyug ma yi rnal 'gror/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /bogs 'byin srung ba'i man ngag gnad thog du 'khel na/ /cir snang dngos kun lam gyi bogs 'don du 'gyur zhing / /sna tshogs yul snang ting 'dzin bdud rtsi ru 'char te/ /bdud dang bar chad rnam gsum rigs dbye ba'i gnad kyis/ /ched du bos pa'i mgroni bzhin sa lam gyi yone tan/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ye shes chen po yi rnam rol/ /lam gyi grogs su shar ba rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde resna rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉(ma chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /kun byang rgyu 'bras phyi nang rten 'brel gyi 'char tshul/ /snang ba sems sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad kyis/ /snang sems dbyer med rtogs pa sa brgyad pa'i ye shes/ /tshogs sbyor lo ka'i lam gyis ji bzhin du mtshon pas/ /bdag gzhan bde sdug snang sems 'khor 'das kyi rtog pa/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang nub pa 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo/ /'bor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉thom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'a11/ /rgyu 122
