'bras rgyas 'debs 'khor 'das bsre ba yi zab gnad/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma'i man ngag gnad thog tu khel na/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas ye shes da lta nas rdzogs pas/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa gsang chen gyi myur lam/ /grangs med gsum gyi tshogs bsags skad cig la 'dums te/ /snang srid rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig nyid du 'char ba/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〈snam chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'grerdzo/ /'khor 'das phyi nang ma lus rang snang du thag chod/ /rang sems gsal stong brjod bral chos sku ru ngo 'phrod/ /snang sems zung 'drug sku gsum dbyer med kyi dgongs pa/ /lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ji bzhin du rtogs nas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde resna rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉(ma chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /rgyu rgyud de nyid dag pa chos sku yi mkha' la/ /thabs rgyud snang stosnang 'gag med rim gnyis kyi 'ja' ཿdzan/ /'bras rgyud lha dang rang rig dag pa ru 'char bas/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa 〉sgom pa yi rgyal po/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang skyong mkhan/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /'khor 'das chos kun dbyengs kyi ltad mo ru mthong bas/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems snang btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /123

'kherdzor ba khams gsum myang 'das sku gsum du shar bas/ /ma dag 'kherdzor ba'i gnas rigs btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /rkyen dang bar chad yoni tan dngos grub tu shar bas/ /gegs dang gol shor nor sa btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /na tsha sdug bsngal lam gyi bogs 'doni du shar bas/ /rkyen ngan bar du gcod pa btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad pha ma ru bosgo bas/ /dgra gnyen chags sdang 'khrul rtog btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /rigs drug 'grerdzo ba thams cad yi dam du shar bas/ /bdud dang 'ordzog 'dren 'byung po btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /phyi snedi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas su shar bas/ /ma dag sa rdo'i snang ba btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /nang bcud sems can thams cad yi dam du shar bas/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sems can btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /chos kun sems su grol ba'i dpal gdeng la brten nas/ /re dwogs zil gnon snang sems dbang bsgyur gyi spyod pa/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang nas bde mo rang spyodi mkhan/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogos su zhig rang med 'gro/ /lcags sreg sa gzhir gshin rje'i pho nya yis gtses sogs/ /tsha grang bzod glags bral ba dmyal ba yi sdug bsngal/ /rab dga' bde chen bskyed pa'i ye shes su 'char bas/ /thig le bde stong dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi rnal 'gyor/ /sdug bsngal 124

bde chen nyon mongs ye shes su 'char zhing / /'khrul snang chos skur grol ba'i rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang 'dug mkhan/ /lam 'bras snordzom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'grerdzo/ /skye shi bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs kyis mnar ba'i/ /rigs drug 'khore ba'i 'khrul snang mu mtha' dang bral ba/ /kun rtog chu rlung zad mtha' med pa yi rang bzhin/ /brgyad khri bzhi stonge las nyon sdig sgrib kyi 'dam rdzab/ /zin med 'khore ba'i bya bzhag chu gnyer dang mtshungs pa'i/ /'du byed las kyi 'khor 'ordzo zad mtha' da nga bral ba/ /brjodi bral rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig nyid du shar bas/ /du ma ro gzhig rtogs pa rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mor sdod chog pa/ /lam 'bras 〉sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'dzasna/ /'khor ba rigs drug gnas sbyong zhe gnyis kyi nyams snang / /phyi nang grub mtha'i lam snang gnas skabs kyi 'char 〉(/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes mthar thug gi snang ba/ /da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du 'char bas/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med do na dam gyi sangs rgyas/ /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mor sdod chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgordzom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'grerdzo/ /mi gtsang ngan skyug ngar 125

snabs bshang gci dang rnag khrag /ro mchog brgya ldan lha yul 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi/ /gnyis med bde chen ye shes gcig nyid du shar bas/ /ci za ci 'thung zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ /gtsang rme gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i ro snyoms kyi tshogs 'khor/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo rang rol mkhan/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /gang zhig rten 'brel gsum dang lam gsum dang drod gsum/ /nyams gsum ting 'dzin gsum du 'khor 'das kun bsre bas/ /sna tshogs yul gyi snang ba ting 'dzin gyi bogs 'don/ /wo mongs chos brgyad rnam rtog rang byung gi ye shes/ /bzang ngan rkyen gyi bskul ma ye shes kyi rtsal 'don/ /snang grag rig gsum lha sngags chos sku yi rol pa/ /lus ngag yid gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gyi rnam rol/ ṣā thig rlung gsum sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi zhing khams/ /gsor 'das lam gsum rdo rje'i ye shes kyi rang gzugs/ /gang shar gang snang skye med chos sku yi yo lang / /cir snang snedi bcud 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rang bzhin/ /sdug btsir sems 'dzin mi dgos cir snang kun ting 'dzin/ /u tshugs rnam rtog ma bkag kun rtog nyid ye shes/ /zhe 'dod bsgrub bya ma dmigs dgag sgrub kyi mtshang gzhig /spang gnyen tha dad ma dmigs kun nyon nyid ye shes/ /gdur 'das dbyer med rtogs pa lta ba 126

yi rgyal yo/ /cir snang chos skur shar ba sgom pa yi snying po/ /bde sdug ro snyoms 'char ba snredad pa yi gnad 'gag /gtsang rme gnyis 'dzin bral ba ro snyoms kyi tshogs 'khor/ /spang gnyen dbyer med rtogs pa sgrib sbyodang gi mthar thug /snang sems rang dbang bsgyur ba drod rtags kyi snying po/ /bdag gzhan dbyer med shes pa theg chen gyi rtsa ba/ /mnyam rjes dbyer med skyong ba nyams len gyi snying po/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'dres pa chos sku yi rnal 'gyor/ /'khor 'das ro snyerdzoms 'char ba nyams len gyi mdo chings/ /mdor na bdag gzhan 'khor 'das spang gnyen dang bde sdug /gtsang rme bzang ngan dgra gnyen 'gyor rgud dang chags sdang / /snang sems gzung 'dzin gnyis snang re dwogs dang dgag sgrub/ /thams cad ro lhasnams 'khor 'das dbyer med du shar bas/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal chen/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes skye 'chi rang dbang du bsgyur sogs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang nas ci dga' ru ngom mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉snam chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'dzasna/ /zhes dang // lto/ /yang smras pa/ a ho/ sna tshogs snang 4ba ma 'gag yul drug gi 'ja' tshon/ /tshogs drug 'dzin rtog bral ba'i nam mkha' ru shar bas/ /snang la der 'dzin med pa bum dbang gi lta ba/ /zung 'jug sgyu ma sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor du 127

shar bas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang der bde mor sdod chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /gtum mo'i bde drod rang byung ye shes kyi me chen/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs nags khrod du 'bar bas/ /gsal la ngos bzung med pa gsang dbang gi lta ba/ /bde chen 'ordzongs spyodi rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor du shar bas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mor stodi chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /bde chen dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes kyi chu rgyun/ /bde stong lhan skyes ye shes rgya mtsho ru babs pas/ /bde la zhen pa med pa sher dbang gi lta ba/ /lhan skyes bde rnyesnang chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du shar te/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang der bde mor sdode chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /bde chen ngang gis shar ba ye shes kyi nyi zla/ /skyon med gnyug ma ye shes mkha' dbyings su shar bas/ /bde chen mtshan rtog bral ba bzhi pa yi lta ba/ /'kherdzor 'das bde stong nyid sku'i dkyil 'khor du shar bas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang der bde mor sdod chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /rjes thob 'khrul snang rang mtshan gzung 'dzin gyi nags tshal/ /mnyam bzhag bde chen ye shes me chen gyis bsregs pas/ /mnyam rjes dbyer 128

med ye shes me chen gyi 'khor lo/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang der bde mor sdod chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /cir snang thams cad sgom gyi ngo bo ru 'char bas/ /bsgoms dang ma bsgoms med pa shugs 'byung gi rnal 'gyor/ /gang shar dgag sgrub med pa byung rgyal du bskyangs te/ /snang srid rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig nyid du shar ba'i/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mor sdode chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi 'byung gnas rigs drug gi skye sgo/ /skye med sku gsum mkha' dbyings chen po ru 'gag kyang / /skye gnas rang dbang bsgyur pa rten 'brel gyi rol gar/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du ci dga' rang 'char mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉(ma chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'a11/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi mthar thug 'chi ba yi 'khrul snang / /'edi gsal ma bu 'phrad pa'i rtse dga' ru shar bas/ /skye shi'i bar lag 'gyel pa rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde resnar rang 'chi mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉tem chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /nying 'khrul sdug bsngal tshad med bar do yi grong khyer/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams su shar bas/ sgyu/bar do'i snang ba lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam rol/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du bde mo 129

rang 'char mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉snam chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'dzato/ /mdor na skye shi bar do'i 'khrul snang gi 'khor lo/ /skye med sku gsum don gyi ral gri yis phral bas/ /'di phyi bar do dus gsum dus med du rtogs te/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chormog pa/ /lam 'bras 〉rdzom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /nyin snang chos kun dbyengs su ltad mo ru mthong zhing / /mtshan dus tshe da gsal mdzes mas 'bral med du 'khyud pas/ /snang mun bar lag 'gyel ba 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chosgog pa/ /lam 'bras 〈snam chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'aspo/ /nying 'khrul gti mug gnyid kyi mun nag gi smag rum/ /'ode gsal chos sku'i zla ba sgrib med du shar bas/ /nyin mtshan khor yug 'od gsal ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ /srab mthug mdangs bde mi rtog 'od gsal gyi rang rtsal/ /sbyong spel sprul sgyur yul snang blta ba la sogs pa/ /gnyid thun gcig la dbang bzhi'i nyams len kun rdzogs pas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /snang mched thob gsum ngo shes rmi lam gyi 'od gsal/ /dran pa rnam gsum thogs med nying 'khrul gyi spong khyer/ /lha sngags chos skur shar ba rnal 'gror gyi dbang 130

phyug /'chi ba bar do'i grong khyer cig car du bcom pas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chog pa/ /lam 'bras 〉sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /gang zhig brjod pa bral ba'i rang byung gi ye shes/ /'khor lo'i mgon po'i drin gyis thogs med du shar tshe/ /skye rga na 'chi'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs kyi nags tshal/ /kun rtog rlung dmar drag pos phyogs mtha' kun khyab pa/ /ye shes me chen 'bar ba'i bogs 'doni du 'char bas/ /gang byung lam du khyer ba rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /'khor 'das rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig nyid du shar tshe/ /ma dag nyoni mongs 'khrul snang btsal na yang ma rnyed/ /sgom zhes sems 'dzin logs nas 'tshol dgos rang med par/ /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chog pa/ /lam 'bras sgorma chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'aspo/ /'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba ji bzhin du rtogs na/ /dmigs med byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis/ /sku dang ye shes snang ba 'gag med kyi nyams snang / /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang nas shugs 'byung gis 'char bas/ /tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug /'khor 'das dbyer med ngang du skyid nyal rgyag chog 131

pa/ /lam 'bras 〉snam chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'grerdzo/ /skye med chos sku'i dgongs pa mngoni sum du mdzad kyang / /'gag med rten 'brel gzugs sku 'gog med kyi snang bas/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid kyi bar du/ /gsor 'das dbyer med ngang nas bde resna rang 'char mkhan/ /lam 'bras 〉sgom chen ma gtogs su zhig rang med 'gro/ /mdor na thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rang bzhi na/ /gang du 'dug kyang 'kherdzor 'das dbyer med kyi zhing khams/ /su dang 'grogs kyang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi yi dam/ /ci za ci 'thung 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi sbyogs 'khor/ /gang shar gang snang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rol pa/ /ci bya ci byed 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi yo lang / /bde sdug bzang ngan 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi bdag nyid/ /snang srid 'khor 'das 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ye shes/ /thams cad thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rang bzhin/ /snang srid 'khor 'das dbyer med a la la ho ho/ /zhes pa'ang dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog tu smras pa'o// 7/ /mkha' spyodi ma'i bsnyen mtshams la sdod skabs 'od gsal gyi nyams snang mang po shar ba'i rkyen byas nas thol byung gi mgur ma 'di 'dra zhig blangs so// 65 hesna/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' 'dra/ /rig ྅sgong rjen ne ye re bar/ /gzung 'dzin mi gnod ngo mtshar che/ /rjes thob yul gyi snang 132

cha 'di/ /sgyu mas sprul pa'i grong khyer 'dra/ /bden med bun ne shig ge bar/ /sna tshogs 'gag med ngo mtshar che/ /rig stong gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'di/ /mkha' la nyi zla shar ba 'dra/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i ngang / /sgrib med rang shar ngo mtshar che/ /rig rtsal rmi lam snang ba 'di/ /me long gzugs la rtse ba 'dra/ /bden par med pa shes bzhin du/ /sna tshorags sprul bsgyur ngo mtshar sbe/ /sems nyid gzhi yi 'od gsal 'di/ /dper na nam mkha' stosnang pa 'dra/ /rang bzhin grub pa med bzhin du/ /kun la khyab pa ngo mtshar che/ /bskyed rdzogs lam gyi 'od gsal 'di/ /gzhon nu'i bde ba myong ba 'dra/ /nyams myong 'gag pa med bzhin du/ /brjode du med pa ngo mtshar che/ /sku gsum 'bras bu'i 'od gsal 'di/ /nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'dra/ /rnam par rtog med lhun grub ngang / /phrin las 'dzad med ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa'ang wo gsal gyi klong nas pho pa'i gsang tshig go/ snye/ /yang dag pa'i lam la nges shes sna tshogs kyang 'drongs pas rkyen byas nas dran skul gyi glu 'di blangs so// a ho/ yar gcig bltas pas dag pa mkha' spyodi kyi zhing na/ /rtsa brgyud drin chen bla ma sprin phung bzhin gtibs pa/ /mosnas gus dag pa'i yul du med thabs ni mi 'dug /a pho'i sems pa dag pa mkha' spyodi la 3(ra nas/ /srid pa 'khor ba'i grong 'dir sdod snying rang ma 'dod/ /tshe 'dir mkha' spyod 133

sgrubs shig sgrub brtson gyi rnal 'byor/ /mar gcig bltas pas 'khor ba ngan semang gi gnas na/ /ma rgan rigs drug 'khrul snang sna ཿdzags kyis mnare ba/ /byams dang snying rje'i yul du med thabs ni mi 'dug /a po'i sems pa pha ma rigs drug la shor nas/ /zhi bde thar pa'i skam sa bsnyeg snying rang ma 'dod/ /sems bskyed snying stobs rems shig byang sems kyi skyes bu/ /phar gcig bltas pas tshogs drug 'gag med kyi 'char 〉(/ /sna tshogs yul snang ma 'gag rten 'brel gyi rol pa/ /ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i sogs 'don med thabs ni mi 'dug /a po'i sems pa yul gyi bdud rtsi la shor nas/ /yul med stong rkyang med dgag bsgom snying rang ma 'dod/ /snang stong zung 'jug skyongs shig sgyu ma yi rnal 'gror/ /tshur gcig bltas pas rnal 'gyor bya bral gyi sgo gsum/ /lha sngags chos sku rang shar shugs 'byung gi 〉sgom pa/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i rgyan du med thabs ni mi 'dug /a pho'i sems pa rang sems 'od gsal la cerdzor nas/ /sna tshogs yul la bya ra gtod snying rang ma 'dod/ /rig stong brdar sha chod cig ri khrodi kyi ban rgan/ /zhes so// 7/ /rong lo zhe drug pa shing wīg lor yang mkha' spyod kyi sgrub pa la chig dril byas pa de'i tshe dben pa la dga' ba'i gtam 'di smras so// kye rderdzo/ gnas dgon sde chen po'i bla brang gi dbus na/ /rgyan gser gyi ga le'i phra tshom gyi bkod 134

pa/ /steng gdugs dkar bla bre yal skusnal du bres shing / /'ordzogs zhal ba pa tra'i ldebs ris kyi brgyan par/ /'og khri dang zab chen 'bol gdan gyi steng na/ /sku dar zab 'jam mdzes na bza' yis spras te/ /zhal zhim dgu mngar brgya'i bza' btung la spyod bzhin/ /grogs bla chen mi tshen 'du long gi 'khor lo/ /'khor dge 'dun mang po'i bkur bsnyi yis skyong zhing / /nor shi gsoni dad 'bul char bzhin du babs te/ /las dgoni sde chos gzhis kha 'dzin la g.yeng ba'i/ /khong snyan grags mnga' thang rgyas pa yi bla chen/ /dus de ring sbyin sreg thal ba ru gyur te/ /rlung ngar ma'i zhags pas btab pa de thos nas/ /gnas dmyal ba'i lcags khang dbang med du khrid pa'i/ /dgra chormos brgyad 'di la ya nga zhig skyes byung / /gnas mi med dben pa'i ri sul gyi khrod na/ /steng brag skyibs nyams dga' rang byung gi bla bre/ /logs rdo rje'i brag ri 'jig med kyi pha mkhar/ /'ogartsa 'jam 'a'ol gdan zhen med kyi stan gtsang / /gos gtum mo a shad grang med kyi na bza'/ /zas sngo dang chu gtsang sdig med kyi 'tsho ba/ /nor chog shes 'phags nor 'dzad med kyi gter chen/ /spogs bya dang ri dwags khro med kyi skyo grogs/ /'khor lha srin sde brgyad ting 'dzin gyi bskul 'debs/ /las 〉sna gsum byar med 'dun ma yi yang rtse/ /gnas thar pa'i pha mkhar btsan thabs su 135

khrid pa'i/ /pha grub thob rje btsun gong ma yi gdan sa/ /nga dben pa'i ri la sems pa 'di shor song / /gnas gling kha skyed tshal me tog gi rwa bar/ /steng zab chen bla bre 'ja' tshoni ltar bkra zhing / /logs tshon ris shel khras mdzes pa yi pho brang / /'og khri dang 'bol gdan rbekod legs kyi steng na/ /sku dar zab lu gu'i tshor blokhoka gi skrug tu/ /zhal bag med sha chang zhim dgu yis bkung sto/ /grogs na chung mdzes ma'i rtse dga' yis skyong zhing / /'khor pho mo mang pos gus gus dang zhum zhum/ /nor mi rgyu gces gces btsan dbang gis 'phrog ste/ /las dgra 'dul gnyen skyong pho rab kyi phyag bzhes/ /khong mnga' thang gzi byin rgyas pa yi mi chen/ /ske thag nag tsa rer btson dong du bcug ste/ /'khor gshed ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba de mthong nas/ /gnas 'khor ba'i btson rwar dbang med du khrid pa'i/ /dgra 'dod yon 'di la spu zing zhig skyes byung / /ma mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs stosna sprin ltar khol ba'i/ /gnas rgyal khams phyogs med ro snyoms kyi spyod yul/ /rgyan gza' skar thig le'i phra tshom gyis spras pa'i/ /steng nam mkha' yangs pa rang byung gi bla bre/ /yul rdza spang brag ri nags tshal gyis gtams pa'i/ /'ordzogs khor yug mu khyud ting 'dzin gyi khang bzang / /rgyan skyed tshal me tog phra tshom gyis bskasnad par/ /'og sa gzhi yangs pa gaskusgo med kyi mal 136

stan/ /rgyan stag sham rus rgyan dpa' chas kyis spras shing / /besnas mi lpags g.yang gzhi mkha' 'gro yi na bza'/ /rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin las byung ba'i/ /zas kha la gang 'bab 'chi med kyi bcud len/ /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i/ /grogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bral med kyi skyo grogs/ /'phral zas gos rtsol med shugs 'byung du sbyor ba'i/ /'khor snang ba gdong 'ded rgyal khams kyi pho mo/ /phyi tshogs drug snang ba 'gag med kyi 'char sgo/ /nang ting 'dzin sgyu ma 'dzad med kyi longs spyod/ /las gang shar snang ba lam khyer gyi spyodad pa/ /'bras tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'dun ma yi yang rtse/ /gnas sku bzhi'i mkhar 〉sgor btsan thabs su khrid pa'i/ /yul rgyal khams phyogs med grub thob kyi shul lam/ /nga kun bzang spyod la sems pa 'di shor song / /gnas grong khyer bde skyid phun tshogs kyi gling na/ /gzhon sha bkrag dkar dmar me tog ltar rgyas pa'i/ /lus lang tshos dregs pa'i mtshar sdug gi 'o mo/ /grerdzogs na mnyam sems mthun bsdebs pa yi tshosnags rnams/ /nor zas 〈snas longs spyod phun tshogs dang ldan pa'i/ /las so nam bro gzhas rtsed mo la g.yeng ba'i/ /mi rnam rig bkra ba de ring gi dus su/ /lus dur khrod chen por gcer bu ru dor nas/ /'khor sha gzan mang pos bskor ba de mthong tshe/ /gnas ngan 137

'gro'i g.yang sar dbang med du g.yug pa'i/ /dgra bag med 'di la dngangs skrag cig skyes byung / /gnas gar song gar bsdad 'og min gyi zhing khams/ /steng dag pa mkha' spyod mos gus kyi bla bre/ /'og 'khor ba ngan song snying rje yi gdan bzang / /phyi snang ba dkar dmar ting 'dzin gyi khang bzang / /nang rang byung rig pa 'bral med kyi skyo grogs/ /sems 'od gsal chos sku rnal 'gror gyi phug nor/ /grogs su dang 'grog kyang yi dam gyi dkrol 'khor/ /zas ci za ci 'argyang bdud rtsi yi tshogs 'khor/ /nor ting 'dzin longs spyod 'dzad med kyi gter kha/ /sems ting 'dzin g.yo med ye shes kyi rgyal po/ /yul snang sems dbang bsgyur 'kherdzor 'bangs dang bran g.yerdzog /las cir snang sgyu ma lam khyer gyi spyodad pa/ /yul gnyis 'dzin bshig pa 'dun ma yi yang rtse/ /pha drin chen bla ma spyi gtsug gi rgyan bzang / /byams snying rje byang sems rang sems kyi skyo grogs/ /gos gtum mo'i bde drod ral med kyi na bza'/ /nyin tshogs drug yul snang ye shes kyi rtse grogs/ /mtshan srab mthug 'od gsal 'bral med kyi grogs mo/ /nang rig pa rang gsal 'gran med kyi rgyal yo/ /phyi snang ba dbang sdud 'khor 'bangs dang bran g.yog /las sgo gsum bya byed tshogs gnyis kyi yo lang / /lar ci bya ci byed ye shes kyi rol pa/ /don gang shar sku gsum lam khyer gyi spyod 138

pa/ /nga 'od gsal rdo rje rang grol gyi rnal 'gror/ /gnas 'khor 'das dbyer med dgongs pa la sbyor ba'i/ /khong snying po'i don la sems pa 'di shor song / /ces dang // 7/ /sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs 'od phung 'bar ba'i nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang byas so// a ho/ mkhan slob chos gsum be+e ro lce btsun dang klong chen/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter stoni brgya rtsa la sogs pa/ /ka dag 'od gsal chos sku'i gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ /lhun grub 'ja' lus rdo rje'i 'od sku ru bzhengs pa/ /snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa snying dbus nas dran byung / /rim dgu theg pa'i brjod bya a ti la rdzogs nas/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin ye shes bla ma'i sa non par/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang rlobes shig /a ho/ shing rta rnam gnyis jo rngog 'brom gsum la serdzogs pa/ /med byung byang chub sems kyi gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgosgon dam pa gcig nyid du bzhengs pa'i/ /bka' gdams gsar rnying brgyud pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /lta ba mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i don rtogs shing / /spyode pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi mdzad pa kun rdzogs te/ /'bras bu tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sku gnyis mngon 'gyur bar/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang :snabs shig /birla 〈snang ma lnga sogs sa ngor dang tshar pa/ /skusgongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i 139

brgyud pa/ /'khor 'das dbyer med chos sku'i gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ /'bras bu lhun grub sku bzhi'i ngo rte ru bzhugs pa/ /gsung ngag lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum tshe gcig la grol ba'i/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i lam mchog gnad thog tu 'khel bar/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang rlobs shig /nā ro paṇa chen mar mi dwags gsum la sogs pa/ /mi med dben pa'i ri sul gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ /snying po'i sgrub la gzhol ba'i rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug /grub mchog mar pa bka' brgyud snying dbus nas dran byung / /'dir snang tshe 'di'i 'dun ma thal ba ltar bor nas/ /dka' spyad snying rus drag pos sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i/ /grub thob bka' brgyud gong ma'i rjes shul de zin par/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang rlobs shig /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam gnyis khyung po la serdzogs pa'i/ /rgyun mtha'i byang sems phreng ba gser ri ltar dngar ba'i/ /thabs lam chos drug zab mo'i gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'gyor du bzhugs pa'i/ /zab lam shangs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma de dran byung / /nyin snang chos kun dbyings kyi ltad mo ru mthong zhing / /mtshan dus 'od gsal mdzes mas 'bral med du 'khyud par/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang rlobes shig /pha gcig dam pa ma 140

gcig lab sgron la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba'i yum don zhi byed gcod yul kyi bla ma/ /rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal stong nyid kyi gzhal yas/ /'khore 'das ro snyoms spyod pa'i dpa' bo yi dam pa/ /zhi gcod brgyud pa'i bla ma snying dbus nas dran byung / /bdag 'dzin snyems byed 'khri ba btsan thabs su chod de/ /bdag med yum gyi dgongs don mngon sum du 'gyur bar/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang rlebes shig /dus zhabs che chung tsa mi rga 'ordzo dang jo zhal/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor sbyor drug brgyud pa yi bla ma/ /bde chen 'pho 'gyur med zlo'i gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ /'pho med dwangs ma rdo rje'i sku mchog tu bzhengs pa'i/ /dus 'khor sbyor drug brgyud pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /'pho bcas srid pa'i rgyu ba dbu ma ru 'gags te/ /'pho bral dwangs ma rdo rje'i sku mchog de 'grub par/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rdo rje phag mo grub thob therte rgyan pa la sogs/ /rdo rje gsum mchog bsnyen sgrub brgyud pa yi bla ma/ /'pho bral rdo rje'i gzhal yas gzhom med kyi dbus su/ /'pho chen dwangs ma 'od sku'i ngo bo ru bzhugs pa'i/ /rdo rje gsum mchog bsnyen sgrub brgyud pa'i tshogs dran byung / /tha mal sgo gsum rdo rje'i gsang gsum du bsdom nas/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku gsum mngon sum du 'gyur bar/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rang 141

:snabs shig /de ltar shing rta brgyad kyi bka' babs kyi chu bo/ /gang thugs ye shes rgya mtshor g.yo med du bskyil nas/ /man ngag rin chen bye ba'i gter chen de brdol bas/ /skal bzang sku bzhi nor bu'i dga' stoni la sbyor ba'i/ rtswa ba'i bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid de mkhyen no/ /rdo rje'i ye shes snying gi thig le ru 'phos te/ /grub gnyis dngos grub nor bu'i dga' ston la rol nas/ /mgon po khyed kyi phrin las byed par rang 31ga cig /ces pa'o// 7/ /rig gsar skabs mthong thos kyi gnas skabs gang gis kyang yid shin tu skyo ba kho na byung ba'i tshe skyo glu 'di 'dra zhig blangs so// kye ma kye hud snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro/ /chos dang 'jig rten gnyis char med pa yi/ /skye bo gdug pa'i g.yerdzog tu bskardzol gyur pa'i/ /nga dang nga 'dra'i las ngan sems can la/ /pha gcig bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /skyabs mgod dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /kye ma bdag cag dal 'gyor mi lus thob/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog gi 〉sna ru zhugs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pas rjes su bzung / /skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub rgyu la/ /gdug can skye bo'i bran g.yog tu gyur te/ / rang gzhan dbang med sdig pa'i las la bskortol/ /nyin mtshan ngal dub kherdzo nas dus 'das pas/ /dal 'gyor stong log byas snyam nga re 'grod/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin chen sgroni/ /spel ba'i thabs la snying nas spro gyur 142

cing / /'dzin spel g.yar dam bdag gis bcas mode kyi/ /rang rkyen shes rab snying rje mi ldan zhing / /gzhan rkyen bstan la dad pa ches nyung bas/ /bstan pa gsal ba'i nus pa ma mchis rkyen/ /bstan pa'i zhabs tog ma grub nga re 'gyod/ /ma gyur 'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /'dren pa'i 'gan khur bdag la yod mod kyi/ /rang gi rang mgo rang gis mi thon pas/ /sems can 'gro don ma grub nga re 'a.o/ /lus sems skyed pa'i drin chen pha ma yis 'di phyi'i re ltos bdag la bcol mod kyi/ /rang nyid blun po'i bran g.yog tu gyur nas/ /pha ma'i drin lan ma gsos nga re 'gyod/ /dpal mgoni bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /gdams ngag snyan brgyud smin 〈snal pha phog bstsal/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa bdag gi bskang 'os kyang / /dbang med gzhan gyis sdig pa'i las la bkol/ /bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs ma grub nga re 'grod/ /mkhan slob dkon mchog gsum po dpang bzhag nas/ /serdzo thar sngerdzom pa bsrung bar khas blangs kyang / /bdud kyis dbang bsgyur skal ngan dbang 3snar bas/ /so thar sdom pa ma bsrungs nga re 'artsu1da/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpang bzhag nas/ /byang sems stsodam pa bsrung bar khas blangs kyang / /rtag tu rang rgyal gzhan pham bsam blo yis/ /byang sems sngerdzom pa nyams pas nga re 'grod/ /rje 143

btsun bla ma yi dam dkyil gsor lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dpang bzhag nas/ /gsang sngags dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs kyang / /'khrul snang rgya 'byams kho nas dus 'das pas/ri /sngags kyi sdom pa shor bas nga re 'grod/ /kyi hud las nyon gdug pa'i bran gyur cing / /rang gzhan dbang med sdig pa'i las la sprodi/ /bslab bya dam tshig sdom pa thams cad nyams/ /dpyal ba'i bud shing yin snyam nga re 'grod/ /dpal mgon bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /tshe gnyig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i gdams ngag bstsal/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par dam bcas kyang / /dam bca' tshad du ma 'khyol nga re 'grod/ /mi med dben pa'i ri sul dam pa ru/ /phung po 'ja' lus bsgrub rgyu yin pa la/ /rnam g.yeng nyon mongs can gyi grong gseb tu/ /ro dri pha ler lus pa nga re 'grod/ /nga re 'gyod kyang nga la bya thabs bral/ /wo kyang rang ngos nyams len 'di tsam ste/ /srog gi phyir yang darkan mchog blos mi gtong / /rgyal srid ched du'ang las 'bras khyad mi gsedi/ /ci la thug kyang byang sems blos mi gtong / /gshed mas brab kyang dran pa gsum mi brjed/ /ji ltar bkol yang sgyu ma rmi lam go /'di ni kho bo'i rnam thar snying po yin/ /khyad par dam pa rdo rje 'chang dbang des/ /'khor 'das chos kun rang sems cho 'phrul dang / /sems nyid gsal 144

stong bla ma sku gsum du/ /rang ngo sprad pa'i tshul la ba〈snam pa yi/ /nyams su myong ba'i rtogs tshad ma mchis kyang / /mos pa'i go yul rdo la ri mo bzhin/ /mi ldog yid ches snying la rnyed 'di tsam/ /da lta'i dus na skyo grogs gcig pur gyur/ /tha mal shes pa sangs rgyas :snan pa dang / /cir snang thams cad chesnas sku'i zhing khams su/ /rang ngo sprad pa'i bka' drin 'di bsam tshe/ /mi bachodi dad pa'i mchi ma gaskusna bar 'gyur/ /gang du 'dug kyang chos sku'i zhing khams te/ /su dang 'grogs kyang chos sku'i yi dam lha/ /ci za ci 'thung chos sku'i tshogs 'khor dang / /ci bya ci byed chos sku'i yo lang ste/ /bde sdug bzang ngan 'gyor rgud la sogs pa/ /thams cad chos nyid stong pa'i rol par go /chos sku'i rnal 'gror ji ltar byas kyang skyid/ /bde sdug sna tshogs rmi lam snang ba 'dra/ /skye shi bar do sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'dra/ /gnas yul longs spyod dri za'i grong dang mtshungs/ /'dod yoni spyod med smig rgyu'i chu dang 'dra/ /mdzes mar snang ba nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /snang ba snang stsortong chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /grag pa grag 〈snang brag ca'i sgra dang mtshungs/ /rig pa rig stong nam mkha'i glog 'gyu bzhin/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde dang mi bde dang / /grags dang mi grags bstsortod dang smad pa ste/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ye shes rol par shar/ /mig ltor rab rib nam mkha'i sprin 145

bzhin rtogs/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bde sdug rdzun du zad/ /de skad mdo khams shar nas 'khyams pa yi/ /sprang rgan 'jam dbyangs :rto gsal zhes ba4) bas/ /dpal ldan sa skyar grags pa'i gnad mchog tu/ /me 'brug dzasna bzhin zla ba'i brgyad nyin smras/ /zhes so// 7/ /dge 'dun bstan dzapan gyis zhal gdams thung ngu zhig kyang zhu zer ba'i lan du 'di smras so// mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum sogs/ /gcig tu 'dus pa rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /sdom gsum bka' drin stsol ba'i drin chen rje/ /dpal mgoni bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dud/ /dad dang dam tshig snang ba ma 'gyur ba'i/ /bu mchog khyed kyis ji ltar dris pa'i lan/ /mdor bsdus tshig gi phreng ba 'di ltar spel/ /'do med chos ltar bcos pa'i dred po la/ /bla ma'i ming tsam 'dzin pa'i sprang ban bdag /skyes pa'i yul ni mdo khams shar gyi phyogs/ /sde bzhi dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i sa yi char/ /thub bstan rin chen mchog gi sgor zhugs nas/ /spyir ni yongs 'dzin dam pa bcu phrag gsum/ /khyad par drin chen bla ma rnam pa gsum/ /'jam mabe(na bla ma ngag dbang legs pa dang / /'jam dpal dgrangs dngos chos kyi ༄la mtshan dang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma chos kyi blo gros yin/ /kun gyi nang nas 'gran zla bral ba ni/ /'jam dgrangs bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang po zhes/ khred pa'i dus kyi thams 146

cad mkhyen pa de'i/ /phrin las spel phyir phrin las sprul pa'i sku/ /kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ /'jam ༅ngas bla ma chos kyi blo gros yin/ /chos lugs grub mtha' ji ltar yin zhes pa/ /spyir ni snga ldor bka' gdams lam 'bras dang / /bka' shangs sbyor drug zhi gcod bsnyen sgrub sogs/ /sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi bka' babs chos/ /deng sang kho na bzhugs pa phal cher thos/ /de phyir chos la phyogs ris ma mchis kyang / /paṇa grub dbang po dpal ldan birla pas/ /rje btsun sa skya pa la gdams pa yi/ /gsung ngag lam dang 'bras bu'i gdams pa 'di/ /ban rgan bdag gi nyams len snying po yin/ /dang po chos sgor zhugs pa nas brtsams te/ /da lta shi rgas mtha' la thug gi bar/ /dkar po dge ba'i snang ba ma bral zhing / /las 'bras tshul la yid ches rnyed pa yis/ /blang dor gnas la ci nus 'bad pa byas/ /so byang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum tsho / /rten 'brel sna tshogs dus kyi byed po yis/ /tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i spo skabs ma rnyed kyang / /rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams dang ma 'gal tsam/ /dbang daḍa lgedams ngag zab mo mang thob cing / /mi med dben pa'i ri sal 'ga' zhig da ༄ tu/ /cung zad nyams su blangs pa'i rten wel dang / /dpal masmo bla ma rdzogs pa'i sa/ngas rgyas la/ /mi phyed gus pa'i bsam sbyor mi dman zhing / /thugs netsho 147

brtse'i thugs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ /chos kun sems su shes pa'i dpa' gdeng dang / /sems nyid rnyasnang gsal sku gsum ngang nyid du/ /gang shar snang ba lam du khyer ba yi/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'gyor bde sdug rdzun du zad/ /bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len dang / /lta sgom spyodi pa'i man ngag thams cad kun/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i 〈sna skabs ma mchis kyang / /rig thog gcig la dbang bzhi'i nyams len kun/ /dril ba'i lta ba zhakhor 'das dbyer med la/ /mi 'phrog yid ches rdo la ri mo bzhin/ /mnyam rjes ye shes 'khor lo'i dus 'da' ba/ /da lta'i dus na skyo grogs gcig pu nyid/ /de skad mdo khams shar nas 'khyams pa yi/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'gyor 'jam dbyangs blerdzo gsal gyis/ /sgyu ma'i nyams myong ban bun ngang nyid nas/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di/ /sgyu ma'i bu la sgyu ma bzhin gdams mthus/ /sgyu ma'i sa lam dus 'dir bgrerdzod byas te/ /sgyu ma'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /ces smras// 7/ /yang nub gcig bla ma rin po che'i mdzad rnam ngo mtshar dang byin rlabs che shing / /khyad par sgyu ma'i rnal 'gror par bde sdug rdzun du zad pa'i nyams len zab mo de phyogs tsam yang ma go bas de don go bder ston pa'i zhal gdams shig gsung du gsol zhes zer ba'i lan du 'di smras so// rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /ye shes phung po gcig tu 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal mgod bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rnam kun dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal 'o(/ /dad dang dam 148

tshig snang ba ma 'gyur ba'i/ /bu mchog khyod kyis slar yang dris pa'i lan/ /'khrul med bla ma'i zhal lung ji bzhin dbye/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i tshul la yid ches nas/ /ngan serdzong lhung bar 'gyur snyam yid 'byung ba/ /de ka kho na shin tu legs pa ste/ /las 'bras tshul la yid ches snying nas skyes/ /blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa'i gang zag ni/ /nam yang ngan 'gror 'gro ba mi srid do/ /skabs don sgyu ma'i rnal 'gror bde dang sdug /rdzun du zad pa'i zab don bkrol lo skad/ /'di don rgyal ba rnams kyis sbas pa'i chos/ /lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ma rtogs par/ /sgyu ma rmi lam ji bzhin shes mi 'gyur/ /'di ma rtogs pas khams gsum 'khosgor ba las/ /thar ba'i thabs gzhan gang yang yedi ma yin/ /'di don rtogs par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ /brgyud ldan bla ma yun du bsten par bya/ /'on te 'di don zur tsam 'di lta ste/ /dgra gnyen sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol gar 'dra/ /chags sdang skye ba'i byis pa ya re nga / /dgra gnyen sgyu ma'i tshul la ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'gror dgra gnyen rdzun du zad/ /skye shi bar do mtshan mo'i rmi lam 'dra/ /de la bden par zhen pa nyon re mongs/ /skye shi rmi lam tsam du thag chod pa'i/ /rmi lam rnal 'gror skye shi rdzun du zad/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed smig rgyu'i chu dang 'dra/ /nor la sred pa'i rmongs pa a thang chad/ /'gyor rgud 149

smig rgyu'i chu ltar ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /smig rgyu'i rnal 'gror 'gror rgud rdzun du zad/ /snyan dang mi snyan brag ca'i sgra dang 'dra/ /bstod smad brag ca'i sgra la zhen pa yi/ /so so skye bo rnams ni tshig gis bslus/ /bstod smad brag ca'i sgra ltar ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /brag ca'i rnal 'gror bstode smad rdzun du zad/ /mdzes dang mi mdzes nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /gzugs la zhen pa'i rmongs pa nyon re mongs/ /snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bur ngo 'kho pa'i/ /'ja' tshon rnal 'gror mdzes btsog rdzun du zad/ /gnas yul longs spyod dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /dri za'i grong khyer bden par 'dzin pa yi/ /byis pa rnams ni sride par yun ring 'khor/ /gnas grong dri za'i grong khyer ltar shes pa'i/ /rnal 'gyor pa de srid pa rang grol yin/ /snang ba snang yang med pa mig yor 'dra/ /dngos yor mtshan mar zhen pa'i mi re 'khrul/ /snang ba mig yor tsam du ngo 'phyod pa'i/ /rnal 'gror pa de snang bas 'ching mi nus/ /'dod yon dngos med chu yi zla ba 'dra/ /de la zhen cing chags pa shin tu 'khrul/ /'dod yon chu zla lta bur ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /chu zla'i rnal 'gror 'dod yon gyis mi 'ching / /des na chos kun sgyu mar thag chod cing / /sgyu ma rmi lam nyams dang mi 'bral ba'i/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bde sdug rdzun du zad/ /rten 'brel sna tshogs dus kyi byed pa yis/ /lus ngag dal bar sdode pa'i long med 150

kyang / /sgyu ma rmi lam nyams dang mi 'bral bar/ /'grerdzo 'dug za nyal spyod lam thams cad du/ /chos sku'i dran pa nam yang ma brjed na/ /gar song gar bsdad chos sku'i zhing khams yin/ /ci za ci 'thung chos sku'i 'tsho ba yin/ /ci bya ci byed chos sku'i yo lang yin/ /bde sdug 'gror rgud chos sku'i rnam rol yin/ /skye shi bar do ros sku'i ngang nyid yin/ /ros sku'i rnal 'gror ji ltar byas kyang skyid/ /'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /snang yang bden med stong par thag chod na/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ye shes rol pa yi/ /lam gyi grogs su 'char ro snying gi bu/ /mdor na tha snyad las 'bras khyad mi gsod/ /mos gus byang chub sems gnyis rgyud la bsten/ /sgyu ma rmi lam nyams dang mi 'bral bar/ /chos kun dbyings kyi rol pa'i ltad mor ltos/ /de skad mdo khams shar nas 'khyams pa yi/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'gyor 'jam dbyangs blo snagasal gyis/ /chu glang zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la/ /legs par bris 'dis khyodi la phan gyur cig / ces smras// lto/ /phyis su dpe bltas 'dra bya rgyu byung tshe dpe gang la bltas na phan thogs che tshul sermegs kyi zhal gdams shig gsung du gsol zhes bris 'dug pa'i lan du// skye shi bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs pa/ /skye med sku gsum klong du ngo sprad cing / /dkyil gsor bzhi la dbang bzhi legs bskur te/ /lam bzhi ba〉snam pa'i sdod rung du mdzad nas/ /sku 151

bzhi'i rten 'brel ma lus bsgrigs mdzad pa'i/ /dpal mgoni bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rnam kun dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu mchog khyod la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /mdo khams shar gyi phyogs nas 'khyams pa yi/ /chos med sprang po mañju ma ti la/ /dad daji dam tshig snang ba ma 'gyur ba'i/ /bu mchog khyod kyis ji ltar dris pa'i lan/ /mdor bsdus tshig gi phreng ba 'di ltar spel/ /khyodi kyi rgyud la dad dang shes rab dang / /lhag par nam 'chi cha med bsam pa yi/ /nges 'byung drag po rgyun du skyes pa de/ /chos kyi snying po yin pas shin tu legs/ /lta ba zhabor 'das dbyer med sbas pa'i doni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dkoni mchog lhun grub kyi/ /rgyud gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan las byung ba ltar/ /go yul yi ger bkod pa de ga yang / /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang yin mod kyi/ /go don nyams su myong ba ma byung na/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom gris shi ba bzhin/ /de phyir nyams su blangs nas nyams rgyu1nga gi /rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad yod pa shin tu gces/ /'di don zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'gyor dang / /tshorags bsags sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i lag rjes las/ /dper char bltas pas bo bar nus ma yin/ /de phyir 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa paṇa gyis/ /nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin 152

las/ /byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin/ /'di yi rtogs pa gsang sngags kyi/ /thabs la mkhas na tshe 'dir 'grub/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs doni ji bzhin yin/ /lam 'bras spyi yi chos skad la/ /thos bsam bosgo yul tsam zhig la/ /lta bar bzhag pa'i lugs gcig dang / /nyams myong ting nge 'dzin nyid la/ /lta bar bzhag pa'i lugs gcig las/ /lta ba 'kherdzor 'das dbyer med ni/ /phyi ma 'di dang mtshungs pa yin/ /chos kun sems su ngo 'phrod cing / /sems nyid sku gsum ngo 'phrod de/ /rig thog gcig tu dbang bzhi yi/ /nyams len dril ba'i mi de ni/ /cha lugs ji ltar gnas kyang rung / /dgongs pa sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam/ /'jigs med seng ge rgyu ba bzhin/ /gang la'ang nyam nga bag tsha med/ /de skad chos dang 'jig rten gli /bya ba gang yang ma nus kyang / /'di phyi bar do thams cad kyi/ /'dun ma bla ma la re ba'i/ /sprang rgan 'jam dgrangs blo gsal gyis/ /rang gi go yul yi ger bskardzod/ /gang ltar yin rung da ltar gyi/ khes pa bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang / /bde sdug rtog pa lam 'khyer ba'i/ /gtad med rnal 'gyor gcig tu bde/ /chos kun sgyu mar ngo 'phrod cing / /sgyu ma'i nyams dang mi 'bral ba'i/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gcig tu bde/ /zhes pa 'di yi ger bris nas gsang thabs su sprad do// 7/ /gzhan yang skabs 'di rnams su bla 153

ma'i gdams ngag tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs pas spya rkyen ngan pa sna tshogs lam du lhongs pa sogs snang grag thams cad grogs su shar ba'i tshe ka mgur 'di blangs so// ka nas dag pa chos sku'i bla ma/ /kha sbyodar bdun ldan 'ordzongs sku'i bla ma/ /gar yang 'char ba sprul sku'i bla ma/ /nga yi bla ma sku gsum dbyer med/ /ca co'i gsol 'debs 'ar ma 'ur gyis/ /cha 'jog blo gtad khyed la zhu'o/ /ja bzang zhal dre'i lha chos nyan bzhin/ /nya rgyas zhal gyi zil mngar btung ste/ /ta thā ga ta'i snying po rlon pa/ /tha mal shes pa sangs rgyas ngo sprod/ /da lta'i skye bo dmu rgod bdag 'dra/ /na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs las skyobo pa'i/ /pā ra mchog gi lam stoni dam pa/ /pha gcig bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing / /ba glang rdzi yang sangs rgyas gtong ba'i/ /ma dadza mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag dwangs ma/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i myur lam zab mo/ /tsha grang ngal ba khyad du bsad nas/ /dza drag rgyun ring bsgoms 'di a ho/ /wa ltar nyul ba'i tha mal rlung sems/ /zha so bzhin du dhu tir rengs nas/ /za ma tog ltar rgyu 'byung ba'i/ /'a cag mchog gi dngos grub snyegs 'gro/ /ya ki'i rdo rje theg pa'i snying po/ /rwa ba rdo rje'i dam tshig gis bskor/ /la gcig lam gcig bla ma'i gdams ngag kho thug rus bab snying la bcangs na/ /sa lam bgrode la dka' tshegs mi 'dug /ha ha skyid skyid rnal 'gyor bya bral/ /a ho ngo mtshar bla ma'i 154

gdams ngag /ces so// lto/ /yang 'di skabs shig sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi ring lugs la spobs pa rnyed pa'i glu 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro zhes bya ba 'di blangs so// a ho/ ka dag chos sku yi mkha' dbyings la/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi ltad mo lta/ /rdzogs chen nam mkha' yi rnal 'gyor pa/ /nga klong chen rab 'byams kyi bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni slob dpon pad+ma yin/ /yang mes ni kun tu bzang po yin/ /lta ba ni rdzogs pa chen po yin/ /sgom pa ni khregs chod thod rgal yin/ /spyod pa ni 'khor 'das zil gnon yin/ /'bras bu ni ye shes bla ma yin/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni sgrub pa bka' brgyad yin/ /chos spyodang ni ma gza' dam gsum yin/ /nga rdzogs chen nam mkha'i rnal 'gror pa/ /snga 'gyur rnying ma'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /a ho/ phyi tshul 'dul ba'i spyod pa 'dzin/ /nang du byang chub sems gnyis sbyong / /gsang ba rim gnyis kyi rnal 'gror pa/ /nga dge bshes stoni pa'i bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni dpal ldan a ti sha /yang mes ni shwakya thub pa yin/ /lta ba ni dbu ma chen po yin/ /sgom pa ni stong nyid snying rje yin/ /spyod pa ni sdom gsum rnam dag yin/ /'bras bu ni sku gnyis zung 'jug yin/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni bka' gdams lha bzhi yin/ /chos srung ni mason po tshogs bdag yin/ /nga byang chub sems kyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /jo bo 155

bka' gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /a ho/ phyi shes bya'i chos la ma rmongs shing / /nang rang rig sangs rgyas sku gsum mthong / /don 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rnal 'gror pa/ /nga 'jam mgoni sa paṇa gyi bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni grub chen birla pa/ /yang mes ni zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /lta ba ni 'khor 'das dbyer med yin/ /sgom pa ni gsung ngag lam 'bras yin/ /spyod pa ni phyogs las rnam rgyal yin/ /'bras bu ni bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni dgyes bde gsang gsum yin/ /chos skyong ni gur zhal lcam dral yin/ /nga rten 'brel lam byed kyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /'jam mgon sa skya'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /a ho/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas rgyud bskul nas/ /snying rus dang zhe bcad kyis sgrub tshugs 'dzin/ /sgo gsum bya bral gyi rnal 'gror pa/ /nga mi la ras pa'i bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni nā ro paṇa chen yin/ /yang mes ni drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /lta ba ni phyag rgya chen po yin/ /sgom pa ni nā ro chos drug yin/ /spyod pa ni byar med smyo spyod yin/ /'bras bu ni tshe gtsig sangs rgyas yin/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni rdo rje phag mo yin/ /chos skyong ni ma mgon lcam dral yin/ /nga ma bcos shugs 'byung gi rnal 'gror pa/ /bka' grub thob brgyud pa'i bu brgyud yin/ /a ho/ mkha' 156

'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag kun/ /rtse gcig zab mo yi sgrub la brtson/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal gyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /nga mkhas grub khyung po'i bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni ye shes mkha' 'aspo yin/ /yang mes ni rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ /lta ba ni phyag chen gwa 'u ma/ /sgom pa ni ni gu chos drug yin/ /spyodi pa ni sgyu ma'i rol gar yin/ /'bras bu ni sgyu ma'i 'od sku yin/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus/ /chos skyong ni myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /nga nyin mtshan 'ode ba/sal gyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /dpal ldan shangs pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /a ho/ /'khor 'das kyi 'dzin rtog rig ngor dag /snyems byed kyi bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod/ /bzang ngan gyi rtsis gdab dbu mar zhig /re dwogs kyi bsam pa thad kar chod/ /'khor 'das ro snyoms kyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /nga ma gcig lab sgroni gyi bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni dam pa sangs rgyas yin/ /yang mes ni grub therdzob brgyad cu yin/ /lta ba ni shes rab phar phyin yin/ /sgom pa ni zhi byed gcod yul yin/ /spyod pa ni brtul zhugs lam lhongs yin/ /'bras bu ni bdud bzhi rtsad chod yin/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni phag mo khros ma yin/ /chos skyong ni gza' klu btsan gsum yin/ /nga bdag 'dzin tshar gcod kyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /grub thob gcod kyi brgyud 'dzin 157

yin/ /a ho/ gnyis snang gi stong pa'i mun khang du/ /stong gzugs kyi sgyu ma'i rol rtsed rtse/ /'pho bcas kyi srid pa'i rgyu ba kun/ /'pho med kyi dwangs ma 'od skur grub/ /nga bu dol gnyis kyi brgyud 'dzin yin/ /mes po ni dus zhabs che chung yin/ /yang mes ni rigs ldan yab sras yin/ /lta ba mi/ 'gyur med yongs grub yin/ /sgom pa ni dus 'khor sbyor drug yin/ /spyod pa ni kun tu bzang po yin/ /'bras bu ni 'a'o med rdo rje'i sku/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni dang po'i sangs rgyas yin/ /chos skyong ni rdo rje shugs sogs yin/ /nga bde chen lam lhong gi rnal 'gyor pa/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /a ho/ 'pho bcas tha mal gyi lus ngag yid/ /'pho med rdo rje yi sku gsum bsdoms/ /bde chen khor yug gi rnal 'gyor pa/ /nga o rgyan dpal gyi bu brgyud yin/ /mes po ni rdo rje rnal 'gror ma/ /yang mes ni dang po'i sangs rgyas yin/ /lta ba ni lhan skyes gnyug ma yin/ /〉zhe༈ pa ni 31 rgyan bsnyen sgrub yin/ /spyod pa ni bde stong lam khyer yin/ /'bras bu ni rdo rje'i sku gsum yin/ /bla ma ni chos kyi blo gros yin/ /yi dam ni rdo rje phag mo yin/ /chos skyong ni mgoni chen sde lnga yin/ /nga brtul zhugs spyode pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /grub thob bsnyen sgrub kyi brgyud 'dzin yin/ /a ho/ khong 'phags yul paṇa grub thugs 158

kyi bcud/ /sod kha ba can gyi rgyal khab tu/ /chos mdo sngags bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog /don dril na sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad/ /yang bshad rgyun 'dzin pa'i bka' chen bcu/ /de kun gyi bka' babs gsang mdzod rnyed/ /mgoni kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ /mtshan chos kyi blo gros dpal bzang po/ ya ki zhig 'og min pho brang na/ /khong longs sku'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /pha ki zhig 'phags yul rdo rje gdan/ /khong mdo yi ston pa shākya thub/ /'di na zhig bod yul bsam yas na/ /khong sngags kyi stone pa pad+ma 'byung / /dus deng sang mdo khams shar gyi char/ /chos mdo sngags kyi bka' babs mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /khong gdod ma'i gzhi la dbyer med cing / /spangs rtogs dang yoni tan la khyad par med/ /thugs rje dang byin rlabs mnyam resna zhes/ /mi nga la the chom spu tsam med/ /dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do kun/ /snyepas skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /blo cwa tshom med pa hril ler gtod/ /dus nyin mtshan med par byin gyis rlobs/ /lar gsar rnying bka' gter gyi dam pa'i chos/ /ngo mtshar gyi bka' babs bdun ldan pa'i/ /rje bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ /yang lo chen be+e mo'i rnam par 'phrul/ /khong 'jam mgoni blo gros mtha' yas 'bas/ /bka' babs kyi gdams pa ma lus pa/ /bum pa ni gang dred ru 159

stsol mdzad pa/ /rje bla ma chos kyi blo gros zhabs/ /nga 'jam mgoni rnam gnyis kyi bu brgyud yin/ /gdams ngag ni gzhan la re mi da〈snas/ /the tshom dang dwogs pa sel mi dgos/ /lta ba la yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod/ /sgom pa ni nyams smyu1nga tshad mas grub/ /spyodad pa ni gang byung lam du khyer/ /bla ma ni 'jam mgoni rnam pa gsum/ /mes po ni 'phags bod paṇa grub tshogs/ /yang mes ni shāka thub rdo rje 'chang / /yi dam ni rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /mkha' 'gro ni rje btsun sgrol ma yin/ /chos skyong ni mgon chen sde lnga dang / /yang gnyan mgon chen po gdong bzhi pa/ /dpal 'dodi pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /nor lha dang dmar po skerdzor gsum yin/ /nga rten 'brel lam byed kyi rnal 'gyor pa/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /lar shing rta brgyad kyi ring lugs la/ /nyams myong gi rtogs tshad ma mchis shing / /bka' babs kyi gsang mdzod ma rnyed kyang / /rnal 'gror ni mos pa lam byed phyir/ /'byung rung rang tsam du smras pa yin/ /'dir 'bad kyi dge ba gang yod des/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do kun/ /kun mkhyen gyi bla mas rjes su gzung / /kun dga' yi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /kun khyab kyi 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub/ /kun bzang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i dgon par rab byung bcu drug lcags bya lo'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bzhir 160

bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i dus dran gyi mchod par dmigs te bris pa'o// 7/ /rje btsun grags pa dang tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub phug rnams su zhag bco lnga'i rid ba ma'i rnal 'gror gsog skabs/ gnas de na sgrub pa bya bzhin pa'e sgrub brtson pa rang gi rigs kyi tsha bor gyur pa zla ba rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor sdom p+ta gsum dang rjeg su 'brel ba'e gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di smras so// pha dran chogo (('dren mchogo ༄/rgyal po sprul pa'i sku/ /mtshan chos kyi blo gros dpal bzang po/ /mi nga yi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /las skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /sgro the tshom med pa hril ler gtod/ /skyabs gzhan na med do drin chen rje/ /mgon khyed kyi rdo rje'i ye shes mchog /mi bdag gi rgyud la 'phos pa las/ /khor yug 'od gsal gyi snang ba can/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam du byin gyis rlobs/ /khyodi mdo khams shar nas 'khyams pa yi/ /mi bdag gi rigs kyi tsha bo ni/ /sgrub brtsoni pa zla ba'i ming can gyis/ /gdams ngag gi gsal 'debs dgos so zer/ /bdag sbyangs pa chung zhing yoni tan dman/ /rang ma smin gzhan la ci zhig 'doms/ /bu 'oni kyang sngoni bsags las 'bras kyis/ /rje bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mjal/ /chos snyan brgyud nyams khrid dmar khrid thob/ /khyed dad ldan slobe bu'i tshogs rnams kyang / /rje bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /dngos mjal ba'i mos gus skyed cig dang / /gsung 'di la nor 'khrul spu tsam med/ /bu ltar snang gi chos spyodi rems na yang / /tshe 'di la zhen 161

na chos pa min/ /de'i gnyen po dal 'gror rnyed dka' dang / /'chi ba mi rtag dran par mdzod / /tshe 'di la zhen pa'i dge sbyor de/ /ming dge sbyor btags kyang chos brgyad yin/ /don de phyir tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /bu tshe 'dir mngon zhen spangs na yang / /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /de'i gnyen po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / /las 'bras la yid ches blang dor gnyes/ /lar gsor ba la zhen pa'i dka' spyad dang / /snying rus dang sgrub tshugs bzang ba sogs/ /ming chos par btags kyang khyim pa yin/ /don de phyir nges 'byung skyed cig ang / /yang daskardzon mchog gsum la ma brten pa'i/ /chos pa bzang yang mu stegs yin/ /don de phyir skyabs 'gror nan tan mdzod/ /bu khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson rwa nas/ /rang thar 'dod zhi bde don gnyer yang / /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /de'i gnyen po bdag bas gzhan gces serdzogs/ /byang chub sems la nan tan gces/ /lar sems bskyed med pa'i dge snredar kun/ /ming theg pa chen por khas 'che yang / /doni nyan thos dman lam las ma 'das/ /don de phyir byams dang snying rje dang / /chos byang chub sems la nan tan sbyongs/ /'di thugs dam gyi mthil po mdzad par zhu/ /bu kun rdzob byang sems 'grongs na yang / /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /de'i gnyen po bdag med sgom pa 162

sogs/ /don dam byang sems sbyong ba gces/ /lar bdag 'dzin dang bcas pa'i dge sbyor kun/ /ming dug med btags kyang dug can yin/ /gnas gsor ba'i mtsho las grol ba med/ /don de phyir zhi gnas lhag mthong dang / /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /thabs shes zung 'drug du nyams su longs/ /bu de ltar nyams su len pa'i mi/ /ming rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' dang / /doni lha dang bcas pa'i phyag bya'i gnas/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /lam 'di la brten nas grol ba yin/ /'phags bod kyi paṇa grub thams cad kyi/ /thugs dam gyi mthil po'ang 'di rang yin/ /lar gsang sngags theg pa 'ud che yang / /snedi byang chub sems dang mi ldan na/ /lam nges pa yin min gtad so med/ /don de phyir byang chub sems la sbyongs/ /'di nor ba med pa'i lam chen yin/ /yang phar phyin theg pa bzang na yang / /dus grangs med gsum gyi dka' spyad dgos/ /tshe 'di'am 'chi kha bar do la/ /khong phyag rgya chen po thob 'dod na/ /chos rdo rje theg pa nyams su longs/ /bu sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa des/ /dus thog mar dbang bskur sngags sdom zhus/ /sngags zab mo'i sdom pa ma thob par/ /rang pho tshod kyis sngags la 'jug pa de/ /chos rdo rje theg pa'i chom rkun yin/ /don de phyir dbang zhus sngags sdom long / /lar skyabs 'gro med na 163

sor sdom med/ /sems bskyed med na byang sdom med/ /dbang bskur med na sngags sdom med/ /don de phyir sdom gsum rnam dag longs/ /bu sdom gsum rnam dag thobo na yang / /dam tshig dang spyo1ma pa ma bsrung na/ /chos gsang sngags mi 'grub dmyal ba 'grub/ /'di khe nyen che ba'i lam yin pas/ /khe thobe na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub/ /gyong bldab na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /lar dam tshig mi bsrung sngags pa de/ /ming sngags par btags kyang bdud rgan yin/ /don de phyir dam tshig sdom pa srungs/ /bu dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa des/ / lam rim pa gnyis la 'bad rtsol gces/ /lam rim gnyis rnal 'gyor mi bsgom na/ /chos phyag rdzogs lta ba 'ud che yang / /done phar phyin theg las 'da' bar dka'/ /doni de phyir rim gnyis lam la 'bungs/ /lus zab gsal lha ru lam mer sgoms/ /ngag rdo rje'i sgra dgrangs dir rir sgrogs/ /sems 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo bar/ /lam rtsa dang rlung la spar zin gyis/ /nyams bde stong khor yug chen po'i ngang / /rkyen gang shar snang ba lam du khyer/ /phyi thos bsam 4) 〈sna yul tsam zhig dang / /sems rkyang khrid tsam la zab zab kyis/ /sngags phyag rgya tshen po 'dod pa de/ /ming phyag chen btags kyang gol ba'i lam /sngags phyag rgya chen po zer ba de/ /dbang rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin dang / /164

lam zab mosna bla ma'i rnal 'gyor gyi/ /resnas gus la gnad du bsnun pa las/ /rang byung gi ye shes rang shar ba'i/ /'od gsal gyi nyi ma snying la shar/ /gnyis snang gi mun pa rang sar dwangs/ /ye shes kyi snang ba phyogs med rgyas/ /the tshom dang sgro 'dogs cig car chod/ /gol shor dang gegs kyi 'phrang las grol/ /khong sangs rgyas byoni kyang 'dri rgyu med/ /bdud 'ordzog 'dren 'khrugs kyang dpa' mi zhum/ /khas brgya bshad rnga ma stosnang g.yug kyang / /doni rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /rig stong rjen ne ye re ba/ rī /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings/ /sprin med kyi mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /mnyam rjes kun tu rang so zungs/ /nang 'dzin pa'i sems rtog sbrul mdud bzhin/ /rang grol gyi ngang du shigs se shig /phyi tshogs drug gi yul snang chu zla bzhin/ /ye shes kyi ngang du sa le ba/ /lar dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /rig stosnang rjen ne ye re ba/ /rang ngo shes bzhin rang so zungs/ /rkyen snang kun de yi ngang du zhog /'di lta sgom spyod gsum chig dril yin/ /'dir rnying mas rdzogs pa chen po zer/ /bka' brgyud pas phyag rgya chen po zer/ /bka' gdams pas dbu ma chen po zer/ /sa skya pas 'khor 'das dbyer med zer/ /de lta bu'i tha snyad sna tshogs kyang / /don rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /dus gsum gyi rtog pas ma bslad 165

pa'i/ /gzhi dus kyi sangs rgyas bde gnyegs snying / /gsal stosnang zung 'jug sku gsum dbyengs/ /mi dbul pos nor bu rnyed pa bzhin/ /mnyam rjes kun tu 'bral med chongs/ /de'i rtsa ba bla mar mos gus dang / /sems can la snying rje chen po skyed/ /nyin snang sgyu ma rdo rje lta bur brtan/ /mtshan dus 'od gsal snying gi grogs dang 'dris/ /rmi lam sprul bsgyur mkhas pa'i rol rtsed rtse/ /'chi ba'i g.yang dang bar do'i 'phrang nang la/ /zhum med spro ba skyed cig snying gi bu/ /'di brjod pa las byung ba'i dge ba des/ /gangs kyi ri la nyi 'od 'og pa bzhin/ /khyed thugs ye shes snang ba rgyas gyur cig /de ltar brjod 'di mdo khams shar phyogs pa/ /lam 'bras 'dzin po mañju'i ming can gyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas nas nub phyogs su/ /dpag tshad gnyis tsam bgrerdzod pa'i sa yi char /grags pa rgyal mtshan tshar chen he ru kas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas dam pa mchog /mang mkhar cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ /rab byung bcu bdun sa 'brug sa ga yi/ /nya ba'i yar tshes rdzogs pa'i nyin par bris// lto/ /snga 'byur rnying ma'i phyogs la las 'phro dang bag chags phran tsam yodi pa'i rten 'brel gyis sngar bsam yas nas g.ya' ma lung dang mchims phu sogs gu ru'i sgrub gnas rnams su song ba'i tshe 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa dang rdo rje rnal 'gror ma'i sku 'ja' 'od kyi rnam par mjal ba/ khyad par yar klung shel brag tu sdod ring mdun gyi brag steng du bsdad nas bla ma 6( rgyan dbyer med la gdung shugs drag po'i 'o dod bos nas mig nas mchi ma 'bab bzhin 166

gsol ba btab pas/ yar lha sham po'i mgul tsam na 'ja' yi bosnang bu gur phub pa lta bu la steng gi nam mkha' dwangs pa las 'ja' dkar po mdung tshugs su zug pa dang 'od kyi gong bu de nam mkha' la rje mthor gshegs pa na 'ja' 'od kyi dar thag de'ang je thung du gyur pa'i mthar nam mkha' la yal bar mthong ba ni/ sngags rnying ma'i rig 'dzin mang po gnas de nyid du 'ja' lus su phebs pa'i tshul lam 'das rjes bstan pa yin nas snyam mos gus tshad med 'phel zhing / de'i tshe 'di skad kyang thal lo// a ho/ kho bo dal 'gror rdo rje'i lus bzang thob/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog gi 〉( ru zhu gas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan la zhabs 'degs grub/ /snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos la bag chags sad/ /khyad par 'jam mgoni rnam gsum bka' bsdus pa'i/ /sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi ring lugs la/ /sngon dge'i spobs pa cung zad rnyed gyur cing / /bka' babs brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i gtsor/ /rdo rje'i lung gis dbugs dbyung ci yang thob/ /da ni shi yang mi 'grod a la la ho/ /slad ma'i char yang 'byung bzhi zad zad bar/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa la/ /gcig tu sems pa'i dam bca'i ri mo 'di/ /rdo bar bris bzhin mthar thug snying po'i bar/ /yid kyi thig ler dbyer med 'dres par gyur/ /de yang 'jam mgoni mkhyen brtse'i zhal snga nas/ /rang rkyen shes rab snying brtse mi ldan zhing / /gzhan rkyen bstan la dad pa ches nyung bas/ /bstan pa gsal ba'i nus pa ma mchis kyang / /bstan pa'i sems khral tsam du deng 'dir 'bad/ /ces dang // lto/ /rgyal sras gzhan phan 167

snang bas/ /'byung bzhi zad zad kyi bar du/ /bstan pa'i zhabs tog la brtson nas/ /gdos bcas sha khrag gi lhag ma/ /gzhan gyi kha zas su spyod no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su slob 'dod tsam dang / khun mkhyen bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jam dgrangs chos kyi blo gros mchog gi zhal snga nas rang nyid la rdo rje'i zhal gdams su gnang bar yang / lto/ /65 rdir+sha/ rtag par bla ma dran pa dang / /cir snang bla mar shes pa yi/ /re(sa gus lam gyi sretreg 'khar la/ /pha rgan sa skya pa chen po'i/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la 'pho/ /zhes thugs rgyud rtogs pa rdo rje'i ye shes rgyud la dngos su 'pho ba'i zhal bzhes thob pa sogs kyang gzhan la ngom rin med mod rang nyid 'chi blo bde ba'i rtogs brjod du mar+pā no/ /ces pa 'di ni rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rang rnam las mgur rnams zur du phyung ba 'dis nyams len pa rnams la cung zad phan du re ba'i kun :thong bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas rje bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa/ thang grwa sgrub thoni pa bsode nams phrin las dang / bsam 'grub rdo rje/ sbyangs brtson pa 'jam dpal bzang po gsum nas/ rje bla ma'i rdo rje'i bka' slob 'jigs med bstan 'dzin phrin las mchesnag la spyan 'bebs zhus pas/ legs tshul gsung gi dbugs dbyung gnang ba dang / mtshams snredar bcas kyi bka' drin bstsal bas/ rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i rgyu gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga lam̐/ shu r+ghaṃ// // 168
